papers.title: We Used It Anyway: Low Trust and High Adoption of Large Language Models in Requirements Engineering Education
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) are reshaping how students approach Software Engineering activities, particularly those centered on textual artifacts. This paper reports on the experience of integrating a non-restrictive LLM use within a first-year Master's course in Software Engineering, in which students completed a semester-long Software Engineering project divided in a Requirements Engineering (RE) phase and a software testing phase. Following the completion of the RE phase of the project, we administered a 12-question survey to 43 students to investigate which LLM tools they used, for which activities, how they evaluated AI-generated outputs, and how they envisioned the role of LLMs in future SE curricula. Our findings show that LLM use was nearly universal among respondents and concentrated primarily on text-intensive activities such as use-case narratives, consistency checking, brainstorming, and refinement of existing artifacts. Despite this widespread adoption, most students perceived AI-generated outputs as inferior to their own work, frequently reporting issues related to incorrect or incomplete content, mismatches with course-specific conventions, over-engineering, and limitations in diagram generation. Nevertheless, students continued to rely extensively on LLM as a reviewer, critic, and productivity aid rather than as a fully autonomous artifact generator. We also observe that students' choice of models was strongly influenced by access to premium subscriptions available for free for student accounts, highlighting the role of economic accessibility in shaping educational AI ecosystems. The results suggest that the most significant challenge in the adoption of LLMs within Requirements Engineering education is not whether students use these tools, but whether they possess the skills required to critically evaluate, contextualize, and correct its outputs.

translation.title: 我们反正还是用了：需求工程教育中大语言模型的低信任度与高采用率
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展正在重塑学生进行软件工程活动的方式，尤其是那些以文本制品为核心的活动。本文报告了在软件工程硕士一年级课程中整合非限制性LLM使用的实践经验，学生完成了一个为期一学期的软件工程项目，该项目分为需求工程（RE）阶段和软件测试阶段。在项目的需求工程阶段完成后，我们对43名学生开展了一项包含12个问题的调查，以了解他们使用了哪些LLM工具、用于哪些活动、如何评估AI生成的输出，以及他们如何设想LLM在未来软件工程课程中的角色。我们的发现表明，LLM在受访者中几乎普遍使用，且主要集中在文本密集型活动中，如用例叙述、一致性检查、头脑风暴以及现有制品的细化。尽管采用广泛，大多数学生认为AI生成的输出不如自己的作品，经常报告内容错误或不完整、与课程特定规范不匹配、过度工程化以及图表生成方面的局限等问题。尽管如此，学生仍然大量依赖LLM作为审阅者、批评者和生产力辅助工具，而非完全自主的制品生成器。我们还观察到，学生对模型的选择在很大程度上受到学生账户免费获得的高级订阅的影响，凸显了经济可及性在塑造教育AI生态中的作用。结果表明，在需求工程教育中采用LLM的最大挑战不在于学生是否使用这些工具，而在于他们是否具备批判性评估、情境化和纠正其输出所需的技能。
translation.brief: 该论文研究LLM在需求工程课程教学中的使用情况，通过对43名学生的调查分析其使用模式、信任度及批判性评估能力的不足。

papers.title: TimeOmni-o1: Bidirectionally Coupling Time Series Foundation Models and LLMs for Multimodal Reasoning and Forecasting
papers.abstract: Time series from real-world systems are often accompanied by text, such as a report on an event that affects them. Two common tasks on these series are understanding, e.g., answering questions about a series, and forecasting its future values. Both tasks require reasoning over the series and the text together. Moreover, understanding outputs text while forecasting outputs a time series, so serving both requires a model that reads and generates both modalities. Large language models (LLMs) read time series as digit tokens and handle long series poorly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast well from large-scale pretraining but typically neither read nor generate text. Time series language models add a time series modality to the LLM but forecast on the LLM side, leaving the TSFM's pretrained forecasting ability unused. We present TimeOmni-o1, which couples a pretrained TSFM and an LLM bidirectionally. In one direction, the TSFM encodes the series in compressed form for the LLM, which reasons over it together with the text. In the other, the LLM's reasoning is fed back into the TSFM, which produces the forecast conditioned on it. One model architecture thus reads and generates both series and text, reasons in text, and draws on the TSFM's pretrained forecasting ability. To train it, we build MMTR, a multimodal time series reasoning dataset with annotated reasoning traces, covering both tasks across 12 domains with 500k+ samples. On MMTR, TimeOmni-o1 outperforms existing models on both understanding and forecasting across most domains, as well as the LLM and the TSFM inside it when used individually. The gains carry over to three open benchmarks, where it outperforms the dedicated time series models.

translation.title: TimeOmni-o1：时间序列基础模型与大语言模型的双向耦合用于多模态推理与预测
translation.abstract: 来自真实世界系统的时间序列通常伴随文本，例如关于影响该系统事件的报告。针对这些序列的两种常见任务是理解（例如回答关于序列的问题）和预测其未来值。两种任务都需要同时对序列和文本进行推理。此外，理解输出文本而预测输出时间序列，因此同时支持两种任务需要一个能读取和生成两种模态的模型。大语言模型（LLM）将时间序列作为数字token读取，处理长序列能力较差。时间序列基础模型（TSFM）凭借大规模预训练具备良好的预测能力，但通常既不能读取也不能生成文本。时间序列语言模型为LLM增加了时间序列模态，但在LLM一侧进行预测，浪费了TSFM预训练的预测能力。我们提出TimeOmni-o1，将预训练的TSFM与LLM双向耦合。在一个方向上，TSFM以压缩形式为LLM编码序列，LLM结合文本对其进行推理；在另一个方向上，LLM的推理结果反馈给TSFM，TSFM据此为条件生成预测。因此一个模型架构既能读取和生成序列与文本，又能以文本进行推理，并利用TSFM预训练的预测能力。为训练该模型，我们构建了MMTR，一个带有标注推理轨迹的多模态时间序列推理数据集，覆盖12个领域的两种任务，样本量超过50万。在MMTR上，TimeOmni-o1在理解和预测任务上于大多数领域超越现有模型，也优于其内部的LLM和TSFM单独使用时的表现。这些增益延续到三个开放基准上，在其中超越了专用时间序列模型。
translation.brief: 该论文解决时间序列与文本联合的推理和预测问题，通过双向耦合TSFM与LLM构建TimeOmni-o1，并构建MMTR多模态数据集进行训练。

papers.title: Actionable Feedback: Improving Model Capabilities from User Edit Data on Clinical Documentation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in clinical documentation workflows, where clinicians review and edit their outputs before use. In principle, these clinician edits represent a scalable source of supervision for model training. In practice, not all edits represent actionable feedback: for instance, on data drawn from real-world deployment of an AI clinical documentation product, our review suggests that over 45% of edited outputs contain user-added information that is not directly supported by the inputs to the model. Naively fine-tuning on such edits risks teaching the model to hallucinate. In this paper, we develop a method to address this challenge. Given that real clinician edits on deployed documentation tools are not publicly available, we first develop a taxonomy of clinician-editing behaviors, informed by data from a deployed AI clinical documentation product. Then, we develop a method for generating semi-synthetic clinician-edit data, informed by our taxonomy, on a discharge-summary generation task based on MIMIC-III, a public dataset. Finally, we introduce simple filtering methods for identifying actionable edits, with accuracy evaluated by expert review. We show empirically, on our semi-synthetic dataset, that naive fine-tuning on raw edited output increases ungrounded content, while our approach of progressively filtering toward grounded edits enables improvement on clinician-alignment metrics while retaining faithfulness to the input context.

translation.title: 可行动的反馈：利用临床文档中的用户编辑数据提升模型能力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署于临床文档工作流中，临床医生在使用前会审阅并编辑其输出。原则上，这些医生编辑是模型训练的可扩展监督来源。实践中，并非所有编辑都是可行动的反馈：例如，在来自AI临床文档产品真实部署的数据中，我们的审查发现超过45%的被编辑输出包含模型输入并不直接支持的用户添加信息。对这类编辑进行朴素微调有教会模型产生幻觉的风险。本文提出一种应对该挑战的方法。鉴于部署文档工具上的真实医生编辑并不公开可得，我们首先基于一个已部署的AI临床文档产品的数据，开发了医生编辑行为的分类体系。然后，基于该分类体系，在基于MIMIC-III（公开数据集）的出院总结生成任务上开发了生成半合成医生编辑数据的方法。最后，我们引入简单的过滤方法来识别可行动的编辑，其准确性通过专家审查进行评估。我们在半合成数据集上实证表明，对原始被编辑输出进行朴素微调会增加无依据内容，而我们的逐步过滤至有依据编辑的方法能在保持对输入上下文忠实性的同时，提升医生对齐指标。
translation.brief: 该论文解决临床文档场景中用户编辑数据含有不可靠信息导致微调引发幻觉的问题，提出编辑行为分类体系和过滤可行动编辑的方法。

papers.title: Brasilidade: Measuring Brazilian Identity for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This work presents a new benchmark that aims to address the limitations of current methods for evaluating LLMs in Brazilian Portuguese. We introduced Brasilidade, an assessment methodology comprised of standardized tasks distributed across four different domains, and we are making available the tasks from its first domain, which address nuances of the language, grammar, and variations of Brazilian Portuguese. The results show that model size, by itself, does not determine performance; several medium-sized models outperformed larger models in the protocols evaluated. Specific models for Portuguese, in general, did not perform above average, despite their targeted training. Different task levels revealed significant nuances: while some tasks proved easy for most models, others posed extreme challenges, and some yielded mixed results, with wide variations in performance. This clearly illustrates the need for benchmarks that address the limitations of the models in Brazilian Portuguese, allowing future training cycles to seek to overcome them. Project repository this https URL

translation.title: Brasilidade：度量大语言模型的巴西身份认同
translation.abstract: 本工作提出了一个新基准，旨在解决当前在巴西葡萄牙语上评估LLM的方法的局限性。我们提出了Brasilidade，这是一种评估方法学，包含分布于四个不同领域的标准化任务，我们正在发布其第一个领域的任务，涉及巴西葡萄牙语的语言细微差别、语法及变体。结果表明，模型规模本身并不决定性能；若干中等规模的模型在所评估的协议中超越了更大的模型。针对葡萄牙语的专用模型总体上表现并未高于平均水平，尽管它们经过了针对性训练。不同任务级别揭示了显著的细微差别：某些任务对大多数模型来说较为容易，另一些则构成极端挑战，还有一些产生了好坏参半的结果，性能差异很大。这清楚地说明需要针对巴西葡萄牙语模型局限性的基准，使未来的训练周期能够致力于克服这些局限。项目仓库见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文解决巴西葡萄牙语LLM评估方法不足的问题，构建了跨四个领域标准化任务的Brasilidade基准并发布首领域任务。

papers.title: Using LLM Agents to Evaluate Prosocial Interventions on Social Media Platforms
papers.abstract: Social media platforms are a primary source of information for many users. Although research explores various interventions to promote prosocial content or demote harmful content on platforms, there are few systematic methods for evaluating competing intervention designs before conducting costly human-subject experiments. We develop a simulation-based evaluation pipeline built on the OASIS framework. We generate 13,835 LLM-based agents, each with a unique profile. Over 20 time steps, we expose them to real-world Twitter/X posts and let them comment, like, repost, or follow. We use those agents to systematically evaluate three interventions that increase exposure to verified news: adding content, upranking content, and celebrity source cues. All interventions significantly increase news engagement, with upranking news to prominent feed positions producing the largest effects. These effects hold across agents' gender, age, and education levels. We validate our injection treatment results against a comparable human-subject study and find strong directional alignment and similar dose-normalized efficiency. Our results suggest that LLM-based agent simulations can support early-stage evaluation of platform interventions before human-subject deployment, and upranking may be more effective than news volume or source.

translation.title: 使用LLM智能体评估社交媒体平台上的亲社会干预措施
translation.abstract: 社交媒体平台是许多用户的主要信息来源。尽管研究探索了多种干预措施来推广亲社会内容或降低有害内容的传播，但在开展成本高昂的人类受试者实验之前，缺乏对竞争性干预设计进行系统评估的方法。我们基于OASIS框架开发了基于仿真的评估流水线。我们生成了13,835个LLM驱动的智能体，每个都有独特的档案。在超过20个时间步中，我们向它们展示真实的Twitter/X帖子，让它们评论、点赞、转发或关注。我们利用这些智能体系统地评估了三种提高经核实新闻曝光度的干预措施：添加内容、提升内容排名以及名人来源提示。所有干预措施都显著提高了新闻参与度，其中将新闻提升至信息流的显要位置产生的效果最大。这些效应在不同性别、年龄和教育水平的智能体上均成立。我们将注入处理的结果与一项可比的人类受试者研究进行了验证，发现了强烈的方向一致性和相似的剂量归一化效率。我们的结果表明，基于LLM的智能体仿真可以在人类受试者部署前支持平台干预的早期评估，且提升排名可能比新闻数量或来源更有效。
translation.brief: 该论文解决平台干预措施缺乏低成本系统评估方法的问题，基于OASIS框架构建LLM智能体仿真流水线并评估三种提升新闻曝光的干预。

papers.title: Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation
papers.abstract: Closed-loop autonomous experimentation can accelerate scientific discovery, but implementation effort limits accessibility. Agentic systems may lower this barrier, although sustained operation on physical instruments remains largely unexplored. Here, using coding-agent infrastructure grounded in validated scientific methods, we demonstrate autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving, human-defined objectives. Complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts enable an audit that reconstructs decision provenance and characterizes the division of cognitive labor. Across three experiments, 61-67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, while the share of methodological and scientific contributions increased from 46% in the setup-focused first experiment to 56-61% in later experiments. Provenance showed that 59-68% of error corrections involved multiple participants and that about half of all decisions incorporated the input of another participant. These results may guide design principles for multi-agent scientific systems and inform future agent harnesses, model training, and accessible autonomous experimentation.

translation.title: 面向自主X射线实验的可审计人-智能体协作团队
translation.abstract: 闭环自主实验能够加速科学发现，但实现成本限制了其可及性。智能体（Agentic）系统或可降低这一门槛，然而其在物理仪器上的持续运行仍鲜有探索。本文利用基于经过验证的科学方法构建的编码智能体（coding-agent）基础设施，演示了在人类设定、不断演化的目标下，针对纳米颗粒超晶格的自主同步辐射X射线实验。完整的人-智能体与智能体-智能体对话记录使审计能够重建决策溯源并刻画认知劳动的分工。在三个实验中，61-67%的消息涉及解释或判断，方法论与科学贡献的占比从聚焦搭建的首个实验的46%上升到后续实验的56-61%。溯源分析显示59-68%的错误纠正涉及多个参与者，且约一半的决策纳入了其他参与者的输入。这些结果可为多智能体科学系统的设计原则提供指导，并为未来的智能体框架、模型训练和可及的自主实验提供参考。
translation.brief: 解决智能体系统在真实物理仪器上持续运行自主实验的可及性与可审计性问题，采用基于验证科学方法的编码智能体基础设施在同步辐射X射线实验中演示并利用完整对话记录进行决策溯源审计。

papers.title: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. Existing benchmarks fall short: they pose questions on curated images or give agents preprocessed inputs, leaving out the raw multi-sensor archives where such analysis begins. We introduce EarthRecord, a benchmark built on the raw record of 56 sites: four decades of Landsat, MODIS, VIIRS, and Sentinel-2 data, with cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization left to the agent. It poses 238 land-change questions across ten analysis tasks, scored against withheld references from global products, agreement among methods, and visual interpretation. Two controls test what answers rest on: the closed book removes the record, and instrument pairs alter one satellite's data while nothing changes on the ground. Evaluations of twelve multimodal agents reveal that leading agents complete most analyses end to end but falter when an answer requires mapping from imagery. Further analysis shows that the record moves answers from prior knowledge to the pixels but not yet to the real change on the ground: when one satellite's data are altered, half of the right answers follow the alteration. EarthRecord thus provides a principled platform for measuring and advancing agents from pixels to land change.

translation.title: EarthRecord：基于多模态智能体从像素到土地变化分析的四十余年卫星影像研究
translation.abstract: 尽管多模态智能体现在能够借助工具执行复杂数据分析，但它们将数十年卫星影像转化为可靠土地变化分析的能力——这对地球观测科学至关重要——仍未被测量。现有基准存在不足：它们在精选影像上提问，或为智能体提供预处理输入，忽略了此类分析所依赖的原始多传感器档案。我们提出EarthRecord，该基准建立在56个站点的原始记录之上：四十年的Landsat、MODIS、VIIRS和Sentinel-2数据，云掩膜与跨传感器协调均由智能体自行完成。基准提出覆盖十项分析任务的238个土地变化问题，依据全球产品的保留参考、方法间一致性及目视解译进行评分。两项对照实验检验答案的依据：闭卷（closed book）移除影像记录，而仪器对照（instrument pairs）在地面无实际变化的情况下篡改一颗卫星的数据。对十二个多模态智能体的评估表明，领先智能体能端到端完成大部分分析，但当答案需要从影像制图时会表现不佳。进一步分析显示，影像记录使答案从先验知识转向像素本身，但尚未触及地面真实变化：当一颗卫星的数据被篡改时，一半的正确答案会随之改变。EarthRecord由此为测量和推进智能体从像素到土地变化的能力提供了一个有原则的平台。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏衡量多模态智能体从原始多传感器卫星档案进行土地变化分析能力的基准问题，提出EarthRecord，要求智能体在未预处理的长时序影像上自行完成云掩膜与跨传感器协调并回答土地变化问题。

papers.title: AI Governance Should Prioritize Control and Knowledge Boundaries Over Limiting Intelligence
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of autonomously acting AI agents makes the governance of agentic systems urgent. We propose the competence circuit, summarized as IKC + KC + C, that decomposes an agent's real-world impact into three pathways: intelligence-mediated discovery, procedural know-how, and direct control. Using the canonical fast-takeoff debate as a stress test, we formalize the conditions for intelligence-mediated fast takeoff as a conjunction jointly sufficient for fast catastrophic supremacy, showing that most rely on rapid knowledge acquisition or control attainment rather than intelligence alone. We operationalize epistemic intelligence as hypothesis-selection efficiency and validate this framework via stochastic simulation on NK fitness landscapes across six scenarios spanning the conjunctive chain. An analytic bound supported by the simulations shows that intelligence-driven speedup is capped by the ratio of competing intelligence levels regardless of task difficulty. The simulations also expose a fast-takeoff dilemma: a large intelligence-driven speedup multiplier materializes only when the hypothesis space is noisy, but the absolute timescale remains constrained by the time required for capability-critical tests, so a large multiplier need not imply rapid progress. Simulations also indicate that institutional chokepoints disproportionately slow down superintelligent agents when mandatory authorization delays are large relative to the negligible time these agents spend on unproductive search. We argue that the dominant safety levers are restricting control and enforcing knowledge boundaries rather than limiting intelligence alone, and this applies to agentic systems at any capability level. Purely digital domains weaken these bottlenecks, strengthening the case for architectures that intentionally "put physics in the loop."

translation.title: AI治理应优先关注控制与知识边界而非限制智能
translation.abstract: 自主行动的AI智能体迅速普及，使智能体系统的治理变得紧迫。我们提出能力回路（competence circuit），概括为IKC + KC + C，将智能体的现实世界影响分解为三条路径：智能介导的发现、程序性技艺和直接控制。以经典的快速起飞（fast-takeoff）争论作为压力测试，我们将智能介导的快速起飞条件形式化为一个对快速灾难性霸权共同充分的合取，证明其中大多数依赖快速知识获取或控制达成，而非仅凭智能。我们将认知智能操作化为假设选择效率，并通过在NK适应度景观上跨越合取链六个场景的随机模拟验证了该框架。模拟支持的一个解析上界表明，智能驱动的加速受竞争智能水平之比的限制，与任务难度无关。模拟还揭示了一个快速起飞困境：大幅的智能驱动加速倍数只在假设空间有噪声时才出现，但绝对时间尺度仍受能力关键测试所需时间的约束，因此大倍数不一定意味着快速进展。模拟还表明，当强制性授权延迟相对于超智能智能体在无成效搜索上所耗的可忽略时间足够大时，制度性瓶颈会不成比例地拖慢超智能智能体。我们认为主要的安全杠杆是限制控制并执行知识边界，而非仅限制智能，且这适用于任何能力水平的智能体系统。纯数字领域会削弱这些瓶颈，这加强了有意"让物理参与回路"的架构设计的必要性。
translation.brief: 解决AI治理应针对何种能力施加限制的问题，提出将智能体影响分解为智能、技艺与控制三条路径的能力回路框架，并用NK适应度景观随机模拟论证控制与知识边界是比限制智能更有效的安全杠杆。

papers.title: SPMW: A Grid-Based Programming Model for Scalable Accelerator Design
papers.abstract: Modern accelerators specialize recurring computation and replicate it across regular hardware structures to achieve high performance. Sustaining this parallelism requires equally deliberate data delivery. Yet design tools often express these structures as sequential programs or flatten them into separate hardware modules and connections. This obscures shared patterns and leads to repeated compiler work. We introduce Single Program, Multiple Connected Work Units (SPMW), a grid-based programming model for scalable accelerator design that makes grid regularity a first-class abstraction. SPMW decouples local work-unit behavior from grid connectivity and data delivery. To our knowledge, SPMW is the first programming model to retain regularity throughout the compilation process, combining behavioral HLS with structural RTL generation for both fixed-function and domain-specific instruction-programmable accelerators. We implement SPMW with a Python frontend and an MLIR-based compiler that synthesizes each distinct kernel configuration once for reuse across independent hardware instances. Preserving regularity also enables parallel compilation and functional simulation to accelerate iterative design feedback. We use SPMW to generate a 32x32 systolic array that reduces GEMM latency and parallel kernel-to-RTL compilation time by 4.36x and 619x relative to AutoSA. Our FFT achieves up to 2.65x lower latency than HP-FFT. Our mini-TPU and our SPMW implementation of the FEATHER accelerator demonstrate complex composition and outperform their RTL baselines. Parallel functional simulation provides up to 18.4x speedup over Vitis HLS C simulation on the mini-TPU workloads. SPMW is also agent-friendly: given the same design specification, all five coding agents produce SPMW designs that satisfy the correctness and latency requirements, with 7.51x lower token usage than for SystemVerilog.

translation.title: SPMW：一种用于可扩展加速器设计的基于网格的编程模型
translation.abstract: 现代加速器通过将重复计算专门化并在规则硬件结构上复制来实现高性能。维持这种并行性需要同样精心设计的数据传递。然而设计工具往往将这些结构表达为顺序程序，或将其拆散为分离的硬件模块与连接。这掩盖了共享模式并导致重复的编译工作。我们提出单程序多连接工作单元（Single Program, Multiple Connected Work Units, SPMW），一种使网格规则性成为一等抽象的可扩展加速器设计编程模型。SPMW将局部工作单元行为与网格连接性和数据传递解耦。据我们所知，SPMW是首个在整个编译流程中保持规则性的编程模型，将行为级HLS与结构级RTL生成相结合，同时支持固定功能和领域特定的指令可编程加速器。我们以Python前端和基于MLIR的编译器实现SPMW，对每个不同的核配置只综合一次，即可在独立硬件实例间复用。保持规则性还支持并行编译与功能仿真，以加速迭代式设计反馈。我们用SPMW生成了一个32x32脉动阵列，相对AutoSA将GEMM延迟降低4.36倍、并行核到RTL编译时间降低619倍。我们的FFT相比HP-FFT实现最高2.65倍的延迟降低。我们的mini-TPU以及FEATHER加速器的SPMW实现展示了复杂组合能力并优于其RTL基线。在mini-TPU工作负载上，并行功能仿真相对Vitis HLS C仿真提供最高18.4倍的加速。SPMW对智能体同样友好：给定相同设计规约，全部五个编码智能体均生成满足正确性与延迟要求的SPMW设计，且token用量比SystemVerilog低7.51倍。
translation.brief: 解决加速器设计工具掩盖网格结构规则性、导致重复编译工作的问题，提出SPMW网格编程模型，将工作单元行为与网格连接解耦并在整个编译流程中保留规则性以实现综合复用、并行编译与高效仿真。

papers.title: SetPrint: Black-Box LLM Fingerprinting via Setwise Correspondence of Response Changes
papers.abstract: Black-box LLM fingerprinting aims to determine whether a target model was derived from a source model when only the output responses to input queries are observable. One way to reveal this relationship is to perturb each query and observe the resulting responses of both models, yielding two corresponding sets of response variations. These sets provide two complementary sources of information: the relations among response changes within each set, and the correspondence of response changes between the two sets. Existing approaches, however, have not fully exploited both. We introduce \textbf{SetPrint}, a training-free method that jointly captures both within-set relations and between-set correspondence. SetPrint expresses each response change relative to the mean change of its own set, and then compares changes from the two models that were induced by the same perturbation. On LeaFBench, SetPrint consistently outperforms existing training-free black-box fingerprinting methods. Further analyses attribute these gains to both within-set relations and between-set correspondence.

translation.title: SetPrint：基于响应变化集合对应关系的黑盒LLM指纹识别
translation.abstract: 黑盒LLM指纹识别旨在仅当可观测模型对输入查询的输出响应时，判断目标模型是否派生自源模型。揭示这种关系的一种方式是对每个查询进行扰动并观察两个模型产生的响应，得到两组对应的响应变化集合。这些集合提供两种互补的信息来源：每组内部响应变化之间的关系，以及两组之间响应变化的对应关系。然而现有方法未能充分利用二者。我们提出SetPrint，一种无需训练的方法，联合捕获组内关系与组间对应关系。SetPrint将每个响应变化表示为相对于其所在集合平均变化的偏差，然后比较由相同扰动在两个模型上诱导的变化。在LeaFBench上，SetPrint持续优于现有无需训练的黑盒指纹识别方法。进一步分析将这一优势归因于组内关系与组间对应两方面。
translation.brief: 解决仅凭黑盒输出判断LLM派生关系时对响应变化信息利用不充分的问题，提出免训练的SetPrint方法，联合刻画各组内部响应变化关系及相同扰动下两模型响应变化的组间对应关系。

papers.title: Agent Architecture Cost-Success Trade-offs: A Controlled Evaluation across Enterprise-Style SOPs
papers.abstract: Enterprises increasingly use large language model agents to execute standard operating procedures (SOPs): long, branching, tool-intensive workflows. Yet there is little controlled evidence for choosing among competing agentic architectures. Holding the model, tasks, and tools fixed and varying only the architecture, we compare four designs (a function-calling single agent, a skill-augmented agent, centralized multi-agent orchestration, and a triage swarm; eight arms) across 13 enterprise SOPs, and introduce a skill-definition quality rubric to build matched high and low-quality skill corpora. Three takeaways emerge. (1)~\textbf{There is no universal best architecture; the right choice is SOP-dependent.} On a given SOP, task success ranges from under $10\%$ on the hardest to near $100\%$ on the easiest; no architecture is statistically separable in aggregate, and added structure only plausibly pays off on complex, branching SOPs (a directional, not yet significant, trend). (2)~\textbf{Added architecture cost must be justified by a task-success gain.} Every coordinated arm (multi-agent or skill-augmented) spends $1.4$--$4.7\times$ the tokens and $2.6$--$5.8\times$ the latency of the single agent for gains that are usually small and rarely significant, making the single agent the efficient default; high-quality skills do lift success (to $73.1\%$ from $67.4\%$) while degraded skills fall below it. (3)~\textbf{Implementation quality outweighs the single- versus multi-agent choice.} A plausible multi-agent implementation loses to the single agent, yet a targeted redesign of it becomes the only arm to significantly beat the baseline ($75.6\%$ vs.\ $67.4\%$).

translation.title: Agent架构的成本-成功权衡：面向企业式SOP的受控评估
translation.abstract: 企业越来越多地使用大语言模型 agent 执行标准操作规程（SOP）：冗长、分支众多且依赖工具的工作流。然而，在竞争性 agentic 架构之间做选择时，鲜有受控证据。我们在固定模型、任务和工具、仅改变架构的条件下，在13个企业 SOP 上比较四种设计（函数调用单 agent、技能增强 agent、集中式多 agent 编排、分诊 swarm；共8个实验组），并引入技能定义质量评分标准来构建匹配的高质量与低质量技能语料库。得到三点结论。(1) 没有普适最优架构；正确选择取决于具体 SOP。在同一 SOP 上，任务成功率从最难的不到 10% 到最容易的接近 100%；总体上没有任何架构在统计上可区分，额外结构仅在复杂、分支型 SOP 上可能有回报（方向性趋势，尚未显著）。(2) 架构成本的增加必须由任务成功率的提升来证明其合理性。每个协调型实验组（多 agent 或技能增强）花费单 agent 1.4–4.7 倍的 token 和 2.6–5.8 倍的延迟，而收益通常很小且很少显著，使单 agent 成为高效的默认选择；高质量技能确实能提升成功率（从 67.4% 到 73.1%），而劣化的技能则低于它。(3) 实现质量胜过单 agent 与多 agent 之争。一个看似合理的多 agent 实现输给了单 agent，但对其进行针对性重设计后，成为唯一显著超过基线的实验组（75.6% vs. 67.4%）。
translation.brief: 在固定模型与任务、仅变架构的受控实验中，评估四种 agent 架构在企业 SOP 上的成本与成功率权衡，发现架构选择应视任务而定且实现质量比单/多 agent 之争更重要。

papers.title: Physics2Weight: Direct Neural Network Architecture and Weight Generation from Physical Laws Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled weight-space programming (WSP), which directly generates neural network weights without gradient-based optimization. However, extending WSP to physical problems remains challenging, particularly in achieving both solution accuracy and physical consistency. In this paper, we propose Physics2Weight (PtW), a framework that extends WSP to solving partial differential equations by directly generating neural network weights and editing architectures based on governing equations and initial and boundary conditions. PtW introduces physics-constrained prompting and physics-guided architecture editing, combined with iterative weight refinement from WSP, to improve solution accuracy and physical consistency without gradient-based optimization. Experiments on four PDEs, namely the heat, advection, Burgers', and Allen--Cahn equations, demonstrate lower solution errors than conventional physics-informed neural networks, while revealing limitations in satisfying the governing equations for nonlinear PDEs.

translation.title: Physics2Weight：利用大语言模型从物理定律直接生成神经网络架构与权重
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展催生了权重空间编程（WSP），即无需基于梯度的优化即可直接生成神经网络权重。然而，将 WSP 扩展到物理问题仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在同时实现解的精度和物理一致性方面。本文提出 Physics2Weight（PtW），该框架将 WSP 扩展到偏微分方程求解，通过基于控制方程及初始和边界条件直接生成神经网络权重并编辑架构。PtW 引入物理约束提示和物理引导的架构编辑，结合 WSP 的迭代权重精化，在无需基于梯度的优化的情况下提高解的精度和物理一致性。在热传导、对流、Burgers 和 Allen–Cahn 四个 PDE 上的实验表明，其解的误差低于传统的物理信息神经网络（PINN），同时揭示了非线性 PDE 在满足控制方程方面的局限。
translation.brief: 提出 Physics2Weight 框架，用 LLM 基于控制方程与初边界条件直接生成并迭代精化求解 PDE 的神经网络架构与权重，替代基于梯度的优化。

papers.title: DocFS: File Systems as Agentic Reasoning Environments for Complex Multimodal Document Question Answering
papers.abstract: VLM-based agents solve complex tasks by iteratively interacting with environments, and their effectiveness depends heavily on how the environment exposes information and provides tools for acting on it. However, constructing an effective environment for complex multimodal document question answering remains challenging: documents usually span many pages, with multimodal contents distributed across hierarchical sections and linked by cross-modal associations, while existing methods organize documents into structured representations that address only the information side of the environment and lack tools aligned with the structure, limiting agents' ability to fully exploit it. We observe that file systems naturally combine structure organization with aligned tools: directories and files encode document structure, while file operations provide rich tools to access file contents. Building on this insight, we propose DocFS, a file-system-based agentic framework that reorganizes raw documents as file systems, where directories mirror the section hierarchy and explicit links connect text with figures, tables, and equations. Based on well-established file system tools such as navigation, search, and reading, agents can iteratively explore the document structure, locate relevant evidence, and understand fine-grained local information. Paired with Qwen3.5-Plus, DocFS achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMLongBench-Doc and FinRAGBench-V, outperforming the strongest baselines by 2.9 and 4.3 percentage points, respectively, and is up to 10.3x faster with up to 10.1x fewer tokens than the strongest baseline during reasoning.

translation.title: DocFS：作为 Agentic 推理环境的文件系统，用于复杂多模态文档问答
translation.abstract: 基于 VLM 的 agent 通过与环境的迭代交互解决复杂任务，其有效性很大程度上取决于环境如何暴露信息以及提供作用于信息的工具。然而，为复杂多模态文档问答构建有效环境仍然具有挑战性：文档通常跨越多页，多模态内容分布在层级化的章节中，并通过跨模态关联相互链接；而现有方法将文档组织为只解决环境信息侧的结构化表示，缺乏与该结构对齐的工具，限制了 agent 充分利用文档的能力。我们观察到文件系统天然地将结构组织与对齐工具结合在一起：目录和文件编码文档结构，而文件操作提供了访问文件内容的丰富工具。基于这一洞察，我们提出 DocFS，一个基于文件系统的 agentic 框架，将原始文档重组为文件系统，其中目录映射章节层级，显式链接连接文本与图、表和公式。借助成熟的文件系统工具（如导航、搜索和读取），agent 可以迭代地探索文档结构、定位相关证据并理解细粒度的局部信息。配合 Qwen3.5-Plus，DocFS 在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 FinRAGBench-V 上达到最先进性能，分别超过最强基线 2.9 和 4.3 个百分点，且推理速度最高快 10.3 倍、token 消耗最多少 10.1 倍。
translation.brief: 提出 DocFS，将多模态文档重组为文件系统并利用文件操作工具，使 agent 能迭代探索文档结构以提升多模态文档问答的准确性与效率。

papers.title: Monitoring One Channel Is Not Communication Control: Causal Evidence for Adaptive Reallocation of Joint Message--Route Codes
papers.abstract: Monitoring a visible channel can change how learned agents communicate without removing why communication is useful. We test this distinction in an end-to-end game where a sender and receiver learn a discrete protocol and route policy without communication supervision. In two independent 20-seed batches, 20/20 and 19/20 protocols form. Online partial coverage increases shadow-route share over no monitoring by .701 [.574,.826] and .575 [.412,.737], while task accuracy remains .905/.913 and signed frozen message contribution remains .592/.563. Complete coverage removes most selective migration without removing communication. Frozen interventions, including a fresh pre-outcome confirmation, show that route is semantic: joint message--route shuffling changes .668 of receiver predictions and route alone retains .388 accuracy versus .25 chance. A corrected explicit-silence cost makes 18/20 policies fully silent and lowers mean sending to .050, but its strict complete-suppression gate fails because two seeds retain communication. Failed semantic-evasion and operational gates further bound the result. The evidence supports adaptive reallocation of a joint message--route code under partial monitoring, not open-world route discovery, emergent encryption, or a universal defense.

translation.title: 监控一个信道并非通信控制：联合“消息-路由”码自适应重分配的因果证据
translation.abstract: 监控一个可见信道可以改变习得的 agent 如何通信，但不会消除通信为何有用。我们在一个端到端博弈中检验这一区分，其中发送者和接收者在没有通信监督的情况下学习离散协议和路由策略。在两个独立的 20-seed 批次中，分别有 20/20 和 19/20 个协议形成。在线部分覆盖相比无监控将影子路由份额分别提高了 .701 [.574,.826] 和 .575 [.412,.737]，而任务准确率保持 .905/.913，带符号的冻结消息贡献保持 .592/.563。完全覆盖移除了大部分选择性迁移但没有移除通信。冻结干预（包括新的事前确认）表明路由是语义性的：联合“消息-路由”混洗改变了 .668 的接收者预测，而仅路由相比 .25 的随机水平仍保留 .388 的准确率。修正后的显式沉默代价使 18/20 个策略完全沉默并将平均发送量降至 .050，但其严格的完全抑制门控因两个 seed 保留了通信而失败。语义规避与操作性门控的失败进一步限定了该结果。证据支持在部分监控下联合“消息-路由”码的自适应重分配，而非开放世界的路由发现、涌现加密或通用防御。
translation.brief: 通过端到端博弈与冻结干预实验，因果证明监控可见信道只会引起 agent 联合“消息-路由”码的自适应重分配而非通信消失或加密。

papers.title: Exploration via Exploitation: The Blessing of Reward Diversity in Personalized Federated RL
papers.abstract: While federated reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally guaranteed high efficiency in homogeneous environments, collaboration is often hindered when agents possess distinct goals. In this paper, we flip this paradigm, framing reward heterogeneity not as a hurdle to consensus, but as a structural asset that catalyzes exploration. We first propose Personalized Federated Upper Confidence Bound Value Iteration (PF-UCBVI), which achieves optimal linear speedup by decoupling shared dynamics from personalized objectives. To eliminate the risks of explicit exploration, we then introduce Personalized Federated Exploration-Free Value Iteration (PF-EFVI), a purely greedy algorithm that leverages reward diversity to ensure state-action coverage. We prove that PF-EFVI attains logarithmic regret without explicit exploration bonuses under sufficient reward diversity. Our results reveal that agent disagreement shifts the exploration burden from temporal complexity to spatial diversity, enabling efficient collective learning without explicit exploration.

translation.title: 通过利用进行探索：个性化联邦强化学习中奖励多样性的福音
translation.abstract: 联邦强化学习（RL）传统上在同质环境中保证高效率，但当 agent 拥有不同目标时，协作往往受阻。本文反转这一范式，将奖励异质性不视为达成共识的障碍，而视为催化探索的结构性资产。我们首先提出个性化联邦上置信界值迭代（PF-UCBVI），通过将共享动力学与个性化目标解耦，实现最优线性加速。为消除显式探索的风险，我们进一步提出个性化联邦无探索值迭代（PF-EFVI），一种纯贪心算法，利用奖励多样性确保状态-动作覆盖。我们证明在足够的奖励多样性下，PF-EFVI 无需显式探索奖励即可达到对数遗憾。我们的结果表明，agent 之间的分歧将探索负担从时间复杂度转移到空间多样性，从而无需显式探索即可实现高效集体学习。
translation.brief: 提出 PF-UCBVI 与 PF-EFVI 两种个性化联邦强化学习算法，将奖励异质性作为探索资产，纯贪心的 PF-EFVI 借助奖励多样性实现对数遗憾而无须显式探索。

papers.title: BuySideFlow: A Point-in-Time Benchmark for LLM Agents in Investment Research
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate SQL and SQL--Python workflows for investment research, but ensuring point-in-time (PIT) validity remains challenging. Agents must enforce disclosure cutoffs and select the appropriate historical states and record versions throughout data retrieval and financial analysis. We introduce \textsc{BuySideFlow}, a benchmark of 408 practitioner-derived Chinese-language tasks spanning equities, funds, fixed income, and macroeconomics over a fixed snapshot from a licensed production financial database. We provide executable references and a taxonomy of temporal errors, pairing result checks with expert audits of executed workflows. We evaluate nine agent configurations on all tasks, with result accuracy ranging from 16.2\% to 36.8\%. An audit of 900 runs on 100 shared tasks confirms PIT violations in 193 of the 380 runs that pass result checks (50.8\%), showing that output agreement alone does not establish temporal validity.

translation.title: BuySideFlow：面向投资研究的 LLM Agent 时点（Point-in-Time）基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以为投资研究生成 SQL 以及 SQL-Python 工作流，但确保时点（PIT）有效性仍然充满挑战。Agent 必须在数据检索和金融分析的全过程中强制执行披露截止期，并选择适当的历史状态和记录版本。我们提出 BuySideFlow，一个包含 408 个来自从业者实践的中文任务的基准，涵盖在持牌生产金融数据库固定快照上的股票、基金、固定收益和宏观经济领域。我们提供了可执行的参考实现和时间错误分类法，将结果检查与对已执行工作流的专家审计相结合。我们在所有任务上评估了九种 agent 配置，结果准确率在 16.2% 到 36.8% 之间。对 100 个共享任务上 900 次运行的审计显示，在通过结果检查的 380 次运行中有 193 次（50.8%）存在 PIT 违规，表明仅凭输出一致并不能确立时间有效性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM Agent 在投资研究数据检索中难以保证时点（PIT）有效性的问题，构建了基于持牌金融数据库固定快照、含 408 个中文实践任务的基准，并辅以时间错误分类与专家审计进行评估。

papers.title: TrustMod-SM: A Multi-Axis Benchmark for Evaluating Trustworthiness of LLMs in Social Media Content Moderation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong potential for social media content moderation, but their trustworthiness beyond overall accuracy remains underexplored. We introduce TrustMod-SM, a benchmark of roughly 29,000 instances across eight datasets, to evaluate LLM moderators on five dimensions: trustfulness, fairness, safety, robustness, and context integrity. Evaluating 16 open-weight models (0.5B-284B parameters, spanning text-only and vision-language architectures) and one closed frontier model, we find persistent trustworthiness gaps. Higher detection accuracy often coincides with greater demographic disparity, and models frequently comply with concealment or exaggeration prompts, assign high confidence to wrong predictions, rarely escalate ambiguous cases, and struggle to separate hate speech from counter-speech or reclaimed language (especially below 8B parameters). Scaling does not uniformly resolve these issues, and no single model excels across all five dimensions.

translation.title: TrustMod-SM：评估 LLM 在社交媒体内容审核中可信度的多维度基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在社交媒体内容审核方面展现出强大潜力，但其在整体准确率之外的可信度仍研究不足。我们提出 TrustMod-SM，一个涵盖八个数据集约 29,000 个实例的基准，从五个维度评估 LLM 审核员：可信性、公平性、安全性、鲁棒性和上下文完整性。我们评估了 16 个开源权重模型（0.5B-284B 参数，涵盖纯文本和视觉-语言架构）和一个闭源前沿模型，发现持续存在的可信度差距。更高的检测准确率往往伴随更大的人口群体差异，模型经常顺从隐瞒或夸大提示，对错误预测给出高置信度，很少将模棱两可的案例升级处理，并难以区分仇恨言论与反驳言论或 reclaimed language（尤其在 8B 参数以下的模型中）。扩大规模并不能一致地解决这些问题，且没有任何单一模型在全部五个维度上表现卓越。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 在社交媒体内容审核中可信度评估不足的问题，构建了跨八个数据集、覆盖五个可信度维度的基准 TrustMod-SM，并对多种开源和闭源模型进行系统评估。

papers.title: StatPrompt-LLM: A Lightweight Statistical Refinement for Foundation-Style Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Time-series forecasting has recently seen a paradigm shift with the introduction of foundation-style models that adapt large pretrained language architectures to sequential data. However, effectively exposing fundamental temporal structures, such as trend, scale, and temporal dependence, to these models remains an open challenge, particularly when the available observations are limited. In this paper, we conduct an exploratory empirical study across different generations of forecasting architectures and propose StatPrompt-LLM, a lightweight statistical refinement of Time-LLM. StatPrompt-LLM augments the existing Time-LLM prompting mechanism with dataset-level statistical information and introduces a zero-initialised autoregressive bypass as a complementary linear forecasting pathway. We evaluate our framework on electricity and meteorological time-series benchmarks, including ETTh1, ETTh2, and Weather, under full-prefix and reduced-prefix configurations. Under the 10% reduced-prefix configuration, StatPrompt-LLM achieved lower in-sample prediction errors than Time-LLM, with unweighted average relative reductions across datasets of 40.2% in MSE and 21.4% in MAE. Full-prefix results were more dataset-dependent. Ablation analyses revealed relatively modest and dataset-dependent changes when selected additional statistical descriptor groups were masked within the combined architecture. Computational profiling indicated additional model parameters and runtime overhead relative to Time-LLM.

translation.title: StatPrompt-LLM：面向基础模型风格时间序列预测的轻量级统计增强
translation.abstract: 时间序列预测最近因基础模型风格方法的引入而经历了范式转变，这类方法将大型预训练语言架构适配到序列数据上。然而，如何有效地向这些模型暴露基本的时序结构——如趋势、尺度和时间依赖性——仍是一个开放挑战，尤其在可用观测数据有限时。本文对不同代际的预测架构进行了探索性实证研究，并提出 StatPrompt-LLM，即对 Time-LLM 的一种轻量级统计增强。StatPrompt-LLM 用数据集级统计信息增强现有的 Time-LLM 提示机制，并引入零初始化的自回归旁路作为补充的线性预测路径。我们在电力和气象时间序列基准（包括 ETTh1、ETTh2 和 Weather）上，在完整前缀和缩减前缀配置下评估了该框架。在 10% 缩减前缀配置下，StatPrompt-LLM 的样本内预测误差低于 Time-LLM，各数据集上 MSE 的未加权平均相对降幅为 40.2%，MAE 为 21.4%。完整前缀的结果更依赖数据集。消融分析显示，在组合架构中屏蔽选定的额外统计描述符组时变化相对有限且依赖数据集。计算剖析表明，相对于 Time-LLM 存在额外的模型参数和运行时开销。
translation.brief: 该论文解决基础模型风格时序预测难以有效利用趋势、尺度等基本时序结构的问题，提出 StatPrompt-LLM，通过在 Time-LLM 提示中注入数据集级统计信息并加入零初始化自回归旁路来增强预测。

papers.title: ICLayout-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Custom Circuit Layout Design
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are being explored for circuit design, but their ability to produce high-quality custom layouts has not been extensively evaluated. ICLayout-Bench is a benchmark in which agents use electronic design automation (EDA) tools to construct and optimize GDSII layouts from transistor-level circuit netlists. These layouts are evaluated using physical verification, parasitic extraction, and post-layout simulation. Layouts that pass the physical and functional checks are scored on electrical performance and area. The benchmark includes 165 tasks across 13 process design kits (PDKs), covering technology nodes from 3 nm to 180 nm. The tasks span analog, mixed-signal, and digital circuits in open-source and commercial EDA flows. The experiments evaluate 22 configurations spanning seven models on 21 public and 19 private tasks. Mean layout scores range from 4.22 to 80.26 on public tasks and from 1.43 to 67.01 on private tasks, on a 100-point scale. Higher reasoning effort does not consistently improve mean scores, and configurations with comparable scores can incur substantially different model costs.

translation.title: ICLayout-Bench：面向定制电路版图设计的 LLM Agent 基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent 正被探索用于电路设计，但其生成高质量定制版图的能力尚未得到广泛评估。ICLayout-Bench 是一个基准，其中 Agent 使用电子设计自动化（EDA）工具从晶体管级电路网表构建和优化 GDSII 版图。这些版图通过物理验证、寄生提取和后版图仿真进行评估。通过物理和功能检查的版图将按电气性能和面积打分。该基准包含跨 13 个工艺设计套件（PDK）的 165 个任务，覆盖 3 nm 至 180 nm 的工艺节点。任务涵盖模拟、混合信号和数字电路，涉及开源和商业 EDA 流程。实验在 21 个公开任务和 19 个私有任务上评估了七种模型的 22 种配置。在满分 100 分下，公开任务的平均版图得分范围为 4.22 到 80.26，私有任务为 1.43 到 67.01。更高的推理投入并不能持续提高平均得分，得分相近的配置可能产生差异巨大的模型成本。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM Agent 生成定制电路版图能力缺乏评估的问题，构建 ICLayout-Bench，要求 Agent 使用 EDA 工具从晶体管级网表构建 GDSII 版图，并通过物理验证、寄生提取和后版图仿真打分。

papers.title: Multimodal Graph Learning: A Survey of Models, Benchmarks, and Frontiers
papers.abstract: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs), in which nodes carry text, images, and other modalities while edges encode relations among entities, underlie e-commerce, social media, content platforms, and creative applications. Learning on MAGs has developed along two complementary lines: graph-centric methods redesign how modalities are fused, propagated, and connected within message passing, while foundation-model-centric methods pretrain transferable multimodal graph encoders or bring graph context into multimodal large language models for prediction and generation. In parallel, several benchmarks have appeared with different datasets and evaluation protocols. This survey takes an algorithm-centric and evaluation-grounded view of the field and makes three contributions. Modeling: we introduce a unified message-passing formulation and organize methods into five integration levels (feature, propagation, topology, learning, and foundation model), covering discriminative and graph-conditioned generative models; within this formulation we derive representative methods as special cases, compare their assumptions, expressiveness, and cost, and identify cross-modal sensitivity as a property that separates otherwise similar architectures. Datasets and evaluation: we review recent benchmarks, summarize their datasets and metrics, define model-independent descriptors (label homophily, average degree, clustering, and edge provenance), and map each evaluation protocol to the baselines it uses. Frontiers: we connect multimodal graph learning to AI agents, covering the multimodal graphs that agents perceive and remember and graph engineering, the practice of organizing agent workflows as explicit graphs; we then discuss open problems, concrete efforts for the community, and research directions, including when graph structure helps in the presence of strong multimodal foundation models.

translation.title: 多模态图学习：模型、基准与前沿综述
translation.abstract: 多模态属性图（MAG）中，节点携带文本、图像和其他模态，边编码实体间的关系，是电子商务、社交媒体、内容平台和创意应用的基础。MAG 上的学习沿两条互补路线发展：以图为中心的方法重新设计模态在消息传递中的融合、传播和连接方式，而以基础模型为中心的方法预训练可迁移的多模态图编码器，或将图上下文引入多模态大语言模型以进行预测和生成。与此同时，出现了多个采用不同数据集和评估协议的基准。本综述以算法为中心、以评估为立足点审视该领域，并做出三项贡献。建模方面：我们提出统一的消息传递形式化，将方法组织为五个集成层次（特征、传播、拓扑、学习和基础模型），涵盖判别式和图条件生成模型；在此形式化下，我们将代表性方法推导为特例，比较其假设、表达能力和代价，并识别跨模态敏感性作为区分其他方面相似架构的性质。数据集与评估方面：我们回顾近期基准，总结其数据集和指标，定义模型无关的描述符（标签同质性、平均度、聚类和边来源），并将每个评估协议映射到其使用的基线。前沿方面：我们将多模态图学习与 AI Agent 联系起来，涵盖 Agent 感知和记忆的多模态图以及图工程——将 Agent 工作流组织为显式图的实践；随后讨论开放问题、社区的具体行动和研究方向，包括在强大多模态基础模型存在时图结构何时有帮助。
translation.brief: 该综述系统梳理多模态属性图学习领域，提出统一消息传递形式化并按五个集成层次组织方法，同时总结基准与评估协议，并展望与 AI Agent 结合的前沿方向。

papers.title: Capacity Allocation at the Source: Sparse Target Optimization for LLM Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract: Knowledge editing has emerged as a promising approach for efficiently updating embedded knowledge in large language models (LLMs). It first computes an ideal target hidden state that steers the LLM toward the new output, and then edits the model parameters so that the original hidden state is mapped to this target. While most existing methods focus on the second stage of parameter editing in preserving other knowledge, we find that the upstream construction of the target hidden state also plays an important role in allocating the model's limited capacity space. We first establish a theoretical connection between interference in the parameter space and interference between target hidden states, showing that the two are positively correlated. Building on this insight, we propose a simple yet effective $\ell_1$ regularization method that prunes away unnecessary ``tentacles'' of each knowledge vector, retaining only the essential components. With fewer extraneous tentacles, each edit affects less other knowledge, enabling better coexistence. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of our method. Code: this https URL.

translation.title: 源头上的容量分配：面向大语言模型知识编辑的稀疏目标优化
translation.abstract: 知识编辑是高效更新大语言模型（LLM）内嵌知识的一种有前景的方法。它首先计算一个引导 LLM 产生新输出的理想目标隐藏状态，然后编辑模型参数使原隐藏状态映射到该目标。现有方法大多关注第二阶段参数编辑中对其他知识的保护，而我们发现上游的目标隐藏状态构建在分配模型有限容量空间方面同样起着重要作用。我们首先建立了参数空间中的干扰与目标隐藏状态之间的干扰之间的理论联系，证明二者正相关。基于这一洞察，我们提出一种简单有效的 ℓ1 正则化方法，剪除每个知识向量不必要的"触角"，仅保留必要成分。多余的触角更少，每次编辑对其他知识的影响就更小，从而实现更好的共存。在多个 LLM 和基准数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。代码：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对知识编辑中编辑间相互干扰的问题，通过建立目标隐藏状态干扰与参数干扰的正相关关系，提出用 ℓ1 正则化稀疏化知识向量以减少编辑间的负面影响。

papers.title: Linear Probes to Bayesian Manifolds: Geometry of Arithmetic in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Linear probes are a standard method to study geometric structures, such as helices and circles, from the activations of large language models (LLMs), and such structure is often taken as evidence that the model computes with it. Probe accuracy alone cannot establish this, because it conflates four separate claims. These are (1) that the concept is decodable from the activations, (2) that they form a specific shape, (3) that the shape belongs to the probed concept rather than to a related concept the model also represents, and (4) that the output of the model depends on the shape. We call these claims decodability, shape, ownership, and causal use, and we test them separately with a four-stage Bayesian pipeline. Stage 2 compares candidate shapes and selects the best one only when its evidence passes a predefined threshold. Stage 3 removes a set of related concepts, specified in advance, and tests whether the shape is owned or inherited. Stage 4 intervenes on the shape to test whether the output of the model depends on it. We apply the pipeline to two-digit addition and multiplication in GPT-J 6B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Pythia 6.9B. Nearly every concept is decodable, but the decoded directions overlap substantially across concepts. Every strongly supported comparison selects a ribbon, which is a helix whose radius changes with the value, or a torus. Of 1,330 cells with an ownership verdict, 19% of shapes are owned and 81% are inherited. Owned and inherited shapes move the output about equally often. Intervening on the shape retains approximately 61% of the effect of intervening on the full probe while using at most five dimensions, against a median of nine for the probe. Our results indicate that a probe verdict alone overstates what a model computes with, and we propose that probe results be reported as verdicts on all four claims rather than as a single accuracy.

translation.title: 从线性探针到贝叶斯流形：大语言模型中算术运算的几何结构
translation.abstract: 线性探针是研究大语言模型（LLM）激活中几何结构（如螺旋和圆）的标准方法，这种结构常被视为模型在利用它进行计算的依据。仅凭探针准确率无法确立这一点，因为它混淆了四个独立的命题：(1) 该概念可以从激活中解码出来，(2) 它们构成特定形状，(3) 该形状属于被探测的概念而非模型同时表征的某个相关概念，(4) 模型的输出依赖于该形状。我们称之为可解码性、形状、归属和因果使用，并用一个四阶段贝叶斯流水线分别检验它们。第二阶段比较候选形状，仅当证据超过预定阈值时才选出最优形状。第三阶段移除一组预先指定的相关概念，检验形状是自有还是继承的。第四阶段对形状进行干预，检验模型输出是否依赖于它。我们将该流水线应用于 GPT-J 6B、Llama 3.1 8B 和 Pythia 6.9B 上的两位数加法和乘法。几乎所有概念都可解码，但解码出的方向在不同概念间大量重叠。每一个获得强支持的比较都选出带状体（半径随数值变化的螺旋）或环面。在 1,330 个做出归属判定的单元中，19% 的形状是自有的，81% 是继承的。自有形状和继承形状移动输出的频率大致相当。对形状进行干预最多使用五个维度（探针中位数为九维）即可保留对完整探针进行干预效果的约 61%。我们的结果表明，仅凭探针判定会夸大模型实际计算所依赖的内容，我们建议将探针结果报告为对全部四个命题的判定，而非单一的准确率。
translation.brief: 针对线性探针准确率混淆四个不同命题的问题，提出一个四阶段贝叶斯流水线分别检验可解码性、形状、归属和因果使用，并将其应用于大语言模型的算术几何分析。

papers.title: Branch-and-Commit for Frozen RL Agents: When and Where to Spend Test-Time Compute
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning agents are often deployed with policies that cannot be retrained or modified. In digital environments whose states can be copied and resumed, an operator has another option: sample several continuations from the current state, evaluate them, and continue from the endpoint of the selected branch. We call this procedure branch-and-commit. We study when it improves return, what produces the improvement, and where its computational budget should be spent. Across four environments, two frozen policies, five continuation verifiers, and a model-free selection rule, we find that the benefit of branching depends on dispersion: the difference between the best candidate return and the mean candidate return. Branching provides no benefit in low-dispersion settings, while increasing return by 12.8% in our main Craftax-Medium setting. Most of this gain comes not from selecting better actions, but from selecting among different stochastic realizations of the same action. Several competent verifiers achieve similar episode returns, suggesting that verifier quality is not the main constraint at our operating budget. Instead, computation is better allocated to states where useful dispersion is likely. On held-out seeds, gating branching using predicted dispersion retains 69% of the improvement from uniform branching while using 48% as many branching calls. These results characterize when branch-and-commit is useful and clarify what its gains represent.

translation.title: 冻结 RL 智能体的分支-提交策略：何时何地花费测试时计算
translation.abstract: 强化学习智能体部署的策略往往无法重新训练或修改。在状态可被复制和恢复的数字环境中，操作者还有另一种选择：从当前状态采样多个后续轨迹，评估它们，并从所选分支的终点继续执行。我们将此过程称为分支-提交（branch-and-commit）。我们研究它何时能提升回报、收益由何产生，以及其计算预算应花在哪里。在四个环境、两个冻结策略、五个后续验证器和一个无模型选择规则上的实验发现，分支的收益取决于离散度：最佳候选回报与候选平均回报之差。在低离散度环境中分支没有收益，而在我们主要的 Craftax-Medium 设置中可将回报提高 12.8%。这一收益大部分并非来自选择更好的动作，而是来自在同一动作的不同随机实现中进行选择。多个能力相当的验证器取得相似的回合回报，表明在我们的运行预算下验证器质量不是主要约束。相反，计算更应分配给可能产生有用离散度的状态。在保留种子上，使用预测离散度对分支进行门控，仅用 48% 的分支调用次数就保留了均匀分支 69% 的改进。这些结果刻画了分支-提交何时有用，并阐明其收益的本质。
translation.brief: 针对无法重训练的冻结 RL 智能体如何利用测试时计算提升回报的问题，提出分支-提交过程，并证明其收益取决于候选回报离散度，可用预测离散度门控来高效分配计算。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Believing: Counterfactual Lesion Erasure Teaches a Small Medical Vision-Language Agent to Report Only What the Image Shows
papers.abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) often report a finding because the question names it; standard benchmarks miss this. From public segmentation datasets we build counterfactual views without manual annotation: the lesion erased by inpainting, a same-shape control edit elsewhere, and unedited lesion-free images. The evidence sensitivity gap (ESG) is the rate of absent-or-refer answers after erasure minus the rate after the control edit; it is zero for a model that ignores the image or reacts to both edits alike. MedScope-4B (Qwen3.5-4B, LoRA, image tools) was trained on label-derived trajectories, selected by a pre-registered rule and tested once against nine frontier and six open VLMs; four pre-registered checks then probed the mechanism. On 507 internal cases across five imaging types, MedScope-4B reached ESG 0.758 and claimed an erased lesion in 9.6% of cases, against 0.27-0.47 and 41-62% for the frontier models (all p<0.001), without significant loss of accuracy on real lesions. Without counterfactual views ESG fell to 0.279+-0.107 (three seeds); the effect replicated on MedGemma 1.5 4B and two unseen inpainting tools. At four external centres the advantage held but frontier models detected more real lesions; on a fresh external test MedScope-4B detected 0 of 48 pneumothorax films, with net utility below gemini-4-argon's (-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]). Matching the control edit was not shown to matter; over three seeds no fresh-external ESG advantage over removal-based DPO was established; a paired-view consistency objective did not beat a matched-compute control, while that continuation alone cut erased-lesion claims on unseen tools at every seed, at a cost in sensitivity at one. Training on erased and edited images gives a small model an evidence-gated disposition that prompting does not give frontier models; it does not improve perception, and rare critical findings need coverage.

translation.title: 看见不等于相信：反事实病灶擦除教会小型医学视觉-语言智能体只报告图像所显示的内容
translation.abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）常常因为问题中提到某个发现才去报告它，而标准基准忽略了这一点。我们从公开分割数据集构建反事实视图，无需人工标注：通过修复擦除病灶的图像、在别处进行同形状对照编辑的图像，以及未编辑的无病灶图像。证据敏感度差距（ESG）定义为擦除后"缺失或提及不存在"回答率减去对照编辑后的回答率；对忽略图像或对两种编辑反应相同的模型，该值为零。MedScope-4B（基于 Qwen3.5-4B，LoRA，带图像工具）在标签衍生的轨迹上训练，按预注册规则选择并一次性与九个前沿模型和六个开源 VLM 测试比较；随后通过四项预注册检查探究其机制。在涵盖五种影像类型的 507 例内部病例上，MedScope-4B 达到 ESG 0.758，虚假报告被擦除病灶的比例为 9.6%，而前沿模型分别为 0.27-0.47 和 41-62%（均 p<0.001），且在真实病灶上的准确率无显著损失。没有反事实视图时 ESG 降至 0.279±0.107（三个种子）；该效应在 MedGemma 1.5 4B 和两种未见过的修复工具上得到复现。在四个外部中心该优势依然保持，但前沿模型检出了更多真实病灶；在新的外部测试中 MedScope-4B 在 48 张气胸片上检出 0 例，净效用低于 gemini-4-argon（-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]）。与对照编辑匹配是否重要未得到证实；三个种子上未能确立相比基于移除的 DPO 在新外部 ESG 上的优势；成对视图一致性目标未优于等算力对照，但该延续本身在每个种子上都减少了在未见工具上的擦除病灶误报，代价是在其中一种上敏感度降低。在擦除和编辑后的图像上训练能让小模型获得提示词无法赋予前沿模型的证据门控倾向；它并不能提升感知能力，且罕见的关键发现需要覆盖。
translation.brief: 针对医学 VLM 因问题提示而虚构报告发现的问题，利用修复擦除构建反事实训练图像，训练小模型形成只依据图像证据作答的倾向。

papers.title: Just AI Governance and the Forbidden-Boundary Principle
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly shapes consequential decisions, yet predictive accuracy is not a sufficient justification for delegated authority. This conceptual study develops an integrated framework for assessing just AI across normative, data, model, and governance layers. Drawing on plural theories of justice, sociotechnical fairness research, and publicly available governance standards, it maps six justice requirements to observable evidence, decision rights, and remedies. It proposes a two-stage evaluation rule: exclude uses that fail independently justified minimum rights constraints, then compare eligible alternatives across multiple performance and governance criteria. As an explicitly limited normative analogy, Genesis chapter 2 motivates a Forbidden-Boundary Principle (FBP), under which an AI agent must not execute externally consequential actions outside pre-authorized boundaries. The resulting First-Principle Safe-Stop Protocol (FPSSP) comprises an independently governed policy monitor, a mandatory execution gate, a restricted or alternative safe-state controller, immutable-oriented audit trails, and accountable human authorization for recovery. We distinguish this normative and traceability contribution from existing Simplex and runtime assurance architectures; we do not claim a novel safety switch or formal proof of universal ethical compliance. A policy schema, threat model, test matrix, outcome definitions, and a prospective comparison design make the proposal falsifiable. No FPSSP implementation, experimental dataset, numerical improvement, or verified latency bound is reported. The framework supports future evaluation rather than constituting evidence of operational safety.

translation.title: 公正的 AI 治理与禁止边界原则
translation.abstract: 人工智能（AI）日益影响重大决策，然而预测准确率不足以作为委托其权威的充分理由。本研究为评估跨规范、数据、模型和治理各层的公正 AI 提出一个整合框架。借鉴多元正义理论、社会技术公平研究和公开可用的治理标准，它将六项正义要求映射到可观察证据、决策权和救济措施。它提出一个两阶段评估规则：先排除未能满足经独立论证的最低权利约束的用途，再在合格备选方案间按多项性能和治理标准进行比较。作为明确限定的规范性类比，《创世记》第二章引出禁止边界原则（FBP）：AI 智能体不得在预先授权边界之外执行具有外部后果的行动。由此得出第一性原理安全停止协议（FPSSP），包含独立治理的策略监控器、强制执行门、受限或替代的安全状态控制器、面向不可变的审计日志以及负责恢复的问责式人工授权。我们区分了这一规范与可追溯性贡献与现有 Simplex 和运行时保障架构的区别；我们不声称提出新颖的安全开关或普遍伦理合规的形式化证明。策略模式、威胁模型、测试矩阵、结果定义和前瞻性比较设计使该提案可被证伪。本报告未包含 FPSSP 的实现、实验数据集、数值改进或验证的时延界。该框架支持未来评估，而非构成运营安全的证据。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 受托决策缺乏充分正义论证的问题，提出跨规范、数据、模型和治理层的公正 AI 评估框架及禁止边界原则与第一性原理安全停止协议。

papers.title: Compile-Gated Lean Proof Refactoring with Enterprise Agent Practices: A Model per Step under a US\$3 Cap, Followed by Programmatic Rewrite Rules
papers.abstract: Our closed-track entry (Arena username Vexorium-Agent) scored 86.31 points on the final board (L = 77.07, H = 81.86, Z = 100) over the 60 final problems, against 33.33 for the reference proofs, 8th at the deadline (top: 92.57), for US\$166.33 at list prices with every call counted (per problem: mean US\$2.772, at most US\$2.874; US\$3 cap). Three practices carry the entry. First, each paid stage runs the model that measured best per dollar for it among the 9 we tested in our own harness: GPT-6.1 Sol the early sessions, GPT-6.1 Terra the later ones and the tail at 70% of Sol's cost per turn, and Gemini 4 Argon the review and repair; Sol also runs the style rewrite. Second, what our development and research runs learned ships as compiler-checked programmatic rewrite rules rather than prompt text (+0.93 points from rules fixed before the release; +0.26 and +0.30, in sample, from passes built or switched on after the release). Third, every call is recorded and reviewed before each change (all 9 board scores came within -0.063 to +0.015 points of our meter's prediction). The harness, gate and many of these rules also serve our open-track entry. We report the full bill and the spread of three runs.

papers.title: khammoon: From a Linguistic Guideline to a Thai Morpheme Segmenter
papers.abstract: Thai is written without spaces between words, making segmentation a foundational step in most Thai NLP pipelines. Existing tools primarily reproduce the word-level conventions of corpora such as BEST; however, because the notion of a "word" in Thai lacks a unified linguistic consensus, these conventions struggle with productive compounding, leading to arbitrary boundaries and ambiguity in downstream representations. Instead, we propose operating at the morphological level, focusing on khammoon, the smallest atomic unit that carries meaning. Segmenting at the morphemic level provides an explicit, consistent morphological representation that eliminates compounding ambiguity. Crucially, this representation benefits downstream learning: models trained on morphemes perform on par with or exceed word-level baselines across part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, and sentiment classification, demonstrating that linguistic consistency improves representation quality without downstream performance penalty. To operationalize this representation, we translate linguistic principles into a formal decision guideline with near-perfect human agreement ($\kappa \approx 0.99$), scale annotation with an LLM, and correct systematic errors with human labels. Finally, we train khammoon, a lightweight 1M-parameter convolutional BiLSTM segmenter designed for efficient CPU inference, achieving a boundary F1 of 0.992 on out-of-domain text. The guideline, datasets, model, and library are all publicly released.

papers.title: FaST: Factored Synthesis of Transitions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Synthetic data augmentation promises to scale offline reinforcement learning beyond fixed logged datasets, but leading diffusion-based generators model the transition tuple (state, action, next state, reward, terminal) as a monolith: no single factor can be natively redrawn in isolation. We present FaST (Factored Synthesis of Transitions), which factors transitions via the chain rule into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, fitting each with an estimator matched to its statistical properties. Across twelve D4RL locomotion and maze benchmarks, TD3+BC and IQL agents trained on FaST transitions match the SynthER diffusion baseline while generating transitions over 90x faster. The explicit action-given-state conditional can also be re-queried for a fixed state, enabling targeted action synthesis: drawing N candidate actions per generated state and keeping the highest-advantage one under a value function fit to the same data, thereby synthesizing improved behavior during generation rather than filtering for it post-hoc. Best-of-10 synthesis beats training on real data on 11 of 12 medium and medium-replay settings (+8.9 D4RL points on average, up to +28.4), and is competitive with advantage-filtered SynthER at a fraction of its generation cost. On expert mixtures both mechanisms degrade identically, tracing the failure to the advantage estimate itself rather than to either targeting mechanism.

papers.title: From Questions to Decisions: Benchmarking How LLM Agents Acquire Decision-Relevant Information from Human Beings
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly asked to make plans for people, such as scheduling drivers or assigning nurses. However, people's requests are often incomplete, and the supporting information for decision-making may be outdated, requiring agents to ask for clarification. Existing benchmarks typically provide fully specified problems or rely on uncalibrated LLM-simulated users, leaving this ability insufficiently tested. We introduce Ask2Decide, a benchmark of 43 planning tasks that evaluates whether agents ask for missing information that matters for their decisions. An operator holds facts absent from the agent's request and records, and optimization solvers determine which facts change the optimal plan. We also include similarly worded facts that leave the optimal plan unchanged to test whether agents distinguish useful information from irrelevant details. We collect 79 interaction sessions from 19 participants and find that, after an incorrect plan, human replies omit the correcting fact far more often than replies from an uncalibrated simulated user (43% versus 7%). Using these interactions, we calibrate a simulated operator that more closely matches human reply patterns. Evaluating four frontier LLMs, we find that their initial plans are infeasible on 58-98% of tasks when information is missing, compared with 5-28% when all facts are provided upfront. Agents uncover facts that change the optimal plan only slightly more often than facts that leave it unchanged (39-52% versus 32-41%). These results show that obtaining decision-relevant information through interaction remains a major bottleneck for LLM planning. This is ongoing work and will be updated. The date of this version is shown on the first page.

papers.title: ChipOmni: A General-Purpose AI Agent for Electronic Design Automation
papers.abstract: Electronic design automation (EDA) workflows remain highly fragmented, requiring engineers to coordinate heterogeneous representations, specialised software tools, and iterative verification across multiple design stages. Although large language models have brought more general reasoning and code-generation capabilities to EDA, many existing approaches remain focused on isolated tasks and struggle to plan, verify, and repair designs autonomously within executable engineering environments. Here we introduce ChipOmni, a knowledge-enhanced, context-evolving AI agent framework for EDA. ChipOmni integrates multimodal understanding, dynamic planning, multi-agent collaboration, and verification-driven tool interaction into a unified autonomous system. By continually incorporating feedback from external engineering tools, the framework maintains an evolving task context, integrates domain knowledge, and iteratively refines intermediate designs. Across benchmarks for analog circuit, RTL, testbench, and formal-assertion generation, ChipOmni improves multiple task-specific measures over the evaluated baselines and solves all 30 AnalogCoder-Pro tasks. In a long-horizon case study, ChipOmni advances a natural-language RISC-V specification through three design levels to a micro-SoC GDSII layout that passes physical sign-off, without human intervention after initialization. Together, these results show that ChipOmni can coordinate verification-driven design across heterogeneous tasks and sustain long-horizon engineering workflows, advancing a shift from fragmented, tool-centred processes towards agent-centred, closed-loop systems.

papers.title: GRAP: Gender Rubric-Aware Probing for Analyzing Gender Bias in LLMs
papers.abstract: As LLMs increasingly mediate everyday interactions, subtle gender biases in open-ended responses pose growing societal risks. Existing probing methods have two key limitations: they rely on fixed-format tasks, such as pronoun resolution or occupation association, that alignment-tuned models can easily handle; and they compare raw group-level rubric scores, ignoring per-dimension variance and obscuring which bias dimensions reliably distinguish gender groups. We introduce GRAP (Gender Rubric-Aware Probing), a framework that uses a lightweight logistic probe to identify the most discriminative bias dimensions from responses scored across 10 rubric dimensions, operating task-agnostically on open-ended instruction following.

papers.title: Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agentic Software Development
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application's UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. Because they are generated from the available repository rather than requiring a known bug-free version, they can be produced automatically for reproducible application states without manual image annotation. We evaluate the approach on a controlled benchmark derived from SWE-bench Multimodal by injecting visual UI bugs into a real web application. We vary screenshot degradation and reference-image provision and measure whether the coding agent identifies the correct source file. The results show that reference images improve file localization especially for degraded image quality, increasing the gold file match rate under fourfold downsampling with JPEG compression. We confirmed with further analysis that the proposed approach recognizes text approximately 12 percentage points better than language biased OCR under the same degradation.

papers.title: GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.

papers.title: Code-Grounded Agentic Explanations for Static Analysis Vulnerability Findings
papers.abstract: Static application security testing (SAST) tools surface vulnerabilities early and their verdicts are rule-based and auditable. Yet developers routinely dismiss findings they cannot interpret. Large language models can supply the missing explanation, but designs that also hand the model the detection give up the auditability that makes static analysis defensible. We keep detection with the analyser and give the model only the explaining. A preliminary user study with 20 participants and a workshop with 19 practitioners yielded five requirements. Guided by these we redesigned SAFE, an open-source IntelliJ IDEA plugin that explains findings from any analyser reporting in the Static Analysis Results Interchange Format. It tiers explanations by demand, ties them to the reported data flow, and replaces the single-prompt backend with an agent that must consult the repository and the rule that fired before answering. A within-subjects crossover experiment with 24 participants compared the redesign against its predecessor. Perceived usability rose from 77.3 to 85.0 on the System Usability Scale. Actionability gained most among the explanation-quality items, the aspect both earlier studies flagged as weakest, and the odds of a correct remediation were 2.6 times higher. Triage accuracy and time per finding were indistinguishable, which we read as uninformative rather than as equivalence. Trust was the one measure that did not move, and the closing interviews indicate that grounding made findings easier to understand rather than easier to believe. Participants also drew a boundary no requirement anticipated, wanting the tool to find and explain while they judge and apply.

Triage accuracy and time per finding were indistinguishable, which we read as uninformative rather than as equivalence. Trust was the one measure that did not move, and the closing interviews indicate that grounding made findings easier to understand rather than easier to believe. Participants also drew a boundary no requirement anticipated, wanting the tool to find and explain while they judge and apply.

papers.title: Trust, but verify, audit and attribute: a human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced research results
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems now produce research results in bulk: in October 2026 a single laboratory released more than 700 AI-generated mathematics manuscripts, only part of them with machine-checked proofs. Such volumes will be checked mostly by AI agents that call specialised software. A passing check certifies only the artefact that was checked. For proofs translated into the proof assistant Lean, it has been shown that this artefact may state something other than the author's text, and that deciding whether a translation is faithful is undecidable in general. The human researcher therefore stays in the loop, and human and AI contributions must be recorded. We propose a domain-independent, human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced results. Validated, agent-usable tools with different grounds of trust check the results; a fidelity audit asks whether each check addressed the claim as stated; the human decides at fixed points; and a dialog report attributes the work to the human and to the AI. We describe two automatic implementations of the tool layer, for mathematics (Wolfram Language, MATLAB, Lean) and statistics (Python and R), and run the mathematical one on a two-claim example. An ambiguous claim was split into two readings, one refuted and one proved.
