papers.title: The Gene Is Not the Gate: Conceptualizing the Semantic Genome of Quantum Software
papers.abstract: Quantum software spans applications, program representations, compilers, runtimes, and hardware-facing control. Existing abstractions describe these artifacts and layers, but they do not capture the semantic responsibilities that must remain valid as a computation is transformed across the stack. This limits systematic reasoning about cross-layer correctness, evolution, and reuse. We present QGenome, a semantic foundation for quantum software genomics. We define a quantum software gene as a typed, reusable responsibility characterized by an explicit contract, execution context, concrete expressions, and supporting evidence. QGenome organizes genes across five software strata and ten responsibility families grouped into computational semantics, coordination, realization, and assurance. Typed genes compose into pathways and genomes through dependency, refinement, provenance, and phenotype relations, enabling responsibilities to be traced across alternative implementations and execution contexts. We illustrate the taxonomy using representative public artifacts across the quantum software stack and define principles for contextual validity, genome evolution, environmental adaptation, and capability expression. Rather than presenting a complete taxonomy or an automated extraction technique, QGenome establishes a falsifiable framework and a concrete research agenda for gene mining, lineage recovery, cross-layer regression testing and repair, and evidence-grounded quantum software agents.

translation.title: 基因并非闸门：量子软件语义基因组的构想
translation.abstract: 量子软件涵盖应用、程序表示、编译器、运行时和面向硬件的控制。现有抽象描述了这些制品与层次，但未能捕捉在计算跨栈变换时必须保持有效的语义职责，这限制了对跨层正确性、演化和复用的系统化推理。我们提出 QGenome，一个量子软件基因组学的语义基础。我们将量子软件基因定义为一种有类型的、可复用的职责，由显式契约、执行上下文、具体表达和支持证据刻画。QGenome 将基因组织在五个软件层级和十个职责族中，归入计算语义、协调、实现和保障四类。有类型的基因通过依赖、精化、来源和表型关系组合成通路与基因组，使职责能够在不同实现和执行上下文之间被追踪。我们用量子软件栈中的代表性公开制品展示该分类法，并定义了上下文有效性、基因组演化、环境适应和能力表达的原则。QGenome 并非完整的分类法或自动化抽取技术，而是建立一个可证伪的框架和具体的研究议程，涵盖基因挖掘、谱系恢复、跨层回归测试与修复，以及基于证据的量子软件智能体。
translation.brief: 为解决量子软件跨层语义职责难以追踪的问题，提出 QGenome 框架，将软件职责建模为可组合、可追溯的有类型“基因”。

papers.title: Beyond the Document: Compiled Context and Governed Agents for Any Work Product
papers.abstract: A document preserves the visible result of professional work but often discards the research, calculations, assumptions, evidence, and authorization boundaries behind it. We study a different unit of delivery: a Portable Agent Format (PAF) package that carries a work product together with compiled context, evidence, provenance, and rules for subsequent interaction. To test whether this context remains useful beyond the process that produced it, we evaluate four new packages, created after the hosted and offline readers were fixed: an investment proposal, fund research, financial-statement analysis, and an engineering incident review. Two packages were produced by specialized agents and two through a general-purpose assistant's packaging skill. Across 400 frozen questions and 12,000 evaluated responses, a hosted governed reader succeeds on 96% of questions versus 86% with instructions plus raw-file retrieval (Holm-adjusted p < 10^-7). On the 260 answerable questions per condition, success is 94% versus 79%; the gap varies by package. Source-material chat and instructions alone reach 48% and 74% overall. A separate 0.8-billion-parameter offline reader succeeds on 69% overall, but 54% on answerable questions. Its -1 response rate is 2.9%, combining materially wrong and unauthorized answers, versus 56% with the source and instructions alone. Ablations suggest advantages for the integrated selector and package-adapted writer, without isolating representation from training effects. The same run exposes a failure: offline retrieval resolves none of the 40 historical-record questions in one financial-data package. These findings support treating compiled knowledge as part of the delivered work product, while leaving independent standards interoperability and end-to-end governance conformance unproven.

translation.title: 超越文档：面向任意工作成果的编译上下文与受治理智能体
translation.abstract: 文档只保存专业工作的可见结果，却往往丢失其背后的研究、计算、假设、证据和授权边界。我们研究另一种交付单元：便携智能体格式（PAF）包，它将工作成果与编译后的上下文、证据、来源和后续交互规则一并携带。为检验这些上下文在产生它的过程之外是否仍然有用，我们评估了四个新包（在托管和离线阅读器固定之后创建）：投资提案、基金研究、财务报表分析和工程事故复盘，其中两个由专用智能体生成，两个通过通用助手的打包技能生成。在 400 个冻结问题和 12,000 条被评估回答上，托管受治理阅读器在 96% 的问题上成功，而指令加原始文件检索仅为 86%（Holm 校正 p < 10^-7）。在每种条件下 260 个可回答的问题上，成功率为 94% 对 79%；差距随包而异。仅靠源材料对话和指令分别总体达到 48% 和 74%。一个独立的 0.8B 参数离线阅读器总体成功率为 69%，但在可回答问题上为 54%。其 -1 响应率（实质性错误回答与未授权回答合并）为 2.9%，而仅用源材料和指令时为 56%。消融实验显示集成选择器和包适配写作器的优势，但未能将表示与训练效应分离。同一次运行也暴露了一个失败：离线检索在某个金融数据包的 40 个历史记录问题上无一成功。这些发现支持将编译知识视为交付工作成果的一部分，但独立的标准互操作性和端到端治理一致性尚未得到证明。
translation.brief: 为解决文档丢失工作过程上下文的问题，提出携带编译上下文与治理规则的 PAF 交付包，并以多领域问答评估验证其有效性。

papers.title: Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted with mathematical, scientific and engineering work, yet their mistakes are often confidently written and hard to spot. A single wrong step tends to propagate, making the model waste inference tokens following a false premise. Existing safeguards either check only the final answer and restart from scratch, or rely on a verifier LLM that competes for GPU capacity and slows down response time. We propose online, deterministic verification: many kinds of reasoning steps can be validated by code, so a step can be verified in real time, as it is written, without any model call or GPU use. Whenever a check fails, we point out the mistake and let the model continue from the same spot. We demonstrate this approach on symbolic mathematics, where derivations already contain explicit expressions that a computer algebra system can check in milliseconds. Tested on the ASyMoB benchmark with three open-weights models, our online validation improves accuracy by 1.4-5.6 percentage points, corresponding to a 1.8-14.9% net reduction in incorrect answers, while increasing token usage by only 6-7%. Because the verifier is independent of the model, the approach complements progress in LLMs rather than competing with it: every new model can benefit immediately, and the benefit grows as deterministic checkers extend to more kinds of reasoning steps.

translation.title: 在哪里出错就在哪里纠正：LLM 推理过程中的实时错误纠正
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被信任承担数学、科学和工程工作，但其错误往往以自信的口吻写出且难以察觉。一个错误步骤容易传播，使模型在错误前提上浪费推理 token。现有保障机制要么只检查最终答案并从头重启，要么依赖与模型争抢 GPU 容量并拖慢响应时间的验证器 LLM。我们提出在线确定性验证：许多推理步骤可以由代码验证，因此可在步骤被写出的同时实时验证，无需任何模型调用或 GPU 使用。每当检查失败，我们指出错误并让模型从同一位置继续。我们在符号数学上演示该方法——推导已包含计算机代数系统可在毫秒内检查的显式表达式。在 ASyMoB 基准上用三个开源权重模型测试，在线验证将准确率提升 1.4–5.6 个百分点，相当于错误答案净减少 1.8–14.9%，而 token 用量仅增加 6–7%。由于验证器独立于模型，该方法与 LLM 的进步互补而非竞争：每个新模型都能立即受益，且随着确定性检查器扩展到更多推理步骤类型，收益还会增长。
translation.brief: 为解决 LLM 推理错误传播的问题，提出用代码进行逐步实时确定性验证并在出错处继续生成，而非事后重启。

papers.title: Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. This perspective makes trajectory compatibility the central criterion for reference selection in multi-turn OPD. Experiments on ALFWorld and the airline domain of $\tau^3$-bench show that LCS is the only evaluated reference selector to improve over reference-free OPD on both ALFWorld overall scores and all three airline metrics. Without further optimization, the airline-trained models also transfer to the retail domain, where LCS improves all three metrics.

translation.title: 哪些成功才是好参考？面向多轮在策略蒸馏的动作序列对齐
translation.abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生模型自身轨迹上进行监督来降低训练-推理分布失配。对于多轮工具使用智能体，以经过验证的同任务成功轨迹作为参考来条件化教师可以提供有用的事后洞察，但不同成功可能到达不兼容的交互状态并提供误导性监督。我们将成功参考的选择建模为自由目标最优传输问题，即把每条失败轨迹分配给与其最兼容的成功参考。由于潜在状态路径不可见，我们用动作序列对齐作为兼容性的可观测代理，并用最长公共子序列（LCS）实例化，它识别共享的有序动作主干，同时允许可恢复的绕行。这一视角使轨迹兼容性成为多轮 OPD 中参考选择的核心准则。在 ALFWorld 和 τ³-bench 航空领域的实验表明，LCS 是所评估参考选择器中唯一在 ALFWorld 总分和全部三项航空指标上都优于无参考 OPD 的方法。未经进一步优化，航空领域训练的模型也迁移到零售领域，LCS 同样改进了全部三项指标。
translation.brief: 为解决多轮在策略蒸馏中成功参考选择不当的问题，将参考选择建模为最优传输问题并用最长公共子序列（LCS）度量轨迹兼容性。

papers.title: Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason: Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies
papers.abstract: Failure taxonomies for LLM reasoning are increasingly reported as measurements: papers state what fraction of a model's errors fall into named categories, then compare those fractions across models. We show that for one such category the reported fraction is largely a property of the measurement procedure. We defined Compositional Collapse (a model notices a required sub-part of a problem, then drops or misapplies it) and measured it across twelve models and eleven languages on a public multilingual math benchmark (2,316 graded records). First, 50.1% of failures carry evidence for more than one category, so the reported plurality depends on the order in which the classifier tests them: reversing two tests moves it in eleven of twelve models, and across all six orderings Collapse's share spans 26.4% to 76.4%. Second, agreement collapses for the category but not for the task. Native speakers of all eleven languages judged 179 transcripts, agreeing with our inspector at kappa = 0.932 on answer correctness but only kappa = 0.093 on Collapse. A second native speaker per language re-rated 142 items; on 121 determinate pairs the two humans agree with each other at kappa = 0.659, while each agrees with the inspector at kappa <= 0.094. Re-running the same inspector model with the human instructions verbatim raises kappa against Human 2 from 0.147 to 0.636, so the gap is largely attributable to the prompt, not the model. Third, the inspector labels Collapse 1.81 times as often as native speakers, but only 1.17 times once a defective benchmark item (a deleted clause in the Bengali and Chinese translations) is excluded. We recommend four cheap checks before comparing failure-mode rates across models: report label co-occurrence, permute the tie-break, validate on a shared independent sample, and audit systematic disagreements.

translation.title: 答案一致但理由不一：LLM 推理失败分类法的测量局限
translation.abstract: LLM 推理的失败分类法越来越多地被当作测量结果报告：论文陈述模型错误落入各命名类别的比例，并在模型之间比较这些比例。我们证明，对于某一类别，所报告的比例在很大程度上是测量程序的属性。我们定义了组合崩塌（Compositional Collapse，模型注意到问题所需的子部分，随后丢弃或误用之），并在公开多语言数学基准上跨 12 个模型、11 种语言（2,316 条已评分记录）进行测量。首先，50.1% 的失败携带多个类别的证据，因此报告的多数类别取决于分类器测试它们的顺序：调换两个测试的顺序会在 12 个模型中的 11 个上改变结果，且在全部六种顺序下 Collapse 的占比在 26.4% 到 76.4% 之间。其次，一致性在该类别上崩塌，而在任务上不崩塌。11 种语言的母语者评判了 179 份记录，在答案正确性上与我们的检查员 kappa = 0.932 一致，但在 Collapse 上仅 kappa = 0.093。每种语言的第二位母语者重新评级了 142 项；在 121 个确定性配对上，两位人类之间 kappa = 0.659，而各自与检查员的一致性 kappa ≤ 0.094。用人类指令原文重跑同一检查员模型后，其与第二位人类的一致性从 0.147 升至 0.636，因此差距主要归因于提示词而非模型。第三，检查员标注 Collapse 的频率是母语者的 1.81 倍，但排除一个有缺陷的基准条目（孟加拉语和中文译文中的删除子句）后仅为 1.17 倍。我们建议在跨模型比较失败模式比例之前进行四项低成本检查：报告标签共现、置换平局裁决顺序、在共享独立样本上验证，以及审计系统性分歧。
translation.brief: 通过大规模多语言实验揭示 LLM 推理失败分类（尤其是组合崩塌）的测量结果高度依赖标注程序与提示词，并给出提高可比性的检查建议。

papers.title: DOBB: Dynamic Oriented Bounding Boxes for Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance under State Uncertainty and Heterogeneous Dynamics
papers.abstract: Learning-based decentralized collision avoidance must remain reliable under state-estimation uncertainty and heterogeneous agent dynamics. Existing methods typically address these factors through training-domain variation or by exposing uncertainty and capability estimates to the policy at runtime. However, both leave the policy to infer how these quantities should alter the physical separation required for safe interaction, which can couple collision-avoidance behavior to relationships learned from the training distribution. We introduce the Dynamic Oriented Bounding Box (DOBB), an online geometric representation that maps the current state estimate, uncertainty, and agent-specific response characteristics into a dynamic, direction-dependent safety margin. We derive geometric features that jointly characterize the relative configuration and severity of interactions between agents' DOBBs, along with a reward function that preserves the physical interpretation of those interactions. Across four evaluation environments, DOBB achieves the lowest mean total failure rate of 2.6%. This performance persists under out-of-distribution shifts in actuation dynamics and state-estimation uncertainty, with collision-based failure remaining at or below 2.3% in every tested condition. We attribute this robustness to the geometric abstraction of the safety margin, which is less coupled to the specific uncertainty and actuation regimes encountered during training.

papers.title: Teaching the Harness: Student-Aware Skill Transfer for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Effective teaching requires reasoning about the learner as well as the task, a capacity that Theory of Mind describes as inferring another agent's latent state from its behavior. We ask whether a stronger LLM teaches a fixed student better when it applies this principle. The student is an LLM agent acting through a harness that fixes its tools, context, and action budget, so a procedure that helps one model can exhaust the budget of another. We introduce Student-Aware Teaching (SAT). The teacher builds a learner model that pairs an empirical profile with hypotheses about the student's limitations, tests these hypotheses with diagnostic probes, and writes reusable skills for the diagnosed failures. A skill enters the library only after it raises success on matched development tasks. With Claude-Sonnet-5 teaching DeepSeek-V4-Flash, SAT reaches 86.46% task success across four primary runs, leading both a profile-free teacher with the same framework (81.04%) and the untaught student (75.00%) in each run. Removing the analytical learner model lowers both prediction and success, and under misleading learner profiles none of the 48 candidate skills passes admission. When DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Gemini-3.8-Flash exchange libraries, each performs better with its own. Saved libraries keep average gains of up to 11.1 points after the teacher leaves. The benefit depends on a student that can follow instructions and a deployment route that delivers them.

papers.title: High Probability Risk Control for Online Policy Learning
papers.abstract: We study risk control for online policy learning, where an agent adaptively collects data and aims to learn a new policy whose risk stays below a tolerance threshold at every round with high probability. Such policy updates and data collection induce feedback covariate shift (FCS): observed data depend on history through evolving policies and the data-collection process. FCS brings two substantive problems for risk control: 1) efficient risk evaluation for each candidate policy and 2) valid policy selection with high-probability risk control. To address these, we propose a permutation-based weighted risk evaluator with weights efficiently approximated by the Sinkhorn algorithm and select policies whose estimated risk upper confidence bounds (UCB) fall below the target threshold, with the UCB obtained through a proposed Gaussian bootstrap method. Theoretically, we prove that our risk evaluator has a no-larger variance upper bound than that of the standard importance-weighted evaluator. Our policy control method also yields an asymptotically valid simultaneous risk bound and provides asymptotic high-probability risk control for the selected policy. Empirically, we evaluate our method on the online contextual bandit problem, safe question answering benchmark, and Medical Claim Filtering tasks. Our method maintains the target risk level, achieves lower risk than baseline methods, has lower variance in risk estimation, and achieves reliable policy selection with high-probability risk control. Further ablation studies support our theoretical claims.

papers.title: SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Per-step model routers send each LLM call of an agent to the cost-optimal model dynamically within each session. However, every model switch discards prefix-cache reuse: KV caches are per model, so the new model must prefill the relevant context before it emits a token. Across representative agentic workloads, including a production coding-agent trace with a mean context of 63K tokens, the prefix hit rate falls from 80-89% on same model calls to 44-65% after a switch, and a switch call takes 1.5-3.2x as long. We present SHADOWPREFILL, which prefills the session's context on the model the router has not chosen, in capacity that instances serving normal traffic leave idle, so the next switch finds its prefix cached. SHADOWPREFILL harvests the per-iteration SLO slack of requests in flight, protects routed calls, spills shadow KV to host memory, and falls back to a cold switch whenever the shadow is incomplete. With LLMRouter routing 24 model pairs over five agentic benchmark suites, SHADOWPREFILL cuts switch-call latency by 8.5-21.4%, LLM-call latency by 3.7-17.7%, and routed token cost by 22.5-46.1%, while normal traffic keeps its SLO and energy per request rises by 0.4%.

papers.title: GroundCascade: Selective Second Opinions for GUI Grounding
papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) grounding maps a screenshot and a natural-language instruction to the screen location where an agent should act. Zoomed views can reveal small targets but may lose the context needed to identify them. We introduce GroundCascade, a training-free controller that uses agreement between a grounder's full-screen and zoomed predictions to decide when to consult a complementary model. It selects between zoomed predictions while preserving corroborated full-screen locations. An optional Finalizer predicts from an unmarked joint crop when disagreement remains (Full); omitting it yields the two-stage Selective variant. GroundCascade reaches 85.33% on ScreenSpot-Pro with Indeed-UI-32B/8B/32B and 88.43% on the visible-target OSWorld-G-Refined subset with Qwen3.6-27B/3.8-27B/3.8-27B, gains of 2.66 and 2.35 percentage points over the stronger standalone two-pass grounder. On UI-Vision, GroundCascade reaches 72.20% category-balanced accuracy, with Selective slightly higher at 72.28%. Across these three evaluations, GroundCascade in Full mode uses 2.42-2.73 calls per request, 31-39% fewer than unconditionally acquiring both models' two-pass predictions. At matched second-model call budgets, selective acquisition gains 1.52-2.56 points over standalone Two-pass, compared with 0.22-0.69 points from stratified random acquisition. GroundCascade leads the official ScreenSpot-Pro leaderboard and exceeds reported GUI-specialist comparisons on OSWorld-G-Refined and UI-Vision, subject to differences in external evaluation protocols.

papers.title: AgentScript-Eval: Benchmarking LLMs and Agents for Code Generation in an Enterprise DSL
papers.abstract: Domain-specific languages (DSLs) are widely used in enterprise software, giving a compact interface to complex tasks, from data access to infrastructure automation. Platforms increasingly extend them to agents, where a developer declares the topics, permitted actions, and guardrails of an agent rather than writing general-purpose code. Large language models (LLMs) write general-purpose code well, but that ability has been measured almost entirely on languages abundant in public pretraining data, and enterprise DSLs are neither abundant nor public. We introduce AgentScript-Eval, an execution-graded benchmark of 100 real tasks for AgentScript, the declarative DSL that Salesforce uses in Agentforce to build conversational agents. Tasks span authoring an agent from a specification, debugging a broken definition, and optimizing a working one. Evaluating five models zero-shot, we find that the regime is hard: the best model reaches only 25.0% pass@3, and every model scores 0% on authoring from scratch. We further find that model scale and price are weak predictors of success -- a 31B open-weight model attains the highest compilation rate of any model tested (48.0%) and matches the strongest frontier model on partial-credit accuracy at the lowest token cost. Adding an agentic compile-and-edit loop is the single largest lever, roughly doubling partial-credit accuracy. Beyond that gain, the wording of domain guidance matters more than its packaging. The same skill pack scores 28% as plain documentation but only 14% as a live plugin. Rewriting one skill inside that plugin then raises it to 37%, our best result, with catalog and tooling untouched. Larger models did not reliably outperform smaller ones; what mattered was the harness surrounding the model and the guidance supplied to it.

translation.title: AgentScript-Eval：在企业级 DSL 中评测 LLM 与 Agent 的代码生成能力
translation.abstract: 领域特定语言（DSL）在企业软件中广泛使用，为从数据访问到基础设施自动化的复杂任务提供简洁接口。平台越来越多地将 DSL 扩展到 agent，开发者通过声明 agent 的主题、允许的操作和护栏来构建 agent，而非编写通用代码。大型语言模型（LLM）擅长编写通用代码，但这种能力几乎完全在公开预训练数据丰富的语言上测量，而企业 DSL 既不丰富也不公开。我们提出 AgentScript-Eval，一个针对 AgentScript 的执行评分基准，包含 100 个真实任务，AgentScript 是 Salesforce 在 Agentforce 中用于构建对话式 agent 的声明式 DSL。任务涵盖从规格说明创建 agent、调试损坏的定义以及优化可用的定义。对五个模型进行零样本评测，我们发现该领域难度很高：最好的模型仅达到 25.0% 的 pass@3，所有模型在从头创建任务上的得分均为 0%。我们进一步发现模型规模和价格是成功的弱预测指标——一个 31B 开源权重模型在所有被测模型中取得了最高的编译率（48.0%），并以最低的 token 成本在部分得分准确率上匹敌最强的前沿模型。加入 agentic 的编译-编辑循环是最大的单一杠杆，约使部分得分准确率翻倍。除此之外，领域指南的措辞比其包装形式更重要。同一 skill pack 以纯文档形式使用得分为 28%，但作为 live plugin 仅为 14%。重写该 plugin 中的一个 skill 后得分提升至 37%，这是我们最好的结果，且目录和工具均未改动。更大的模型并不可靠地优于更小的模型；真正起作用的是围绕模型的 harness 和提供给它的指南。
translation.brief: 针对企业级声明式 DSL（AgentScript）代码生成缺乏评测的问题，构建了 100 个真实任务的执行评分基准 AgentScript-Eval，并发现 agentic 编译-编辑循环和领域指南措辞是提升性能的关键杠杆。

papers.title: Prediction-Powered LLM Ranking with Adaptively Collected Human Feedback
papers.abstract: Ranking large language models (LLMs) through human evaluations is essential for downstream decision-making. Because human feedback is expensive, evaluation platforms often collect it adaptively, prioritizing informative model comparisons using previously observed feedback. To further improve precision with limited human feedback, evaluators can draw on abundant unrated responses and relatively inexpensive LLM judges; however, judge bias and adaptive dependence challenge standard i.i.d. inference frameworks. We propose Prediction-Powered Ranking (PP-Rank), a framework that combines LLM-judge predictions with human feedback to improve precision while providing valid inference under adaptive sampling. Data-driven prediction weights minimize the asymptotic covariance trace within the proposed class. In theory, we establish asymptotic normality for general evaluation targets and simultaneous ranking inference. A joint martingale analysis handles dependence between adaptive human feedback and auxiliary data. We further derive a rule for reducing exploration that prioritizes lower-cost comparisons while matching a conservative variance bound, and characterize allocation limits for regular $\sqrt{T}$-rate estimation of pairwise means. Semi-synthetic experiments on UltraFeedback-Extended show improvements over human-only baselines in score estimation, confidence interval width, and ranking certification. Synthetic experiments demonstrate robustness to judge quality and adaptive allocation, while showing that PP-Rank can substantially reduce evaluation costs without sacrificing precision.

translation.title: 基于自适应收集人类反馈的 Prediction-Powered LLM 排序
translation.abstract: 通过人类评估对大型语言模型（LLM）进行排序对下游决策至关重要。由于人类反馈成本高昂，评估平台通常采用自适应方式收集反馈，利用先前观察到的反馈优先进行信息量大的模型比较。为了在有限的人类反馈下进一步提高精度，评估者可以利用大量未评分的响应和相对便宜的 LLM judge；然而，judge 偏差和自适应依赖性挑战了标准 i.i.d. 推断框架。我们提出 Prediction-Powered Ranking（PP-Rank），一个将 LLM-judge 预测与人类反馈相结合的框架，在自适应采样下提高精度并提供有效推断。数据驱动的预测权重在所提出的类内最小化渐近协方差迹。在理论上，我们为一般评估目标和同步排序推断建立了渐近正态性。联合鞅分析处理了自适应人类反馈与辅助数据之间的依赖性。我们进一步推导了减少探索的规则，在匹配保守方差界的同时优先进行低成本比较，并刻画了成对均值以正则 $\sqrt{T}$ 速率估计的分配极限。在 UltraFeedback-Extended 上的半合成实验显示，相比仅用人类的基线，方法在分数估计、置信区间宽度和排序认证方面均有改进。合成实验证明了对 judge 质量和自适应分配的鲁棒性，并表明 PP-Rank 可以在不牺牲精度的情况下大幅降低评估成本。
translation.brief: 针对人类反馈昂贵且 LLM judge 有偏、自适应采样下推断失效的问题，提出 PP-Rank 框架，将 LLM judge 预测与人类反馈结合，在自适应采样下提供有效排序推断并降低评估成本。

papers.title: From Process Models to Composable Agentic Workflows: Combining BPMN, Agents and Enterprise Knowledge
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents can reason, use tools and collaborate. However, coordinating increasingly complex agentic applications becomes difficult to understand, monitor and improve. Decisions distributed across prompts, tool calls and application logic make workflows implicit. We introduce **Recursive Capability Composition**, enabling agents to execute business processes and expose them as reusable Agentic Tools. This paper presents a BPMN-based approach to Agentic Workflows, combining explicit orchestration with autonomous reasoning. SemTalk BPMN models are transformed into executable workflows using a LangGraph/Pregel runtime. Agentic Tasks introduce LLM reasoning at selected activities, while conventional BPMN controls process flows, deterministic decisions, system interactions and human approvals. Agentic Participants provide reusable interfaces for agent behavior or other executable processes. BPMN orchestration makes multi-agent systems more understandable and manageable. Explicit process models provide developers and operators with a shared view of workflow structures and execution progress, facilitating debugging, monitoring and optimization. Enterprise agents also need organization-specific context. Process Models and Knowledge Graphs describe activities, participants, information objects, decisions and relationships between processes. They provide structured knowledge of how an organization operates, supporting informed agent decisions and actions. Our contributions are threefold: 1. **Model-Driven Execution:** Transforming BPMN models into executable Agentic Workflows. 2. **Recursive Capability Composition:** Exposing agents and executable business processes as reusable tools for other agents. 3. **Enterprise Context:** Using Process Models and Ontologies to provide organization-specific knowledge for agent reasoning.

translation.title: 从过程模型到可组合的 Agentic 工作流：结合 BPMN、Agent 与企业知识
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的 agent 能够推理、使用工具并协作。然而，协调日益复杂的 agentic 应用变得难以理解、监控和改进。分布在 prompt、工具调用和应用逻辑中的决策使工作流变得隐式。我们提出 **Recursive Capability Composition**，使 agent 能够执行业务流程并将其暴露为可重用的 Agentic Tools。本文提出一种基于 BPMN 的 Agentic 工作流方法，将显式编排与自主推理相结合。SemTalk BPMN 模型通过 LangGraph/Pregel 运行时转换为可执行工作流。Agentic Tasks 在选定的活动上引入 LLM 推理，而传统 BPMN 控制流程、确定性决策、系统交互和人工审批。Agentic Participants 为 agent 行为或其他可执行流程提供可重用接口。BPMN 编排使多 agent 系统更易理解和管理。显式过程模型为开发者和运维人员提供工作流结构和执行进度的共享视图，便于调试、监控和优化。企业 agent 还需要组织特定的上下文。过程模型和知识图谱描述活动、参与者、信息对象、决策以及流程之间的关系。它们提供组织运作方式的结构化知识，支持 agent 做出明智的决策和行动。我们的贡献有三方面：1. **模型驱动执行：** 将 BPMN 模型转换为可执行的 Agentic 工作流。2. **递归能力组合：** 将 agent 和可执行业务流程暴露为其他 agent 可重用的工具。3. **企业上下文：** 使用过程模型和本体为 agent 推理提供组织特定知识。
translation.brief: 针对多 agent 工作流隐式难管理的问题，提出将 BPMN 过程模型转换为可执行 Agentic 工作流（基于 LangGraph/Pregel），并通过递归能力组合与知识图谱提供企业上下文。

papers.title: HiCAP: Hierarchical Cultural Adaptation via Personality for Dialogue Generation
papers.abstract: Cultural adaptation in dialogue systems refers to the ability to generate responses that conform to linguistic norms and social expectations across different cultures. However, existing dialogue generation approaches pay limited attention to the role of personality in shaping cultural expression and communication style. We therefore propose HiCAP, a novel framework that integrates personality traits into culturally adaptive dialogue generation. HiCAP employs a personality-conditioned control mechanism that hierarchically modulates response style by first aligning it with the cultural tone and then refining linguistic expression and content according to individual personality attributes. To embed these factors, the model combines supervised fine-tuning and instruction-based tuning, supported by dynamic instruction templates and multi-agent demonstrations to capture diverse combinations of culture and personality. Experiments on CulturalPersonas and CPED show that HiCAP achieves the strongest overall performance across various dialogue generation metrics, demonstrating effective cultural adaptability and personality modelling.

translation.title: HiCAP：基于个性的层次化文化适配对话生成
translation.abstract: 对话系统中的文化适配是指生成符合不同文化下语言规范和社会期望的回应的能力。然而，现有对话生成方法对个性在塑造文化表达和沟通风格中的作用关注有限。因此我们提出 HiCAP，一个将个性特质融入文化适配对话生成的新框架。HiCAP 采用个性条件控制机制，层次化地调节回应风格：首先使其与文化的语气对齐，然后根据个体个性属性精炼语言表达和内容。为了嵌入这些因素，模型结合监督微调与基于指令的微调，辅以动态指令模板和多 agent 演示来捕捉文化与个性的多样组合。在 CulturalPersonas 和 CPED 上的实验表明，HiCAP 在各项对话生成指标上均取得最强的整体性能，展示了有效的文化适配和个性建模能力。
translation.brief: 针对对话生成中文化与个性因素结合不足的问题，提出 HiCAP 框架，用个性条件控制的层次化机制先对齐文化语气再按个性精炼表达，并结合微调与指令模板训练。

papers.title: ARoute: Task-Aligned Batch and Streaming Model Routing
papers.abstract: Language models increasingly power data-intensive applications, from semantic data processing to question answering and agentic workflows. Using frontier models for every request is prohibitively expensive, while relying only on smaller models reduces accuracy. We study model routing under a user-specified cost budget, aiming to maximize accuracy under task-specific correctness criteria. Existing routers fall short in two ways: pretrained routers rely on generic preference signals that may not reflect a task's own correctness criteria or a new model pair, and model cascades run the weaker model first on every request, adding sequential latency. We present ARoute, a task-aligned router that learns cost and accuracy signals to select a model for each request before inference. ARoute has two variants: ARoute-Batch operates on a batch of requests known in advance, routing requests with the greatest expected benefit to the stronger model subject to the budget, whereas ARoute-Stream processes requests online, using a threshold calibrated on a small validation set to satisfy the cost quota and dynamically adjusting it as the budget is consumed. For ARoute-Stream, we provide a finite-sample guarantee on expected normalized spending. We evaluate ARoute on MMLU-Pro, LiveCodeBench, SuperGPQA, and two value-filling tasks built from SWAN semantic query benchmark against other state-of-the-art approaches. At matched cost, ARoute-Batch achieves the highest mean accuracy in all 15 task-cost settings, improving over the strongest baseline by 4.1 percentage points on average and by up to 11.9 points. ARoute also completes a batch up to 2.8x faster than cascades.

translation.title: ARoute：任务对齐的批处理与流式模型路由
translation.abstract: 语言模型日益支撑数据密集型应用，从语义数据处理到问答和 agentic 工作流。对每个请求都使用前沿模型成本过高，而只依赖较小模型又会降低准确率。我们研究在用户指定成本预算下的模型路由，旨在任务特定的正确性标准下最大化准确率。现有路由器存在两点不足：预训练路由器依赖可能不反映任务自身正确性标准或新模型对的通用偏好信号；而模型级联对每个请求都先运行较弱的模型，增加了顺序延迟。我们提出 ARoute，一个任务对齐的路由器，学习成本与准确率信号以在推理前为每个请求选择模型。ARoute 有两个变体：ARoute-Batch 作用于预先已知的一批请求，在预算约束下将期望收益最大的请求路由给更强的模型；而 ARoute-Stream 在线处理请求，使用在小验证集上校准的阈值来满足成本配额，并随预算消耗动态调整阈值。对于 ARoute-Stream，我们提供了期望归一化花费的有限样本保证。我们在 MMLU-Pro、LiveCodeBench、SuperGPQA 以及两个基于 SWAN 语义查询基准构建的取值填充任务上，将 ARoute 与其他最先进方法进行评估。在相同成本下，ARoute-Batch 在全部 15 个任务-成本设置中取得最高的平均准确率，相比最强基线平均提升 4.1 个百分点、最高提升 11.9 个百分点。ARoute 完成一批请求的速度最高达级联方法的 2.8 倍。
translation.brief: 针对固定成本预算下模型路由中预训练路由器信号不匹配与级联延迟高的问题，提出任务对齐的 ARoute，通过学习成本与准确率信号在推理前选模型，提供批处理与流式两个变体。

papers.title: Reliability of Claude Code as an Agentic AI Grading System for Handwritten University Exams
papers.abstract: This study examines the reliability of Claude Code, an agentic deployment of the Claude Opus 4.6 large language model, as a grading system for handwritten university exams. Four research questions addressed agreement with expert human grading on total scores (RQ1), agreement across five question types from multiple choice to evaluative judgement (RQ2), consistency across two independent grading sessions one week apart (RQ3), and the accuracy of AI-generated feedback (RQ4). Claude Code graded the 20-mark mid-term papers of 60 consenting students in a Saudi computer graphics course in a single agentic session, guided by three rubric files. Reliability was estimated on disjoint samples: 20 papers for RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4, and 15 papers for RQ3. Analyses used Pearson correlation, mean absolute error, Bland-Altman analysis, weighted Cohen kappa, intraclass correlation, and a four-category coding scheme separating diagnostic from confirmation feedback. The author, as the sole subject-matter expert for the course, provided the human benchmark, so the design assesses agreement with a domain-expert reference rather than inter-rater reliability. AI grading agreed strongly with human grading on totals (r = 0.97; MAE = 0.85 marks) with a small but significant AI-positive bias of 0.68 marks, showed excellent test-retest consistency (ICC = 0.96), and produced accurate feedback (92.8% diagnostic; 97.8% confirmation). Drawing items were the outlier on three of four measures. Three failure modes recurred: keyword matching without conceptual depth, selection-state ambiguity on corrected multiple-choice answers, and region-of-attention drift on hand-drawn diagrams. The findings suggest that AI grading at this capability level can assist instructors on objective and short-form items under structural safeguards but is not yet ready to replace instructor judgement at boundary cases or on drawing items.

translation.title: Claude Code 作为手写大学试卷智能体式 AI 评分系统的可靠性
translation.abstract: 本研究考察 Claude Code（Claude Opus 4.6 大语言模型的智能体式部署）作为手写大学试卷评分系统的可靠性。四个研究问题分别考察：与专家人工评分在总分上的一致性（RQ1）；从选择题到评价性判断的五类题型上的评分一致性（RQ2）；间隔一周的两次独立评分之间的一致性（RQ3）；以及 AI 生成反馈的准确性（RQ4）。Claude Code 在一次智能体式会话中，依据三个评分细则文件，对沙特某计算机图形学课程中 60 名同意参与学生的 20 分期中试卷进行了评分。可靠性在互不重叠的样本上估计：RQ1、RQ2 和 RQ4 使用 20 份试卷，RQ3 使用 15 份试卷。分析采用 Pearson 相关、平均绝对误差、Bland-Altman 分析、加权 Cohen kappa、组内相关系数，以及区分诊断型与确认型反馈的四类别编码方案。由于作者本人是该课程唯一的专业领域专家并提供人工基准，该设计评估的是与领域专家参考评分的一致性，而非评分者间信度。AI 评分在总分上与人工评分高度一致（r = 0.97；MAE = 0.85 分），存在 0.68 分的小幅但显著的正向偏移，重测一致性极佳（ICC = 0.96），且反馈准确（诊断型 92.8%；确认型 97.8%）。绘图题在四项指标中的三项上是异常值。三种失败模式反复出现：缺乏概念深度的关键词匹配、改错后的多选题答案的选项状态歧义，以及对手绘图形注意力区域的漂移。研究结果表明，在结构化保障措施下，该能力水平的 AI 评分可以辅助教师批改客观题和简答题，但尚不足以替代教师对边界案例或绘图题的判断。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 Claude Code 能否可靠地为手写大学试卷评分，通过将其与专家人工评分在总分、题型、重测一致性和反馈准确性四个维度上对比来检验其可靠性。

papers.title: Decisions by Discrimination: Differential Evidence for Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied for clinical decision support, and medical question answering provides a testbed for evaluating this capability. In particular, medical multiple-choice questions (MCQs) reflect a core challenge in clinical decision-making: plausible options often share overlapping evidence, while only a few decisive factors distinguish the correct option from incorrect ones. However, existing retrieval-based and reasoning-oriented methods mainly focus on supplying broadly relevant knowledge or eliciting reasoning paths, rather than identifying the compact differential evidence that separates confusing alternatives. In this work, we present a retrieval-grounded differential evidence framework for medical MCQs. Our method extracts option-specific pieces of differential evidence and organizes them into concise evidence prompts for answer selection. This design better aligns external knowledge with differential reasoning while reducing irrelevant context. Experiments show consistent accuracy gains across multiple datasets and target LLMs. Ablation studies further show that our framework outperforms both directly using retrieved evidence chunks and closed-source LLM-generated general hints, and that its improvements are not solely explained by answer-proximal guidance, but are consistent with differential evidence serving as a compact aid for reasoning over competing alternatives. Our findings also offer insights for medical reasoning and other decision-making settings with multiple possible choices.

translation.title: 以鉴别实现决策：面向医疗推理的差异化证据
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在临床决策支持方面日益受到研究关注，医疗问答为评估这一能力提供了试验场。特别是，医疗多选题（MCQ）反映了临床决策的核心挑战：合理选项往往共享重叠的证据，而只有少数决定性因素将正确选项与错误选项区分开来。然而，现有的基于检索和面向推理的方法主要侧重于提供广泛相关的知识或诱导推理路径，而非识别区分易混淆备选项的紧凑差异化证据。本文提出一个面向医疗 MCQ 的、以检索为基础的差异化证据框架。我们的方法提取针对各选项的差异化证据片段，并将其组织为简洁的证据提示用于答案选择。这一设计使外部知识与差异化推理更好对齐，同时减少无关上下文。实验在多个数据集和多个目标 LLM 上显示出一致的准确率提升。消融研究进一步表明，该框架优于直接使用检索到的证据块和闭源 LLM 生成的通用提示，且其提升不能仅用靠近答案的引导来解释，而是与差异化证据作为对竞争性备选项进行推理的紧凑辅助相一致。我们的发现也为医疗推理及其他多选项决策场景提供了启示。
translation.brief: 该论文针对医疗多选题中易混淆选项的区分问题，提出一个检索驱动的差异化证据框架，提取各选项特异的差异化证据并组织为简洁提示以辅助 LLM 选答。

papers.title: FlowPlan: Reducing the Token Cost of Coding Agents with Abstraction-Guided Planning and Verification
papers.abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code can resolve real-world repository issues, but their iterative interaction loop can be expensive. Existing approaches reduce this cost primarily by limiting, compressing, or selectively avoiding information and actions within the repair process. We investigate a complementary question: Can an agent reason about a repair at an abstract program level, rather than repeatedly operating over raw source code, to reduce both the exploration needed to identify a repair and the repeated checking needed to verify it afterward? We present FlowPlan, an abstraction-guided repair approach that structures localization, planning, and verification around per-function control-flow or data-flow graphs. The agent first localizes the candidate fault location on the program abstraction and expresses the intended repair as explicit graph deltas before modifying the concrete source. After the edit, FlowPlan reconstructs the same abstraction and compares the observed structural change with the planned one. Then, a verification checks the complete repair before termination. Across all six benchmark-model settings, FlowPlan does not significantly change resolution rate relative to the vanilla agent while reducing token consumption in every setting, significantly in five of six settings. With Claude Haiku 4.5, it uses only 0.46-0.47x the baseline tokens on SWE-bench Pro, 0.32-0.35x on SWE-bench Verified, and 0.68-0.74x on SecBench; with Sonnet 5, it uses 0.72-0.76x, 0.73-0.74x, and 0.92-0.94x, respectively. Overall, FlowPlan achieves the largest token reduction among the compared methods in three of the six settings and ties the strongest compared method in a fourth. Trajectory analysis shows that FlowPlan saves tokens by replacing much of the costly post-edit re-reading and testing with explicit verification and reducing per-call context.

translation.title: FlowPlan：用抽象引导的规划与验证降低编码智能体的 token 开销
translation.abstract: Claude Code 等基于 LLM 的编码智能体可以解决真实世界的仓库问题，但其迭代交互循环可能代价高昂。现有方法主要通过在修复过程中限制、压缩或选择性地规避信息与动作来降低成本。我们研究一个互补的问题：智能体能否在抽象程序层面进行修复推理，而不是反复操作原始源代码，从而同时减少定位修复所需的探索和事后验证所需的重复检查？我们提出 FlowPlan，一种抽象引导的修复方法，它将定位、规划和验证围绕逐函数的控制流或数据流图来组织。智能体首先在程序抽象上定位候选故障位置，并在修改具体源码之前将预期的修复表达为显式的图增量（graph deltas）。编辑之后，FlowPlan 重建同一抽象，并将观察到的结构变化与计划进行对比。随后进行一次验证以在终止前确认完整修复。在全部六个基准-模型设置中，FlowPlan 相对原始智能体没有显著改变解决率，同时在每个设置中都降低了 token 消耗，其中五个设置显著。使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 时，它在 SWE-bench Pro 上仅用基线 0.46-0.47 倍的 token，SWE-bench Verified 上为 0.32-0.35 倍，SecBench 上为 0.68-0.74 倍；使用 Sonnet 5 时分别为 0.72-0.76 倍、0.73-0.74 倍和 0.92-0.94 倍。总体而言，FlowPlan 在六个设置中的三个实现了对比方法中最大的 token 削减，在第四个设置中与最强对比方法持平。轨迹分析表明，FlowPlan 通过用显式验证替代大量代价高昂的编辑后重读与测试、并减少每次调用的上下文，从而节省 token。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 LLM 编码智能体迭代修复过程中 token 开销过高的问题，提出 FlowPlan，以函数级控制流/数据流图为抽象进行故障定位、修复规划和结构化验证，从而减少探索与重复检查。

papers.title: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases
papers.abstract: ExpertCrowd-SWE (EC-SWE) is a benchmark of 100 expert-authored, multi-file software engineering tasks for evaluating autonomous coding agents in large, unfamiliar codebases. Each task is a change request written by a practising engineer against a pinned commit of a real repository, paired with a sealed reference solution and a task-specific grader whose weighted, mostly executable criteria award partial credit; must-pass blockers and pass/fail gates encode what a maintainer would refuse to merge. The tasks span 87 open-source projects and 11 languages. The median ticket is 148 words, while the median reference solution changes 471 lines. Every task image is calibrated before release so that the reference solution scores 1.0 and both the untouched repository and an inert change score 0; nearly half of the tasks also ship alternative, lazy and adversarial control patches that the grader must classify correctly. The final 100 tasks were selected for difficulty against current frontier models. We evaluate seven frontier models, five runs each (3,495 scored runs), in a single platform harness that gives each model its provider-native tool interface. Claude Opus 5.5 (67.3%) and GPT-6 Astra (63.7%) lead without a statistically significant gap, followed by Claude Fable 5.1 (46.5%), Gemini 3.8 Flash (40.0%), and a statistically indistinguishable group of Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Grok 4.6 (32-34%). No task is fully solved by every model, and on 80 tasks no model earns full credit on all five runs. Scores span 35 points. Depending on the model, agents take a median of 33 to 166 steps per run, with little relation to score. We release 24 tasks with their environments, graders and results, and hold out 76 to limit contamination.

translation.title: ExpertCrowd-SWE：在陌生代码库中用专家编写的工程任务衡量前沿编码智能体
translation.abstract: ExpertCrowd-SWE（EC-SWE）是一个包含 100 个专家编写的多文件软件工程任务的基准，用于在大型、陌生代码库中评估自主编码智能体。每个任务都是由执业工程师针对真实仓库固定 commit 提出的变更请求，配有封存的参考解决方案和一个任务专属评分器，评分器采用加权、多数可执行的评分标准并给予部分得分；必过阻断项和通过/不通过门控体现了维护者会拒绝合并的情形。任务涵盖 87 个开源项目和 11 种语言。任务工单的中位长度为 148 词，而参考解决方案的中位改动为 471 行。每个任务镜像在发布前经过校准，使参考解决方案得分为 1.0，而未改动的仓库和无效改动得分为 0；近半数任务还附带评分器必须正确分类的替代性、懒惰性和对抗性对照补丁。最终 100 个任务是针对当前前沿模型的难度而筛选的。我们在单一平台测试框架中评估七个前沿模型、每个模型运行五次（共 3,495 次评分运行），该框架为每个模型提供其原生的工具接口。Claude Opus 5.5（67.3%）和 GPT-6 Astra（63.7%）领先且差距无统计学显著性，其后是 Claude Fable 5.1（46.5%）、Gemini 3.8 Flash（40.0%），以及 Qwen 3.8 Max、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 Grok 4.6 这一无统计学差异的组合（32-34%）。没有任何任务被所有模型完全解决，且在 80 个任务上没有任何模型在全部五次运行中获得满分。各模型得分跨度达 35 分。不同模型的智能体每次运行的中位步数在 33 到 166 步之间，与得分关系不大。我们发布 24 个任务及其环境、评分器和结果，并保留 76 个任务以限制污染。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了 ExpertCrowd-SWE 基准，用 100 个专家编写的、陌生大型代码库中的多文件工程任务及配套评分器来评估前沿自主编码智能体的真实工程能力。

papers.title: Dependable Long-Horizon LLM Agents: A Trajectory-Centered Empirical Study of Where Errors Enter and Which Controls Reach Them
papers.abstract: When an LLM agent fails part-way through a long task, the usual analysis records a symptom: a failure-mode label, or the agent and step judged responsible. It does not say where the error entered, which state carried it to the symptom, whether anything in the trajectory contradicted it, or which control could have caught it. We define an episode record that ties a candidate fault to its origin, propagation, detection, response and consequence, located by operational phase and state domain, and that names the control families whose observation and reach cover it. We turned the record into a written annotation protocol and applied it to 95 failed runs of six multi-agent systems from the public Who&When and MAD corpora, reading each trajectory in full. Faults enter early (median at 0.18 of the run), mostly as wrong decisions or fabrications over task state, and in 37 of 88 Who&When runs before the step the corpus' human labels mark as decisive. In 72% of failed runs the trajectory already contained evidence against the error before the failure; in 88% of those no agent acted on it. Something flagged a deviation in 31% of runs, but no response removed the deviated state. Independent judges reading the unused evidence, task contracts fixed at admission, and re-checking beliefs against the environment reach most episodes; restoring the agent's own state would have sufficed in 35 of 95 runs. A text scan of the raw corpus also shows that 45% of the hand-crafted Who&When failures ended with a provider content-filter crash after which the harness emitted a final answer no agent produced, a failure class that neither symptom taxonomies nor responsible-agent labels represent. Protocol, records and scripts are included.

translation.title: 可靠的长时程 LLM 智能体：以轨迹为中心的实证研究——错误从何进入、哪些控制手段能够触及它们
translation.abstract: 当 LLM 智能体在长任务中途失败时，通常的分析只记录一个症状：一个失败模式标签，或被判定负有责任的智能体与步骤。它并未说明错误从何处进入、哪个状态将其传递到症状处、轨迹中是否有内容与之矛盾、或哪种控制手段本可捕获它。我们定义了一种片段记录（episode record），将候选故障与其起源、传播、检测、响应和后果联系起来，按操作阶段和状态域定位，并指明其观测与触及范围覆盖该故障的控制手段族系。我们将该记录转化为书面标注协议，并将其应用于来自公开 Who&When 和 MAD 语料的六个多智能体系统的 95 次失败运行，完整阅读每条轨迹。故障进入得很早（中位数在运行的 0.18 处），主要表现为对任务状态的错误决策或捏造，并且在 88 次 Who&When 运行中的 37 次发生在语料人工标注所标记的决定性步骤之前。在 72% 的失败运行中，轨迹在失败发生前已包含与错误相矛盾的证据；其中 88% 没有任何智能体对其采取行动。31% 的运行中有某种机制标记了偏离，但没有任何响应移除了偏离后的状态。独立评审员阅读未被使用的证据、读取在任务开始时即固定的任务契约、以及依据环境重新核查信念，可覆盖大多数片段；在 95 次运行中的 35 次中，恢复智能体自身状态本已足够。对原始语料的文本扫描还显示，45% 的 Who&When 手工构造失败最终以提供商内容过滤崩溃告终，此后测试框架输出了一个没有任何智能体产生过的最终答案，这一失败类别既未被症状分类学也未被责任智能体标签所涵盖。协议、记录与脚本均已随文发布。
translation.brief: 该论文针对长时程 LLM 智能体失败分析只记录症状而缺乏错误起源与传播信息的问题，提出一种轨迹标注协议，追踪故障的起源、传播、检测与响应，并实证考察哪些控制手段能够触及这些故障。

papers.title: Off-policy Learning with Excursion Policies
papers.abstract: Off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) tries to learn the value of a target policy while data comes from a different behavior policy. This often requires trading off bias for variance or stability. One way to trade these off is to linearly interpolate between the behavior and target policies, but this represents only one point in a broader space of interpolation mechanisms. We introduce excursion policies--a structured alternative where the agent follows the target policy for a multi-step "excursion" before reverting to the behavior policy. We derive dynamic programming results for these policies, establishing the theoretical basis for their use in RL. We further develop provably sound off-policy temporal-difference (TD) algorithms for excursion value estimation. We find that excursion policies provide an efficiency-stability trade-off comparable to mixture policies in continuous control benchmarks, and our analysis illustrates conceptual differences in their behavior.

translation.title: 基于excursion策略的离策略学习
translation.abstract: 离策略强化学习（RL）试图在数据来自不同行为策略的情况下学习目标策略的价值，这通常需要在偏差与方差或稳定性之间进行权衡。一种权衡方式是在行为策略与目标策略之间进行线性插值，但这只是更大插值机制空间中的一个点。我们提出excursion策略——一种结构化的替代方案，其中智能体在回到行为策略之前先执行多步的"excursion"（ excursion 执行目标策略）。我们为这类策略推导了动态规划结果，为其在RL中的应用奠定了理论基础。我们进一步为excursion价值估计开发了可证明正确的离策略时序差分（TD）算法。我们发现excursion策略在连续控制基准上提供了与混合策略相当的效率-稳定性权衡，并且我们的分析阐明了二者行为上的概念差异。
translation.brief: 研究离策略RL中偏差与稳定性的权衡问题，提出agent先执行多步目标策略再回到行为策略的excursion策略，并基于动态规划推导和时序差分算法对其进行价值估计。

papers.title: Project Progress Desk: Know Where All Your Claude Code and Codex Projects Stand at a Glance
papers.abstract: Codex and Claude Code let developers work on many projects in parallel, but keeping track of them still means switching between chats, terminal sessions and providers. We present Project Progress Desk, a local desktop interface that brings overall progress, blockers and pending decisions into one view. Users can see which projects need attention, inspect what remains, and compare earlier approaches before choosing how to continue. Agent receipts link reported outcomes to each project's weighted acceptance checklist; the overview distinguishes receipt-supported progress from dated estimates. We describe daily use across 36 projects, including a choice between two implementations based on their recorded outcomes. At the demo, attendees will explore 30 simulated projects, trace completed work to overall progress, and watch a coding agent's new result update the overview.

translation.title: Project Progress Desk：一览掌握所有 Claude Code 与 Codex 项目的进展
translation.abstract: Codex 和 Claude Code 让开发者可以并行推进多个项目，但跟踪这些项目仍需要在聊天、终端会话和不同提供商之间来回切换。我们提出 Project Progress Desk，一个本地桌面界面，将整体进展、阻塞项和待决策事项汇聚到一个视图中。用户可以查看哪些项目需要关注、检查剩余工作，并在选择如何继续之前对比早期方案。Agent receipts 将报告的结果与每个项目的加权验收清单关联起来；总览界面区分有 receipt 支撑的进展与带日期的预估。我们描述了在36个项目上的日常使用情况，包括基于记录的结果在两个实现之间做出的选择。在演示中，与会者将探索30个模拟项目，追踪已完成工作对整体进展的贡献，并观看一个编码 agent 的新结果实时更新总览。
translation.brief: 解决开发者并行使用多个AI编码项目时难以统一追踪进展的问题，构建了一个本地桌面界面，通过agent receipts将agent报告结果与验收清单关联，集中展示项目进展、阻塞项和待决策事项。

papers.title: Large Language Model Explainability for Planning Lunar Rover Trajectories under Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Planning planetary rover trajectories under probabilistic uncertainty is a multi-objective optimization problem that science teams currently iteratively solve and verify by hand. This process becomes impractical when timelines and constraints frequently shift throughout the mission planning phase. Sampling-based planners such as Monte Carlo tree search can speed up this process, but their outputs do not preserve traceability to the science objectives that justify each plan, which the science team needs to verify. We propose an interactive assistant based on a large language model (LLM) that can explain planner trajectories using domain vocabulary and re-run the planner under user-specified conditions to compare alternatives. Previous work has used LLMs inside planner decision-making loops, but we explore using them for post-planning explanation, where they are more likely to be trusted since they do not directly influence planner decisions. Our framework pairs a simulator inspired by the NASA Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) mission with a ReAct queryable interface that calls curated action tools and retrieval functions. We evaluate the assistant on a query bank consisting of plan comparisons, feasibility, and lookup queries. Experiments show that 90.9% of the assistant's responses are faithful to the planner's outputs, a nearly 65% improvement over zero-shot prompting of the same LLM without tool access, demonstrating the potential for trustworthy explainability of uncertainty-aware traverses with an LLM-based system.

translation.title: 面向不确定性下月球车轨迹规划的大语言模型可解释性
translation.abstract: 在概率不确定性下规划行星探测车轨迹是一个多目标优化问题，目前科学团队需要迭代地手动求解并验证。当任务规划阶段的时间线和约束频繁变化时，这一过程变得不切实际。诸如 Monte Carlo tree search 等基于采样的规划器可以加速该过程，但其输出无法保留对支撑每个方案的科学目标的可追溯性，而科学团队需要据此进行验证。我们提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的交互式助手，能够使用领域词汇解释规划器生成的轨迹，并在用户指定条件下重新运行规划器以比较备选方案。已有工作将 LLM 置于规划器决策循环之内，而我们探索将其用于规划后解释，由于不直接影响规划器决策，这种方式更容易获得信任。我们的框架将一个受 NASA Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) 任务启发的模拟器与 ReAct 可查询接口配对，该接口调用经过整理的动作工具和检索函数。我们在由方案比较、可行性检查和查询组成的查询库上评估该助手。实验表明，助手90.9%的回复忠实于规划器的输出，相比无工具访问的同一 LLM 零样本提示提升了近65%，展示了基于 LLM 的系统对不确定性感知穿越规划进行可信可解释性的潜力。
translation.brief: 解决行星探测车轨迹规划中采样式规划器输出缺乏对科学目标可追溯性的问题，提出一个基于LLM的规划后解释助手，通过ReAct接口调用模拟器工具与检索函数来解释轨迹并对比备选方案。

papers.title: Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding
papers.abstract: Serving large language models at high concurrency with long contexts requires KV-cache capacity and attention bandwidth that grow with the decode pool. Existing parallelization strategies trade one against the other: data parallelism replicates model weights, limiting KV capacity; tensor parallelism stops scaling attention at the model's KV-head count and pushes dense collectives across nodes; and decode context parallelism (DCP) recovers capacity by sharding the sequence but adds cross-node aggregation of partial attention results. We observe that during decode, dense layers and attention scale differently: dense layers amortize weight reads across the batch and run efficiently within a single NVLink domain, whereas attention cost grows with every active request's KV cache. We present Decode Token Parallelism (TKNP), a decode-pool architecture that decouples weight placement from attention ownership. TKNP distributes a single model copy across nodes in balanced layer blocks. The active node holding a block executes its projections and MLP for the full batch using intra-node tensor parallelism, while every node computes attention for its own requests against locally resident KV cache. This extends request-local attention across nodes without replicating weights: only current-token activations cross the network, dense all-reduces remain within NVLink, and attention requires no cross-node merging of partial results. Implemented in vLLM and evaluated on Llama 3.1 405B and Nemotron-4 340B on up to 64 H100 GPUs, TKNP improves completion throughput for long-context, high-concurrency workloads by up to 1.7$\times$ over DCP and by up to 2.06$\times$ over data parallelism at matched GPU count.

translation.title: Decode Token Parallelism：面向可扩展 LLM 解码的高内存效率分布式注意力并行
translation.abstract: 在高并发、长上下文场景下服务大语言模型，所需的 KV-cache 容量和注意力带宽会随 decode pool 的增长而增长。现有并行化策略在此二者之间进行取舍：数据并行复制模型权重，限制了 KV 容量；张量并行在模型 KV-head 数量处停止扩展注意力，并将密集的集合通信推向跨节点；decode context parallelism (DCP) 通过对序列分片恢复容量，但增加了对部分注意力结果的跨节点聚合。我们观察到，在解码阶段，密集层与注意力的扩展方式不同：密集层将权重读取摊销到整个 batch 上，可在单个 NVLink 域内高效运行，而注意力的开销随每个活跃请求的 KV cache 增长。我们提出 Decode Token Parallelism (TKNP)，一种将权重放置与注意力所有权解耦的 decode pool 架构。TKNP 将单一模型副本以均衡的层块方式分布在多个节点上。持有某个层块的活跃节点使用节点内张量并行对整个 batch 执行其投影和 MLP，而每个节点针对本地驻留的 KV cache 为自己的请求计算注意力。这在无需复制权重的情况下将请求本地注意力扩展到多个节点：网络上仅传输当前 token 的激活值，密集 all-reduce 保持在 NVLink 内，且注意力无需跨节点合并部分结果。我们在 vLLM 中实现 TKNP，并在最多64张 H100 GPU 上对 Llama 3.1 405B 和 Nemotron-4 340B 进行评估，在相同 GPU 数量下，TKNP 在长上下文、高并发工作负载上的完成吞吐量相比 DCP 最高提升1.7倍，相比数据并行最高提升2.06倍。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文高并发LLM解码中KV-cache容量与注意力带宽难以兼顾的问题，提出TKNP架构，将权重按层块分布到各节点、注意力在本地KV-cache上计算，仅传输当前token激活值。

papers.title: PegasusAI Studio: Legible Cyberinfrastructure and Accountable AI Agents for Scientific Workflows
papers.abstract: AI coding agents can now construct scientific workflows, but operating them on shared cyberinfrastructure (CI) raises problems that code generation does not solve. Agents need current knowledge of the workflow system and its execution sites and access to the runtime state of distributed executions, while facilities need to attribute every agent action to a user and bound it by that user's privileges. We present PegasusAI Studio, an AI-assisted science gateway built on the Pegasus and HTCondor stack. Studio makes CI legible to agents by projecting one facility-curated knowledge base into the native configuration of several coding agents, by introspecting workflow interfaces and execution sites, and by grounding diagnosis in workflow and scheduler telemetry. Agent actions operate within a trust envelope that combines federated authentication, per-user execution environments and scheduler credentials, provider-neutral model access, observability, and approval controls for state-changing actions. The same application runs as a JupyterHub-based gateway on a research cloud and as an Open OnDemand application on HPC systems. We evaluate Studio through case studies of legacy CASA weather workflow modernization, a gravitational-wave reanalysis, an EEG analysis built with an open-weight model, and an Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) M87 image reconstruction that recovered from two failed runs to a zero-failure execution. The evaluation establishes that these mechanisms operate as designed.

translation.title: PegasusAI Studio：面向科学工作流的可读网络基础设施与可问责AI Agent
translation.abstract: AI 编码 agent 如今可以构建科学工作流，但在共享网络基础设施（CI）上运行它们会带来代码生成本身无法解决的问题。Agent 需要了解工作流系统及其执行站点的最新知识，并访问分布式执行的运行时状态；同时设施方需要将每个 agent 动作归因到具体用户，并以该用户的权限加以约束。我们提出 PegasusAI Studio，一个构建在 Pegasus 和 HTCondor 技术栈之上的 AI 辅助科学网关。Studio 通过将一个由设施方维护的知识库投射到多个编码 agent 的原生配置中、通过内省工作流接口和执行站点、以及将诊断锚定在工作流和调度器遥测数据上，使 CI 对 agent 变得可读。Agent 动作在一个信任包络内运行，该包络结合了联邦认证、每用户执行环境和调度器凭据、提供商中立的模型访问、可观测性，以及针对改变状态操作的审批控制。同一应用既可作为基于 JupyterHub 的网关运行在研究云上，也可作为 Open OnDemand 应用运行在 HPC 系统上。我们通过多个案例研究评估 Studio：遗留 CASA 天气工作流的现代化改造、引力波再分析、使用开源权重模型构建的 EEG 分析，以及一次 Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) M87 图像重建——该案例从两次失败运行恢复为零失败执行。评估表明这些机制按设计运行。
translation.brief: 解决AI agent在共享科学基础设施上运行时缺乏系统知识访问与动作问责的问题，构建PegasusAI Studio，通过设施方知识库投射、接口内省、遥测诊断和信任包络使agent可读基础设施且动作可归因。

papers.title: Towards Scalable Network-Based Interventions for HIV Treatment and Prevention via R2C-Agent
papers.abstract: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) remains a pressing public health challenge worldwide. Targeting limited HIV prevention and treatment resources effectively with network-based algorithms is a long-standing problem with a rich history at AAMAS and other computational venues. However, optimizing targeted biomedical interventions for minimizing spread of HIV often requires observability of the contact network of HIV transmission risk behavior among individuals, which is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale. Peer referral networks, i.e., networks collected through a recursive peer referral process, are an alternative network class often used to study HIV in hidden populations that can be collected digitally at scale, but they deviate from the underlying contact network: referrals can follow non-risk social ties and participants accept only one referral, hiding contacts among already-recruited individuals. In this work, we first formalize the novel problem of planning network-based interventions to minimize HIV spread in the hidden contact network while observing only the peer referral network. Second, we implement R2C-Agent, a decision making agent for interventions that is designed around our new conditional graph diffusion model called Referral-to-Contact Diffusion (R2C-Diff). R2C-Diff positions the peer referral process as incremental corruption of the underlying contact network and learns to reverse it. R2C-Agent plans its interventions over contact networks sampled from R2C-Diff, so its decisions account for uncertainty about the hidden contact network. Finally, we conduct simulated experiments using real-world HIV network data that demonstrate that R2C-Agent empirically plans more effective interventions than baselines from interdisciplinary literature and highlight key tradeoffs and assumptions driving performance.

papers.title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
papers.abstract: Few-shot abstract reasoning on ARC-AGI requires inducing algorithmic transformations from 2 to 5 demonstration pairs without task-specific pretraining. Because few-shot demonstrations under-constrain the hypothesis space, program synthesis suffers from the Rashomon effect (predictive multiplicity): heuristic search finds spurious programs with low training error that fail on test inputs, while unconstrained library growth degrades latency. We introduce F3-AGI v4.0, a CPU-native neuro-symbolic and active inference architecture comprising three mechanisms: (1) F3-Metabolic-Optim, combining mistake-gated plasticity, Fisher-EMA preconditioning, and virtual ATP gating; (2) Adaptive Complexity-Guided Program Synthesis (AACR) with a Cycle-3 ResidualPatchSynthesizer and smallest-pair early rejection; and (3) a 512D L2-normalized random projection driving Expected Free Energy (EFE) exploration with dead-signature pruning. Across three empirical studies: (i) on a synthetic 5-task class-incremental stream without replay, F3-Metabolic-Optim achieves 91.67% final accuracy with 9.17% forgetting, skipping 93.47% of updates, cutting L1 plasticity cost by 65.7%, and running 2.19x faster than EWC; (ii) on the 400-task ARC-AGI-1 public evaluation set (offline CPU, zero LLM calls), F3-AGI v4.0 solves 57/400 tasks (14.25% pass@2; 56/400 pass@1) with a mean latency of 1.62 s/task, decomposed into 19/50 (38.00%, 1.19 s/task, a 42.5x paired speedup over Horizon 2) on the 50-task calibration slice and 38/350 (10.86%) on the 350 strictly uninspected hold-out tasks (with 7 autonomous Cycle-3 patch solutions); and (iii) in a local 5-game (15-level) ARC-AGI-3-inspired interactive suite, our agent completes 15/15 levels with 89.44% level-weighted RHAE (90.72% unweighted).

papers.title: Agent-Guided Discovery of Exchange-Correlation Functionals with Physics-based Validation
papers.abstract: Accurate, compact exchange--correlation functionals are central to predictive density functional theory. Symbolic search and language-model agents can propose new functional forms, but it remains unclear whether their gains survive self-consistency and external evaluation, whether the new terms carry physical content, whether agents outperform evolutionary search, and how language-model backbones compare. We connect frontier LLM agents to a GPU evaluator through the Model Context Protocol, with training-only fitting, persistent memory, and self-consistent and external evaluation. Opus-5.5 agents passed the screening gate with about 40-fold fewer tokens than Codex (GPT-6-Astra) agents and found a candidate with lower validation and held-out errors; only this candidate advanced to self-consistent evaluation. The resulting 13-parameter functional, O159, multiplies same-spin correlation by a smooth density window. Refitted controls favor a window that scales the entire same-spin factor, reducing it by 15--30\% at its peak, and that acts on reaction energies mainly in near-iso-orbital regions; against a refitted no-window control, it lowers heavy-atom total-energy errors on GSCDB137 by 29\%. With about 400 fits each, SyFES evolution did not improve on its GAS22 seed, whereas the agents found forms 0.10--0.13 \kcal\ lower in validation error by adding an explicit density scale. Self-consistent O159 lowers the held-out MGCDB84 test error of $\omega$B97M-V by 11.7\%, and its mean normalized error ratio on 36 GSCDB137 datasets (1.139) is comparable to $\omega$B97M-V (1.144) and below GAS22 (1.190). Frontier-LLM agents thus produced O159, a compact functional whose improvement over $\omega$B97M-V survives self-consistent, physics-based validation.

papers.title: Do AI Agents need Preventive Care? An Epidemiologic Cohort Design for Agentic AI
papers.abstract: As AI agents increasingly perform tasks autonomously across sectors, including healthcare and biomedical research, understanding how their behaviors develop and influence outcomes over time becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations largely focus on model capabilities and performance on predefined tasks. Here, we propose an epidemiologic cohort design for studying agentic AI, drawing on principles established in human population studies. The framework treats individual agents as members of a cohort, their underlying model as genetic makeup, accumulated work as their time scale, and naturally occurring behaviors as exposures that may influence subsequent outcomes. By following agents longitudinally, this approach enables investigation of behavioral determinants of adverse events, estimation of their potential preventable burden under causal assumptions, and characterization of behavioral changes over an agent's work life. We illustrate the design through two prospective observational cohorts examining curiosity and probing as a safety question, and data checking and analytical accuracy as a reliability question. Together, the framework and illustrative studies provide a generalizable blueprint for designing epidemiologic cohorts of AI agents.

papers.title: Veritas: A Verifier Generation Harness for Agent Tasks
papers.abstract: The effectiveness of a self-improving system relies heavily on the quality of its verifier, which judges the outcome of each improvement round. However, the verifiers of most tasks are written by hand, which is expensive and does not scale to tasks that come without one. We propose Veritas, a harness that generates verifiers automatically. Unlike general-purpose agent harnesses, Veritas adds three mechanisms for verifier generation: an evidence header stating what the verifier will observe, a library of domain rules that tasks leave unstated, and authoring principles, partly refined by a self-improvement loop. We evaluate on six benchmarks: four scored by execution, whose official verifiers we first certify, and two that compare pairs of responses. With the model fixed, the verifiers Veritas generates agree better with the official verdicts than those of seven other harnesses on all four execution-scored benchmarks. On the two pairwise benchmarks they are at or near the best. They also agree better than those of the vendor's own harness for two of three other model families. Its mechanisms also improve 9 of 12 harness-benchmark pairs scored by execution across three harnesses.

papers.title: Measuring Definition Sensitivity in LLM Annotation of Social Science Concepts
papers.abstract: In social science research, text annotation is a fundamental task that is traditionally a costly, hard-to-scale manual process. Researchers have used large language models (LLMs) to perform annotation by writing a definition of a concept into a prompt - a rule that determines whether a label should be attributed to a text depending on its content. However, concepts such as hate speech, fake news, and terrorism typically have several theoretically defensible competing definitions. It is also unknown whether the model actually applied the definition to provide the label or the label was based on the model's pretrained notion of the concept. To test this, we have the model annotate the same texts twice, each time with a different definition. We call the disagreement between the two sets of annotations definition sensitivity. As a control, we paraphrase one definition but leave its requirements unchanged - the disagreement between the annotations with the two wordings becomes the paraphrase floor. Across six concepts and three LLMs, a swap of competing definitions always changes more annotations, on average, than a paraphrase. This shows that the annotations depend on the prompted definition, so any set of annotations should be interpreted together with the definition that produced it. The LLM annotator's definition sensitivity and its paraphrase floor should both be reported in such work.

translation.title: 测量LLM标注社会科学概念时的定义敏感性
translation.abstract: 在社会科学研究中，文本标注是一项基础任务，传统上是一个成本高昂、难以规模化的手工过程。研究者使用大语言模型（LLM）进行标注，方法是将概念的定义写入提示词——即一条根据文本内容决定是否赋予其某个标签的规则。然而，诸如仇恨言论、假新闻和恐怖主义等概念通常存在多个理论上都可辩护的相互竞争的定义。此外，模型究竟是真正应用了所给定义来提供标签，还是基于其预训练中对概念的理解给出标签，也尚不清楚。为了检验这一点，我们让模型对同一批文本进行两次标注，每次使用不同的定义。我们将两组标注之间的不一致称为定义敏感性。作为对照，我们对其中一个定义进行改写但保持其要求不变——两种措辞下标注之间的不一致构成改写底线。在六个概念和三个LLM上，交换相互竞争的定义所改变的标注数量平均而言总是多于改写定义。这表明标注结果依赖于提示词中的定义，因此任何一组标注都应与产生它的定义一起解读。在此类工作中，应同时报告LLM标注者的定义敏感性及其改写底线。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM标注结果是否真正依赖提示词中定义的问题，通过用竞争性定义与仅改写措辞的定义对同一文本重复标注，以比较两者的标注不一致程度来测量定义敏感性。

papers.title: DEPUTYBENCH: Evaluating Contextual Safety in Enterprise Agents
papers.abstract: Enterprise agents must determine whether ordinary requests are permitted by organizational records and policies while continuing legitimate work. We introduce DEPUTYBENCH, an executable benchmark with 79 base items, 375 instances, paired permission contexts, and graded evidence requirements. Across 12 models, revised audits give 88.0% pooled safety and 79.1% paired success. A controlled study of 28 derived tasks and six models tests authorization-fact flips, evidence masking, and irrelevant rewrites. Outcomes track backend permissions, yet restricted execution is more frequent with missing evidence than explicit non-permission: 10.3% versus 3.5% on 27 matched tasks, a 6.8-percentage-point difference (95% interval: 1.9-13.0; secondary analysis). A post-hoc analysis locates 61 of 100 masked-condition executions in four privacy tasks requiring complete cumulative counts or person-specific consent. The difference persists when the most error-prone model or the largest contributing task is excluded, but is much smaller outside those four tasks. Thus high safety with available evidence does not establish reliable stopping when permission cannot be verified. Mean paired success is equivalent within a prespecified five-point margin under irrelevant rewrites, while strong-model safety remains near ceiling. Scorer validation improves from 178 to 266 correctly scored cases out of 284 held-out counterexamples. Two security experts manually verified task ground truth over a two-week period; stage labels remain LLM-generated. The concentration analysis describes task structure and audited outcomes, not an identified internal mechanism.

translation.title: DEPUTYBENCH：评估企业智能体的上下文安全性
translation.abstract: 企业智能体必须判断普通请求是否被组织记录和政策所允许，同时继续开展合法工作。我们提出DEPUTYBENCH，一个可执行的基准，包含79个基础项目、375个实例、成对的许可上下文以及分级的证据要求。在12个模型上，修订后的审计给出88.0%的总体安全性和79.1%的成对成功率。一项针对28个派生任务和六个模型的受控研究测试了授权事实翻转、证据掩蔽和不相关改写。结果与后端权限相符，但在证据缺失时的受限执行比明确不允许时更频繁：在27个匹配任务上为10.3%对3.5%，相差6.8个百分点（95%区间：1.9-13.0；次要分析）。事后分析在四个需要完整累计计数或针对特定个人同意的隐私任务中定位了100次掩蔽条件执行中的61次。当排除最易出错的模型或贡献最大的任务时，这一差异仍然存在，但在那四个任务之外差异要小得多。因此，有证据可用时的高安全性并不能确立无法验证许可时的可靠停止能力。在不相关改写下，平均成对成功率在预先指定的五个百分点范围内等价，而强模型的安全性仍接近上限。评分器验证从284个保留反例中正确评分的178例提升至266例。两位安全专家在两周内人工验证了任务真值；阶段标签仍为LLM生成。集中度分析描述的是任务结构和审计结果，而非已识别的内部机制。
translation.brief: 该论文解决企业智能体在组织权限上下文中能否正确停止的问题，构建了包含成对许可上下文的可执行基准DEPUTYBENCH，并通过授权翻转、证据掩蔽等受控实验评估12个模型的安全性。

papers.title: No finite rulebook can certify every safe program: an impossibility theorem for gatekeeping AI agents
papers.abstract: An AI assistant writes small programs, and a gatekeeper must decide, from the code alone, whether each one may run. Suppose the rules are fixed: never perform a forbidden action, never let the output depend on a secret, always answer eventually. Can two rulebooks, one listing what is allowed and one listing what is not, both be complete, if every rule must be backed by evidence that a machine can check in finite time? We prove that they cannot. Checkable evidence can only establish what a finite record settles, and ``never'' and ``eventually'' are never settled by a finite record. For prohibitions the failure is one-sided: every violation can be caught by watching, but no safe program can be cleared for good. For confidentiality and responsiveness, neither side can be. We characterise exactly which rules about visible behaviour evidence can confirm, and we show that any sound rulebook of $n$ bits omits a compliant program of about $n$ bits. A time limit makes everything checkable, but only by running the program for essentially the whole limit, so a finite machine is not a feasible one. Finally, we show what a gatekeeper can still guarantee: not a verdict on every program, but a checkable list that contains everything it must allow and nothing it must refuse. Simulations on 2.2 million random programs and on self-referential adversaries show that the obstruction is adversarial rather than typical, and that the one error a longer test never removes is the liveness part of confidentiality.

translation.title: 没有有限的规则手册能够认证每一个安全程序：守门AI智能体的一个不可能性定理
translation.abstract: 一个AI助手编写小程序，而守门者必须仅凭代码决定每个程序是否可以运行。假设规则是固定的：绝不执行被禁止的操作、绝不让输出依赖于秘密、总是最终给出回答。如果每条规则都必须有机器能在有限时间内检查的证据支撑，那么两本规则手册——一本列出允许的内容，一本列出不允许的内容——能否都是完备的？我们证明它们不能。可检查的证据只能确立有限记录所能确定的事情，而“绝不”和“最终”永远不会被有限记录所确定。对于禁止性规则，失败是单侧的：每一次违规都能通过监视被捕捉，但没有任何安全程序能够被永久放行。对于保密性和响应性，两侧都无法确立。我们精确刻画了关于可见行为的规则中哪些能被证据确认，并表明任何n比特的可靠规则手册都会遗漏一个约n比特的合规程序。时限使一切可检查，但代价是必须运行程序几乎整个时限，因此有限时间的机器并不可行。最后，我们展示了守门者仍能保证什么：不是对每个程序的裁决，而是一份可检查的清单，包含它必须允许的一切而不包含它必须拒绝的任何内容。在220万个随机程序和自指对手上的模拟表明，这种阻碍是对抗性的而非典型的，且更长的测试永远无法消除的唯一错误是保密性的活性部分。
translation.brief: 该论文解决守门AI智能体能否用有限可检查规则完备认证程序安全性的问题，通过形式化不可能性定理证明“绝不”和“最终”类规则无法被有限记录验证，并刻画守门者可保证的边界。

papers.title: Online-Adaptive Fuzzy Cognitive Maps for Neuro-symbolic Financial Forecasting
papers.abstract: We present a neuro-symbolic framework that pairs online-adaptive Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) with long short-term memory (LSTM) networks for financial forecasting. Financial markets exhibit regime shifts and nonlinear dynamics. Existing models often trade off one of these key properties: these models capture temporal patterns but hide causal drivers, or they recover causal graphs that cannot adapt post-training. We close this gap with two frameworks. Framework I constructs an FCM from live dual-source price series and macroeconomic indicators, and adapts its edges online through an error-driven Hebbian rule. We introduce the Asymmetric Additive Residual Fusion method to seamlessly combine the FCM and LSTM predictions under Framework I. Framework II constructs a literature-grounded, LLM-augmented FCM where every edge carries a verifiable citation that gives an auditable map of factor interactions. On NASDAQ Composite data, Framework I matched the performance of the LSTM baseline on state-directional accuracy and outperformed LSTM by 7.6 percentage points on the return-sign accuracy. Framework I outperformed standalone FCM models across both evaluation metrics. The adaptive maps converged to new regimes within 10-15 trading days, and Framework II center-node FCMs scored 68.9% to 85.7% on the state-directional accuracy.

translation.title: 面向神经符号金融预测的在线自适应模糊认知图
translation.abstract: 我们提出一个神经符号框架，将在线自适应模糊认知图（FCM）与长短期记忆网络（LSTM）结合用于金融预测。金融市场呈现体制转换和非线性动态。现有模型往往在这些关键属性之间取舍：它们要么捕捉时间模式但隐藏因果驱动因素，要么恢复出训练后无法自适应的因果图。我们用两个框架来弥补这一缺口。框架I从实时双源价格序列和宏观经济指标构建FCM，并通过误差驱动的Hebbian规则在线调整其边。我们提出非对称加性残差融合方法，在框架I下无缝结合FCM和LSTM的预测。框架II构建一个以文献为基础、LLM增强的FCM，每条边都带有可验证的引用，从而提供可审计的因子交互图。在NASDAQ综合指数数据上，框架I在状态方向准确率上与LSTM基线持平，并在收益率符号准确率上超出LSTM 7.6个百分点。框架I在两个评估指标上均优于独立的FCM模型。自适应图在10-15个交易日内收敛到新体制，框架II的中心节点FCM在状态方向准确率上达到68.9%至85.7%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决金融预测中时间模式建模与可适应因果图难以兼得的问题，提出结合在线自适应FCM与LSTM的双框架方法，其中边更新采用误差驱动Hebbian规则并引入LLM增强的可审计引用图。

papers.title: Plumbline: When the Loss Lies, Validating LLM Training Correctly
papers.abstract: Correctness is a prerequisite for training large language models (LLMs) at scale, yet it is hard to ensure: a fault can sit in any part of a run, and how it shows differs across frameworks and the libraries they depend on. Some failures are loud and some are silent, and both take time to detect and trace. A single fault can waste a long run: the run crashes late, or the model scores lower only at the final evaluation. We present Plumbline, a correctness validation system for LLM training, used in production at Amazon. Plumbline checks each part of the training lifecycle, from the data a run trains on to the model it serves, down to the new layers each model brings and up to whole runs. Its diagnosis reuses these checks to trace failures to their root causes. Both rest on a systematic correctness methodology designed to carry across models and frameworks. Plumbline supports two agentic use cases: Day-0 onboarding, which validates the training of a newly released model before teams rely on it, and root-cause tracing of training failures. Across 3 frameworks and 5 models, it found 61 problems, 32 of them silent. Of these, 42 are fixed or reported upstream, 8 of them first raised by us. We further group the 61 into seven failure patterns that show where training breaks, and report how problems recur across frameworks and models.

translation.title: Plumbline：当损失函数撒谎时，正确验证LLM训练
translation.abstract: 正确性是大规模训练大语言模型（LLM）的前提，但难以保证：故障可能存在于运行的任何环节，其表现形式因框架及其依赖的库而异。有些故障是响亮的，有些是静默的，检测和追踪两者都耗时。单个故障可能毁掉一次长时间运行：运行在后期崩溃，或者模型仅在最终评估时得分偏低。我们提出Plumbline，一个LLM训练正确性验证系统，已在Amazon投入生产使用。Plumbline检查训练生命周期的每个部分，从运行所训练的数据到所服务的模型，深入到每个模型带来的新层，也上升到整个运行层面。其诊断复用这些检查将故障追踪至根本原因。两者都建立在一套旨在跨模型和框架通用的系统化正确性方法论之上。Plumbline支持两个智能体使用场景：Day-0接入，即在新模型发布后、团队依赖它之前验证其训练；以及训练故障的根因追踪。在3个框架和5个模型上，它发现了61个问题，其中32个是静默的。其中42个已被修复或上报至上游，其中8个由我们首次提出。我们进一步将这61个问题归纳为七种故障模式，以展示训练在何处出错，并报告问题在框架和模型间的复现情况。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM训练中显性和静默故障难以检测与溯源的问题，提出覆盖训练全生命周期的正确性验证系统Plumbline，基于跨模型跨框架的系统化方法论自动发现并追踪故障根因。

papers.title: The AI Era's Lines of Code? A Case Study on What an Engineer's Token Spend Measures
papers.abstract: Organizations use engineers' token spend to monitor AI adoption, set budgets, and measure productivity, but the metric's relationship with engineering output is unclear. We link five weeks of token usage in coding agents to the commits of 404 engineers at JetBrains, and analyze a company survey of 412 employees. We find that token spend varied mostly between engineers, and which engineers spent the most stayed largely the same over the five weeks. Among weeks with similar commit counts, the 90th percentile of spend was 39 to 240 times the 10th. Within an engineer, doubling spend was associated with about 10% more commits. Available work metrics explained 38% of the variation in spend between engineers and 13% of the week-to-week variation within an engineer. In the survey, respondents in technical roles reported in nearly nine of ten agent evaluations using agents for tasks beyond coding, such as analysis, research, and planning. Token spend therefore measures how much engineers use agents across many kinds of work and not the outcome and value of that work. We recommend using token spend at most for resource accounting, and evaluating agent-assisted work with evidence about tasks and outcomes.

papers.title: SPARK: Semantic-preserving Prompt Mutation for Code Generation using Consensus-based Verification Framework
papers.abstract: Automated code generation with large language models (LLMs) has improved in recent years. With the lack of test cases in real-world usages, generated code is not automatically verifiable and often requires manual validation. Previous studies have leveraged consensus verification, where code solutions and corresponding test cases are generated and evaluated based on functional consistency. Building on this, SPARK incorporates semantic-preserving mutations to problem descriptions such as paraphrasing, grammatical adjustments, function renaming, and other alterations to enhance the robustness and correctness of LLM-generated code. For each mutated description, SPARK generates a set of code solutions and test cases. These candidate solutions are evaluated using consensus-based verification, where the solutions' quality is measured by how consistently they pass generated tests. We assess the effectiveness of SPARK on three benchmarks (LiveCodeBench, BigCodeBench, and DLBench) across three LLMs (o4-mini, DeepSeek-R1-Basic, and Gemini-2.5-Pro). Our evaluation demonstrates that SPARK outperforms state-of-the-art consensus-based verification approaches by up to 4.1%. Our generalization experiment highlights the practical potential of SPARK as an effective strategy for enhancing the reliability and correctness of LLM-based code generation systems in scenarios where traditional validation resources are scarce, while our qualitative analysis shows insight into how SPARK's mutation helps LLMs generate better code solutions.
