papers.title: Living constitutions: Participatory alignment for sovereign foundation models
papers.abstract: In Constitutional AI, a plain-text "constitution" encodes values and gets incorporated into a model via post-training. However, the procedure for creating such a constitution poses significant challenges: who contributes, who decides which norms are included, and to what extent must the process be participatory or democratic? These challenges can be paralyzing. Yet, we argue that taking action is essential: without a deliberate constitution, sovereign models would risk misalignment or default to norms set by frontier model providers. We propose treating the development of a constitution as an evolving, participatory process akin to citizen science, iteratively drafted, tested, and refined. We therefore formulate five desirable principles: iterative, modular, justifiable, positional, and legitimate. We further argue that such a document must remain responsive not only over time but across the people it governs, and propose that provisions be marked as settled, contested, or underdetermined, so that durable disagreement is recorded in the constitution rather than resolved away. Empirically, we show via agent-based modelling that proposed process for maintaining living constitutions is robust against 50% bad actors among citizens - assuming a share of 75% participants with good intent in the deliberative body. This indicates that the proposed process tolerates a substantial share of adversarial participants.

papers.title: Stinging the Swarm: Extracting Attacker Intelligence from a Twin-Controller OT Honeypot
papers.abstract: Autonomous language-model agents can drive industrial controllers over fieldbus protocols, probing a plant at machine speed and in coordinated swarms. We present Talos, an inline gate that judges every agent request to a controller in milliseconds and routes agents it flags as hostile to a device-faithful decoy -- a mirror twin of the real plant -- where their attack continues harmlessly and is read for intelligence. We evaluate the full pipeline (detect -> quarantine -> mirror -> extract) against 2,400 autonomous attacker agents, 600 in each of four tiers that escalate the attacker's effort to stay hidden, from no concealment to an explicit non-disclosure rule and a trained cover story. No write reached the real plant in any tier: the gate denies the damage path and a device-level envelope check backstops it, while unmapped registers are denied without exception and the gate still permits safe-direction stop commands. Decisions are model-driven in every tier with no inference timeouts, closing a common objection to small on-device judges. Beyond blocking, the pipeline reads the attacker. We find a behavioral structure along two axes -- how persistently an agent attacks and how much it discloses -- and show that the system has a capture channel for three of the four resulting regions: hardened, silent attackers escalate most and are read on the mirror; compliant, talkative attackers volunteer their identity to a diagnostic form before they are ever quarantined; only the paranoid, low-yield region resists both. Attacker identity fields are self-authored cover stories, but involuntary tells -- the self-reported toolchain fingerprint and the attacker's own list of targeted registers -- accumulate across the swarm into a high-confidence profile drawn from agents under explicit orders to stay silent. The gate, mirror, and harness are released under Apache 2.0 with a synthetic device family.

papers.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. We internalize these corrections by training the student without guidance to match the steered student's predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher's at other turns, enabling unassisted inference. Across five agentic benchmarks and three models, SteerDistill exceeds the strongest quantized baseline by 1.67--2.18 points in average score under W4A16 and stays within one point of BF16. On $\tau^2$-Bench, it outperforms QeRL by 1.84 percentage points in success rate using 67% fewer training GPU hours and produces shorter successful trajectories than the quantized baselines.

papers.title: Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving
papers.abstract: LLM agents drive inference engines with closed-loop sessions whose context grows every turn, and serving them economically depends on prefix caching: a hit costs an incremental prefill of about a thousand tokens, a miss recomputes a 10--40K-token context. We show that this makes prefix-cached agent serving metastable. With an identical base workload, a few minutes of extra arrivals leaves a vLLM server in a degraded regime--a ~10% hit ratio, about half the throughput, and a backlog that grows for the remaining 70 minutes--while its no-burst twin stays healthy (9 of 12 pairs; none in the reverse direction). The regime appears at loads the cache-warm server sustains, is absent without prefix caching, and also appears with Qwen3-32B on SWE-bench agent trace shapes and on SGLang, which tolerates larger triggers. Slower service keeps more sessions in the system, their working set outgrows the KV pool, and every turn becomes a recomputation; a first-order workload-balance condition, calibrated independently, brackets when the regime can drain. Getting out is the harder problem: throttling new admissions recovered 1 of 7 matched collapsed runs, while suspending admitted sessions against a capacity-based limit recovered all of them within minutes. A CPU offload tier delays the collapse but does not prevent it. A budgeter that bounds the resident KV demand of active sessions to the pool, with thresholds that need no per-workload tuning, prevented the failure in every run we tested.

translation.title: 比自身更持久的突发：前缀缓存智能体服务中的持续性能退化
translation.abstract: LLM智能体以每轮上下文持续增长的闭环会话驱动推理引擎，其经济性服务依赖于前缀缓存：命中只需约一千token的增量prefill，未命中则需重算10–40K token的上下文。我们证明这使得前缀缓存的智能体服务处于亚稳态。在相同的基础负载下，几分钟的额外到达就会让一个vLLM服务器进入退化状态——命中率约10%、吞吐量减半、且积压在其后70分钟内持续增长——而其无突发对照组保持健康（12对中有9对出现此现象，反向则无一发生）。该退化状态出现在缓存预热服务器本可承受的负载下，在没有前缀缓存时不会出现，并且在SWE-bench智能体轨迹形状上用Qwen3-32B以及在SGLang（其触发阈值更大）上也会出现。变慢的服务使更多会话滞留在系统中，其工作集超出KV池，每一轮都变成重算；一个经独立校准的一阶负载均衡条件界定了该退化状态何时可以排空。如何摆脱才是更难的问题：限制新请求准入仅恢复了7个匹配的崩溃运行中的1个，而基于容量上限挂起已准入会话则在几分钟内全部恢复。CPU offload分层能延迟崩溃但不能阻止它。一个将活跃会话驻留KV需求限制在池容量内的budgeter，其阈值无需按负载调优，在我们测试的所有运行中都阻止了该故障。
translation.brief: 研究前缀缓存智能体服务在短暂流量突发后陷入持续性退化的问题，提出通过容量限制挂起已准入会话并将活跃会话KV需求约束在池内的budgeter来阻止崩溃。

papers.title: Placing LLM Lookup Tables by Per-Layer Prefetch Deadlines
papers.abstract: DeepSeek-V4.1's 203 GB of Engram n-gram tables sit in host DRAM today, taking 190 of the 223 GiB a 4-GPU serving process uses. Row indices depend only on input tokens, so reads can start with each step and overlap earlier layers. V4.1's two Engram layers have windows that differ by 30x (0.3 vs. 9.3 ms). We show that this deadline, together with session reuse and contention on a shared device, decides which tier each table can use and which layers need cache, and we give a model that predicts the resulting slowdown from measured read times. Agent and chat traffic reuse rows within sessions, and static hot sets transfer poorly. We build SlackTier, a table tier for SGLang that issues all lookups at step start. It reads the short-window layer first and splits a small GPU row cache across layers. The path runs inside the decode CUDA graph and is bit-exact with the original gather. Layer 14's table can go to NVMe uncached with no measurable decode cost. With both tables on four NVMe disks, mean time per output token on agent and chat replays rises at most 1.4% over unmodified SGLang, and host memory falls from 212 to 34 GiB. Both tables need no cache when read over RDMA (remote direct memory access) from another node's memory; one copy serves two instances. On a KV-constrained agent workload, using the freed memory as host KV cache at the same memory budget raises median throughput by 36% and cuts median p90 time to first token from 38 to 24 s.

translation.title: 基于逐层预取截止时间的LLM查找表放置
translation.abstract: DeepSeek-V4.1的203 GB Engram n-gram表目前存放在主机DRAM中，占4-GPU服务进程所用223 GiB内存中的190 GiB。行索引只依赖输入token，因此读取可以在每步开始时发起并与更早的层重叠。V4.1的两个Engram层的窗口相差30倍（0.3对9.3毫秒）。我们证明这一截止时间，加上会话内复用与共享设备上的争用，决定了每张表可用的存储层级以及哪些层需要缓存，并给出一个由实测读取时间预测减速的模型。智能体与聊天流量在会话内复用行，静态热集迁移性差。我们构建了SlackTier，一个面向SGLang的表分层机制，在步开始时发起所有查找。它先读取短窗口层，并将一个小的GPU行缓存跨层切分。该路径运行在decode CUDA graph内，与原始gather比特级一致。第14层的表可放入不缓存的NVMe而无可测的decode开销。当两张表都放在四块NVMe磁盘上时，智能体与聊天回放的平均每输出token时间相比未修改SGLang最多上升1.4%，主机内存从212降至34 GiB。通过RDMA（远程直接内存访问）从另一节点内存读取时两张表都无需缓存；一份副本可服务两个实例。在一个KV受限的智能体负载上，将释放的内存用作用于主机KV缓存、在相同内存预算下中位吞吐量提升36%，并将中位p90首token时间从38秒降至24秒。
translation.brief: 解决n-gram查找表占用大量主机内存的问题，提出按逐层预取截止时间将表分层放置到NVMe或远端内存并共享小GPU缓存的方法SlackTier。

papers.title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. An 8-particle probe identifies the problems that benefit from more particles, and a two-pass policy matches 64-particle accuracy on MATH500 with 34.2% fewer particles over three seeds.

translation.title: 免费午餐的不确定性：粒子解码的序列级Rényi熵用于自适应LLM推理
translation.abstract: 量化整个LLM补全的不确定性对选择性预测和自适应计算至关重要。均值token熵和对数概率等零成本信号局限于token或单个补全，而self-consistency需要许多额外补全。我们证明幂采样的Sequential Monte Carlo（SMC）解码已经在估计幂分布的归一化常数，这以零边际成本给出模型补全分布的序列级Rényi熵（SRE），且在每个粒子预算下都有保证。一个Rényi链式法则将此读数扩展为任意阶数的分步熵族。我们证明阶数大于1的成员与每步最可能token相关，这解释了为何它们跟踪对数概率，而阶数1/2的成员累积每步搜索努力的对数。该成员在13个设置中的10个里是最佳的零成本选择性预测信号。在MATH500上，其AUROC比所有四个模型及各长度四分位内的对数概率高0.022到0.044，且在留出设置时仍选中相同阶数。一个8粒子探针识别出受益于更多粒子的问题，一个两遍策略以减少34.2%的粒子在三个种子上匹配了64粒子在MATH500上的准确率。
translation.brief: 解决LLM补全级不确定性量化成本高的问题，利用SMC解码已估计的归一化常数以零边际成本导出序列级Rényi熵作为选择性预测信号。

papers.title: BioMem: Agentic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.

translation.title: BioMem：面向生物医学LLM智能体的智能体记忆
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在生物医学应用中已展现出可观潜力，而智能体记忆系统已成为跨任务和交互保存与利用信息的一种有前景方法。然而一个根本问题仍然存在：这些系统在多大程度上有效且可靠地保留、检索、更新和利用生物医学信息？在本研究中，我们系统性地考察生物医学领域的智能体记忆，聚焦任务有效性、检索质量、信息保真度和长期鲁棒性。我们在三种代表性设置——生物医学知识推理、临床预测和长期对话记忆——下评估了四种LLM上的五种记忆方法。我们的分析揭示了记忆构建、证据相关性和对话历史如何塑造下游生物医学性能，凸显了检索相关信息、保持其保真度以及将其有效用于推理的独特挑战。基于这些发现，我们提出混合记忆检索与利用（HMRU），一个无需训练的框架，共同提升证据可及性和任务感知利用，以改进生物医学推理和长期对话记忆。HMRU在生物医学问答和对话记忆基准上平均相对提升8.6%，并在部分临床预测任务上有额外增益。它还将对话答案错误减少24.9%，并缩小了与全上下文推理之间48.0%的性能差距。我们的发现为生物医学智能体记忆提供了系统性刻画，并为开发更有效可靠的记忆增强LLM系统提供了实践洞见。
translation.brief: 系统评估生物医学LLM智能体记忆系统的有效性，并提出免训练的HMRU框架联合增强证据检索可及性与任务感知利用。

papers.title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Parallel drafters accelerate LLM decoding by proposing a whole block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, making them attractive for LLM serving. Recent systems optimize goodput (i.e., accepted tokens per second) because rejected drafts steal compute from other requests. However, these systems control only how many tokens are verified, so every request still drafts a full block. At high serving load, we find that drafting consumes up to 40% of step time, of which a majority is discarded because it is never verified. Yet, draft-length control from autoregressive drafters does not carry over, because a parallel drafter commits to its length before its single pass. Moreover, draft and verification lengths are coupled across the batch, so they must be selected jointly for every request while keeping the decision computationally cheap at every step. In this paper, we propose work-conserving speculation (WCS), a design that jointly allocates draft and verification budgets per request in LLM serving, and present ForeSpark as its prototype. ForeSpark realizes WCS with (i) a context-aware pre-draft estimator that predicts acceptance for every candidate length from the target model's context features, (ii) a lightweight joint draft-verify scheduler that selects both lengths through a global sort, and (iii) a post-draft budget distribution that spends verification on the most promising tokens. Implemented on vLLM, ForeSpark improves throughput by up to 1.77x over the state-of-the-art DSpark and by 2.49x over autoregressive decoding at a matched per-request generation rate, without changing the output distribution. It also tolerates higher load, sustaining up to 1.51x the request rate of DSpark under latency service level objectives (SLOs).

translation.title: ForeSpark：面向并行投机解码的草稿与验证预算联合调度
translation.abstract: 并行drafter通过单次前向传播提出整块草稿token来加速LLM解码，使其对LLM服务很有吸引力。近期系统优化goodput（即每秒被接受的token数），因为被拒绝的草稿会抢占其他请求的算力。然而这些系统只控制验证多少token，因此每个请求仍要起草完整块。在高服务负载下，我们发现drafting最多消耗40%的步时间，其中大部分因从未被验证而被丢弃。然而自回归drafter的草稿长度控制并不适用，因为并行drafter在其单次前向传播前就确定了长度。此外，draft和verification长度在batch内耦合，因此必须为每个请求联合选择，同时保持每步决策的计算开销低。本文提出work-conserving speculation（WCS），一种在LLM服务中按请求联合分配draft和verification预算的设计，并给出其原型ForeSpark。ForeSpark通过以下方式实现WCS：(i) 一个上下文感知的预draft估计器，从目标模型的上下文特征预测每个候选长度的接受率；(ii) 一个轻量级联合draft-verify调度器，通过全局排序同时选择两个长度；(iii) 一个post-draft预算分配，将验证开销花在最有希望的token上。实现于vLLM之上，ForeSpark在匹配的每请求生成速率下，吞吐量相比最先进的DSpark最高提升1.77倍，相比自回归解码提升2.49倍，且不改变输出分布。它还能承受更高负载，在延迟服务级别目标（SLO）下维持最高1.51倍于DSpark的请求速率。
translation.brief: 解决并行投机解码中草稿算力大量被丢弃的问题，提出ForeSpark按请求联合调度draft与验证预算的工作保持式投机设计。

papers.title: SLIC: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning Small LMs for Multi-Turn Analog Circuit Optimization
papers.abstract: Analog integrated circuit (IC) design is a multi-turn, simulator-grounded engineering task that demands iterative reasoning over coupled performance tradeoffs, yet proprietary process design kits (PDKs) make hosted large language model workflows difficult to deploy in practical design settings. We present SLIC (Small LM Iterating on Circuits), a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that trains a 4B-scale, locally deployable language model for closed-loop analog circuit optimization. SLIC pairs structured circuit representations with discretized relative-update actions, domain- and success-gated multiobjective rewards, and Reward-Guided Rollout Steering (RGRS), which turns per-step simulator feedback into signals for both policy learning and online rollout construction in this sparse, highly constrained domain. We further release an open, goal-conditioned benchmark of 41 amplifier topologies with standardized protocols for in-distribution validation, held-out topology evaluation, and cross-technology-node transfer. Trained solely with open source 65 nm CMOS predictive technology models (PTM), SLIC-Random achieves 87.1% in-distribution four-specification Pass@1 within eight turns, surpassing the 763B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Think by 48.5 percentage points. Beyond the training distribution, SLIC-Softmax reaches 72.6% Pass@1 on held-out topologies, and the trained policies consistently transfer across five unseen technology nodes without additional fine-tuning. This transfer extends to a commercial TSMC 65 nm CMOS PDK, where SLIC-Random achieves 49.9% held-out-topology Pass@1, demonstrating practical deployment through local inference without transmitting proprietary data to external LLM services. Performance further scales with test-time simulator interactions, reaching up to 83.2% held-out-topology Pass@1 at a 32-turn budget.

papers.title: SafeRoute-MAS: Coverage-Aware and Risk-Calibrated Message Routing for Multi-Agent Scientific Reasoning
papers.abstract: We introduce SafeRoute-MAS, a coverage-aware, risk-calibrated procedure that keeps all specialist messages or removes one using only pre-integration information. On a sealed cache of 5,328 committees, its source-compatible operating point gains +1.80 percentage points (95% CI [+1.13, +2.52]) while removing 12.76% of message tokens. We also run 4,580 controlled integrations over a stratified 458-committee sample on a public gpt-oss-120b endpoint. The sample estimate is -0.09 points; design weighting to the original workload gives +0.94 points (95% CI [-1.31, +3.50]) and 18.72% acted-input reduction. A weighted token-matched comparison likewise does not establish a selector advantage (+1.68 points, CI [-1.27, +5.10]). Only 13 of 88 cached non-neutral labels (14.8%) retain direction by repeated-call majority. Expected-corruption UCL is 4.60% after weighting, but only 2 of 11 prespecified marginals pass the support/risk rule. We therefore propose a numerical qualification with Keep-All fallback, applied here retrospectively rather than validated prospectively.

papers.title: Deep Personalization: Continuous Context Observation for Local Proactive Agents
papers.abstract: As AI agents become increasingly capable, users must still recognize when and how to ask for help, leaving many opportunities for useful support unrealized. Proactive agents hold the promise to close this gap, but effective proactivity requires understanding users' real-time activities and personalizing intervention timing so that assistance is offered when it is likely to be helpful rather than disruptive. We introduce deep personalization, a closed-loop process that connects continuous context observation with continual agent adaptation: an agent observes user activity, selectively retains long-term context, and adapts intervention decisions from implicit feedback. We initiate deep personalization in Coco, a proactive desktop agent, by having a separate Observer Agent that monitors desktop activity, maintains compact long-term user modeling context, and learns when assistance is desirable from implicit signals such as engagement, dismissal, explicit requests, and repeated work patterns. We further develop efficient on-device strategies to enable the Observer Agent to run on local AI compute platforms without streaming raw activity data off-device. For evaluation at scale without collecting sensitive real-user activity, we introduce a data-synthesis pipeline that transforms existing computer-use trajectories into OSWorld-Persona, a benchmark with persona-conditioned intervention labels. On OSWorld-Persona, deep personalization improves macro F1 across three model backbones from 0.12-0.19 under direct prompting to 0.35-0.48 after adaptation, a 2.4-3.0x relative gain. In a week-long user study, we observe that Coco improves its macro-averaged F1 score from 0.199 to 0.515. These results suggest that on-device deep personalization can make proactive agents more timely and increasingly aligned with each user's everyday work.

papers.title: An Empirical Study on Improving LLM-Based Issue Classification through Domain-Informed Analysis
papers.abstract: Issue reports that describe Intrinsic Bugs, Extrinsic Bugs, and Not a Bug cases often use similar language, but they might point to different causes and require different maintenance actions. This makes three-way issue classification difficult for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly when prompt-based refinements begin to plateau. We study whether domain-informed analysis of LLM outputs can improve classification beyond prompt modification alone. Using 428 manually labeled issue reports, we evaluate six LLMs across 18 prompt configurations and analyze 7,704 model-generated rationales to identify recurring failure patterns in how models justify predictions, use evidence, and handle conflicting information. We translate these findings into a multi-stage pipeline that separates bug validity from bug origin. The pipeline improves macro F1 and Extrinsic Bug recall for five of the six models. The strongest pipeline configuration reaches 0.827 accuracy and 0.757 Extrinsic Bug recall, improving over the best-accuracy prompt-only baseline by +1.2 and +7.5 pp, respectively. The decomposition further reveals that bug origin classification is more reliable than validity, indicating that the bug-validity decision accounts for most of the remaining error. These results show that expert failure analysis can support more reliable LLM-based software engineering classifiers.

papers.title: The WoW: A Large-Scale World Knowledge Corpus for Full-Lifecycle LLM Training
papers.abstract: Existing Chinese educational corpora often suffer from fragmented coverage and a lack of systematic organization. In this paper, we propose WoW (\textbf{Wo}rld Kno\textbf{w}ledge), a large-scale dataset designed for the full-cycle training of foundation models. The construction of this dataset is driven by an Educational Knowledge Graph, which serves as a taxonomic backbone for the systematic collection and completion of missing educational modules across all levels. Compared to previous versions, this iteration provides enhanced systematicity, superior quality, and a larger scale, while incorporating multimodal signals and supporting every stage of model development. Experiments demonstrate that WoW significantly improves model performance across diverse benchmarks. To facilitate community research, we further provide an interactive platform for graph-based data selection and retrieval.

papers.title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
papers.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot frontier models on five tasks, by up to 0.34, and match them on three more. Its search comes within 0.03 of exhaustively training all 27 model variants on an entity extraction task, while using 19$\times$ less GPU time. Phone measurements also matter: the best configuration changes across phones. Without phone measurements, Claude Opus 5.5, given the full hardware and model specifications, misses the app's requirements in 25\% of easy and moderate cases and in 60\% of hard ones. Code is available at: this https URL.

translation.title: Mobile AI Factory：为你的移动设备构建专用语言模型
translation.abstract: 在移动设备上运行的小语言模型（SLM）可以保护用户隐私并离线工作，但只有在针对目标任务微调并适配目标设备尺寸时才能表现良好，而这一过程目前需要反复的专家调优。我们提出 {	it Mobile AI Factory}，一个能够为特定任务和手机构建微调、量化 SLM 的智能体系统。给定任务规格和目标手机后，协调 LLM 决定是调优超参数、挖掘真实数据还是生成合成样本，同时固定规则会回滚损害准确率的更改。该工厂从小到大地在多个基础模型和量化方案中进行搜索，随搜索动态调整准确率目标，并在不同推理引擎和后端上使用目标手机的真实测量数据。我们在十个任务和四部 Android 手机上评估了 Mobile AI Factory。在未见过的测试集上，其端侧模型在五个任务上超越了两个五样本前沿模型，最大领先 0.34，并在另外三个任务上与之持平。在实体抽取任务上，其搜索结果与穷举训练全部 27 个模型变体的结果差距在 0.03 以内，而 GPU 时间减少 19 倍。手机测量数据也很重要：最佳配置会因手机而异。若没有手机测量数据，即使获知完整硬件和模型规格，Claude Opus 5.5 在简单和中等情形中仍有 25%、在困难情形中 60% 未能满足应用需求。代码见：this https URL。
translation.brief: 解决为特定任务和手机自动构建微调量化 SLM 需专家反复调优的问题，采用协调 LLM 结合固定回滚规则、自适应搜索及真机测量数据的智能体流水线。

papers.title: The RSI Tax: When Recursive Self-Improvement Is Not Worth the Cost
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to improve an agent using its own task experience. Its practical value depends on whether performance gains justify the full cost of self-improvement and task execution. We evaluate this trade-off on continual task streams, scoring each task before its feedback is used for subsequent updates. We define the \emph{RSI Tax} as the token cost of the self-improvement process and include it alongside task-execution costs in end-to-end evaluation. Across six methods and two language models, a bounded-note baseline matches or exceeds the observed accuracy of Meta-Harness, EvoSkill, and RRSI, with mean total-token savings of 65.6-71.0\%. We decompose the RSI Tax into verification, exploration, and writing costs, and track subsequent use of the associated state or artifact. For these three RSI methods, verification accounts for 74.8--93.6% of the aggregate RSI Tax. A substantial share of the RSI Tax is also associated with states or artifacts that are not used later in the evaluated streams. These results expose a practical limitation of costly RSI procedures: improvements in the deployed agent need not justify the expense of the improvement process. They motivate RSI objectives that jointly optimize the RSI Tax and expected task-execution cost while ensuring continued growth in agent capabilities across the task stream.

translation.title: RSI 税：递归自我改进何时得不偿失
translation.abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在利用智能体自身的任务经验来提升智能体。其实际价值取决于性能提升能否证明自我改进及任务执行的完整成本是值得的。我们在持续任务流上评估这一权衡，在每个任务的反馈被用于后续更新之前对其进行评分。我们将 RSI 税（RSI Tax）定义为自我改进过程的 token 成本，并将其与任务执行成本一起纳入端到端评估。在六种方法和两个语言模型上，一个受限笔记基线在观测准确率上持平或超过 Meta-Harness、EvoSkill 和 RRSI，平均总 token 节省 65.6–71.0%。我们将 RSI 税分解为验证、探索和写作成本，并追踪相关状态或制品的后续使用。对这三种 RSI 方法而言，验证占 RSI 税总量的 74.8–93.6%。RSI 税中相当一部分也与在评估任务流中后续未被使用的状态或制品相关。这些结果揭示了高成本 RSI 流程的实际局限：对已部署智能体的改进未必能证明改进过程的开销是值得的。这促使我们提出同时优化 RSI 税和预期任务执行成本、并确保智能体能力在任务流上持续增长的 RSI 目标。
translation.brief: 解决 RSI 自我改进成本是否值得的问题，通过在持续任务流上端到端核算自我改进的 token 成本（RSI Tax）并与基线对比评估。

papers.title: EJAI: Judgment-Preserving Civic AI for Data Center Environmental Justice
papers.abstract: Communities in the United States and around the world are contesting data centers, the physical infrastructure of AI. These disputes pose environmental justice issues: residents must weigh unevenly distributed burdens using evidence scattered across metrics, corporate claims, policy documents, and public testimony. A formative study with 10 users showed that dashboards and single-agent AI can settle questions before people examine that evidence. Here we present EJAI, a source-grounded system that links an interactive map, retrieved evidence, missing-data statements, and two stakeholder personas that allow people to inspect evidence and form their own policy recommendations. In a small functional benchmark of 21 queries, retrieved evidence supported 98.4% of factual claims and the system acknowledged missing evidence in 32 of 33 cases. Persona alignment carried a grounding cost: the Corporate Executive omitted some evidence that conflicted with its assigned priorities. In a within-subjects study, 15 participants acting as residents prepared for a simulated town hall. Some checked cited AI claims while treating map metrics as official, some made conditional recommendations with safeguards such as water-use disclosure, and some found the personas simplified or biased. Our results suggest that civic AI can support preparation for public reasoning when it makes evidence, gaps, and disagreement open to inspection, and that corpus imbalance and two-sided personas remain open justice concerns.

translation.title: EJAI：面向数据中心环境正义的保留判断力的公民 AI
translation.abstract: 美国及世界各地的社区正在抵制数据中心——AI 的物理基础设施。这些争议涉及环境正义问题：居民需要依据散落在各项指标、企业声明、政策文件和公开证词中的证据，权衡分布不均的负担。一项针对 10 位用户的形成性研究表明，仪表盘和单智能体 AI 会在人们审视证据之前就下结论。我们提出 EJAI，一个基于来源的系统，它将交互式地图、检索到的证据、缺失数据声明以及两个利益相关者角色persona 相结合，使人们能够检验证据并形成自己的政策建议。在一个包含 21 个查询的小型功能基准中，检索到的证据支持了 98.4% 的事实性声明，且系统在 33 例中的 32 例承认了证据缺失。角色对齐带来了基于证据的代价：企业高管角色省略了与其被指派优先级相冲突的部分证据。在一项被试内研究中，15 名参与者扮演居民为模拟市政厅会议做准备。一些参与者核查 AI 引用的声明，同时将地图指标视为官方数据；一些参与者提出带有用水披露等保障措施的条件性建议；另一些参与者认为角色设定过于简化或带有偏见。结果表明，当公民 AI 使证据、缺口和分歧均可被审视时，它能够支持公众推理的准备；而语料不平衡和双边角色设定仍是待解决的正义问题。
translation.brief: 解决居民评估数据中心环境正义争议时证据分散、易被 AI 过早定论的问题，提出结合交互地图、来源可溯证据与利益相关者角色、保留用户自主判断的 EJAI 系统。

papers.title: Framing-Induced Vulnerability in Large Language Models: Evidence from Chinese News Headlines
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly evaluate, route, and moderate news, so a model's judgment of a headline has become a gatekeeping decision. We ask whether that judgment follows the fact being reported or the way the fact is framed. We combine an ecological audit of 63,926 Chinese news headlines with a controlled experiment. The experiment covers 30 real events, 30 synthetic events, and 29 natural headline pairs, tested on four Chinese models. Changing only the headline frame shifted both perceived misleadingness and event severity, and the direction and ordering of the shifts were the same for DeepSeek, MiMo, Dots, and LongCat. Emotionally intensified headlines raised severity ratings by 0.65 to 0.88 points, whereas positively reframed headlines lowered them by 0.34 to 0.52 points. Supplying the article body reduced this severity bias by 54 to 80 percent, and all four reductions were significant at p < .01. A small human reference study showed the same direction of effect. Headline-only LLM evaluation therefore carries a measurable robustness gap, and framing sensitivity belongs among the reliability properties that deployment and governance check.

translation.title: 大语言模型中的框架效应脆弱性：来自中文新闻标题的证据
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地承担新闻的评估、路由和审核工作，因此模型对标题的判断已成为一种把关决策。我们探讨这种判断究竟遵循所报道的事实，还是事实被呈现的方式。我们结合了对 63,926 条中文新闻标题的生态审计与一项受控实验。实验覆盖 30 个真实事件、30 个合成事件和 29 对自然标题对，在四个中文模型上测试。仅改变标题框架即可改变感知的误导性和事件严重性，且 DeepSeek、MiMo、Dots 和 LongCat 的变化方向和排序一致。情绪强化的标题使严重性评分上升 0.65 至 0.88 分，而正面重构的标题使其下降 0.34 至 0.52 分。提供文章正文可使这种严重性偏差降低 54% 到 80%，且四项降低均在 p < .01 水平上显著。一项小型人类参照研究显示相同方向的效果。因此，仅基于标题的 LLM 评估存在可测量的鲁棒性缺口，框架敏感性应被纳入部署与治理所检查的可靠性属性之中。
translation.brief: 研究新闻标题框架是否会扭曲 LLM 对误导性和严重性的判断，通过对中文标题的生态审计与跨四个模型的受控实验量化框架效应。

papers.title: Exploiting Feature-invariant Scaling Laws for Efficient A/B Experimentation in Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract: Researchers and engineers improve recommendation systems by performing A/B experiments with new model architectures, optimization methods, and data features. However, running full-scale experiments (e.g., full-model training with online data) for every feature change is prohibitively computationally intensive, while the result from a single small-scale experiment is often misleading. To address this challenge, we show that modern recommendation models exhibit feature-invariant scaling: the change of a model's performance follows a predictable scaling-law even when different feature changes are applied to the baseline model. We introduce an efficient method that exploits scaling-laws and uses statistical inference to predict (with confidence intervals) the full-scale effect of an A/B experiment in recommendation systems. This enables practitioners to efficiently filter out neutral or regressive feature changes with only small-scale experimentation. We validate our method on three distinct recommendation model families---Wukong, HSTU, and LLM-based recommendation models---across more than 40 architectural, optimization, and data changes. Our method accurately distinguishes beneficial feature changes from neutral and regressive ones while using only a fraction of the compute required for full-scale evaluation. It also identifies several changes that improve HSTU's state-of-the-art performance on MovieLens-20M. Our results demonstrate that scaling laws can be practically exploited to make compute-efficient decisions for improving industrial-scale recommendation systems.

translation.title: 利用特征不变缩放定律实现推荐系统中高效的 A/B 实验
translation.abstract: 研究者和工程师通过 A/B 实验评估新的模型架构、优化方法和数据特征来改进推荐系统。然而，为每次特征变更进行全规模实验（如使用在线数据的完整模型训练）的计算开销过高，而单次小规模实验的结果往往具有误导性。为应对这一挑战，我们展示现代推荐模型具有特征不变缩放特性：即使对基线模型应用不同的特征变更，模型性能的变化仍遵循可预测的缩放定律。我们提出一种利用缩放定律并结合统计推断的方法，以预测（带置信区间）推荐系统中 A/B 实验的全规模效果。这使从业者能够仅通过小规模实验高效过滤中性或退化的特征变更。我们在三个不同的推荐模型族——Wukong、HSTU 和基于 LLM 的推荐模型——上验证了该方法，涵盖超过 40 种架构、优化和数据变更。我们的方法能准确区分有益的特征变更与中性及退化的变更，同时仅使用全规模评估所需计算量的一小部分。它还识别出若干改进 HSTU 在 MovieLens-20M 上最先进性能的变更。我们的结果表明，缩放定律可被实际利用，以实现计算高效的决策来改进工业级推荐系统。
translation.brief: 解决推荐系统特征变更全规模 A/B 实验计算开销过高的问题，提出利用特征不变缩放定律结合统计推断从小规模实验预测全规模效果的方法。

papers.title: AgenticConflictLens: From Long Traffic Videos to Verifiable Conflict Evidence
papers.abstract: Traffic cameras continuously record urban road-user behavior, providing proactive safety evidence beyond crash reports. Yet safety-critical events - conflicts, near misses, unsafe turns, sudden braking, and crosswalk interactions - are rare and brief, buried in hours of routine footage. Existing traffic-video pipelines extract detections, trajectories, and risk scores but process footage uniformly, without adapting to an analyst's query. Vision-language methods improve scene understanding but often lack traffic-specific verification of participant-level conflicts. We introduce AgenticConflictLens, an agentic, query-conditioned framework for efficient, auditable conflict extraction from long fixed-camera traffic videos. Given a natural-language safety query, a Traffic-Aware Controller combines structured traffic memory with specialized conflict-analysis tools to choose where to search, which road users to examine, and which evidence to verify or reject. A coarse-to-fine search retrieves candidate intervals and applies detailed verification selectively. The framework produces conflict records with refined time intervals, participant pairs, semantic regions, trajectories, motion evidence, uncertainty, rejection reasons, and supporting clips. On 96 annotated hours from Bellevue and NYC DOT, AgenticConflictLens achieves the highest conflict-existence F1 and temporal IoU on both datasets: 0.84 F1/0.77 tIoU on Bellevue and 0.80 F1/0.73 tIoU on NYC DOT, while inspecting only 8.7% and 11.9% of video, respectively. These results support scalable, evidence-grounded urban traffic-safety analysis.

papers.title: Agent Benchmarks Stop Ranking Before They Run Out of Tasks
papers.abstract: Data-science and ML-engineering agents are evaluated on benchmarks such as MLE-bench, ALE-Bench, SWE-fficiency and AlgoTune, whose tasks yield a quantity (a Kaggle metric, contest score or speedup). When one stops separating the best models, the usual remedy is a harder version. Re-scoring released runs of eight benchmarks, including SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench for breadth, we find much of this saturation lies in the measurement, not the tasks. Most agent benchmarks reduce a run to one pass/fail bit, which fails in two ways. It is too coarse: neighbouring top-ten agents on SWE-bench Verified differ by less than its tests' errors, and correcting them reorders neighbours no more than deleting a random sixth of each agent's passes. It is capped at the reference: ALE-Bench's top ten, separated by contest score, tie when graded against the median human, although nearly half the runs beat that human. On fixed tasks, a higher bar only moves the problem; graded credit fixes it. We derive a clipped log-ratio score with dated anchors and cost as a separate axis. In a Terminal-Bench re-run, pass/fail-tied models differ over tenfold on the quantity the tests discard.

papers.title: Navigating relational agency in AI feedback musicianship: a diffractive dialogue
papers.abstract: Musical AI systems behave in non-linear, dynamic ways that exceed the tool-oriented framings inherited from earlier instrument design. Existing frames of control and ensemble interaction do not articulate the entangled, relational agency that emerges when performers work with AI feedback instruments over time. We examine a duet practice with two AI-enabled feedback instruments, Sù and Agentier, in which feedback operates at the inner level of the AI's recurrent processes and the outer loop of musical interaction between performer, instrument, and co-performer. Our work draws on agential realism and a diffractive dialogue methodology to read our independent reflections through one another across five performances, examining how agency is enacted between performers and AI instruments. We find that control and agency are relational and shift across performances; musical textures enact feedback moments of control with performers; reaching a productive feedback environment is itself a shared exploratory act; and performers maintain their instruments through funnelling and injection, developing the skill of navigating agency along a continuous spectrum. Feedback musicianship with AI instruments demands navigation of this relational agency, displacing the leading-versus-responding binary that initially framed our reflections. This work contributes a materially-grounded vocabulary for AI feedback musicianship and a model of human-AI creative collaboration in which mutual agency is worked for through practice rather than designed in.

papers.title: Discovering Structurally Plausible and Interpretable Cognitive Models with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Computational cognitive modeling has traditionally relied on manual model construction, which is a time-intensive process that requires substantial domain expertise. Although recent LLM-based approaches have begun to automate model generation, they often prioritize predictive accuracy at the expense of structural plausibility and parameter identifiability. We introduce DisCo, an LLM-guided framework that discovers interpretable symbolic cognitive models through evolutionary search with two structural components: a Validator that filters structurally invalid models, and a Cleaner that promotes parameter identifiability by removing redundant parameters. Across three behavioral tasks, DisCo consistently discovers models that achieve performance competitive with task-specific baselines. Ablation analyses show that the Validator is important for recovering psychologically meaningful structure. Without this component, models tend to violate behavioral constraints and show less consistent associations with external cognitive measures. These results suggest that LLM-driven model discovery, when coupled with appropriate structural constraints, can yield cognitively plausible models that go beyond predictive fit.

papers.title: An evidence-traceable benchmark of clinical reasoning in large language models
papers.abstract: Benchmark scores for medical large language models (LLMs) are difficult to interpret when scoring criteria cannot be traced to clinical evidence. Here we developed Med Evidence Bench (MEB; this https URL), comprising 1,536 physician-constructed items across three levels: guideline knowledge, standardized clinical scenarios and real-world laboratory scenarios. Each criterion stating a medical claim is linked to a versioned source-text span. Across ten LLMs, the Evidence Trace Score (ETS) was 0.975-0.997 for guideline knowledge, 0.292-0.658 for standardized scenarios and 0.182-0.447 for real-world scenarios, and rankings varied across levels. For real-world scenarios, scores for identifying clinical information (mean, 0.770) exceeded those for matching evidence (0.165) or formulating recommendations (0.160). On 1,296 criterion-level judgments, automated grading agreed with the majority vote of three physicians (macro-F1, 0.930; 95% confidence interval, 0.915-0.945), although agreement was lower for evidence application. These findings from Chinese-language materials indicate that guideline recall does not ensure patient-specific evidence use and do not establish clinical effectiveness.

Across ten LLMs, the Evidence Trace Score (ETS) was 0.975-0.997 for guideline knowledge, 0.292-0.658 for standardized scenarios and 0.182-0.447 for real-world scenarios, and rankings varied across levels. For real-world scenarios, scores for identifying clinical information (mean, 0.770) exceeded those for matching evidence (0.165) or formulating recommendations (0.160). On 1,296 criterion-level judgments, automated grading agreed with the majority vote of three physicians (macro-F1, 0.930; 95% confidence interval, 0.915-0.945), although agreement was lower for evidence application. These findings from Chinese-language materials indicate that guideline recall does not ensure patient-specific evidence use and do not establish clinical effectiveness.

papers.title: TERM: Target-Free Jailbreak Defense via Entropy-Guided Residual Modulation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across diverse applications, making both safety and utility essential for reliable deployment. Jailbreak attacks use diverse forms of adversarial prompting to bypass alignment safeguards and induce LLMs to generate harmful responses. Some representation-based defenses regulate internal activations using predefined steering directions or learned safety regions. However, adapting intervention to each input without a predefined representational target while limiting over-refusal remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose Target-free Entropy-guided Residual Modulation (TERM), an inference-time defense that uses prompt-calibrated attention entropy deviations to guide adaptive modulation of the model's own residual updates. Attention patterns vary across prompts and decoding steps, making raw entropy values difficult to interpret as a consistent signal for intervention. We therefore calibrate attention entropy against each prompt's own prefill baseline to establish an input-specific reference for reducing unnecessary intervention on benign requests. Adaptive scale normalization and temporal accumulation then account for differences in deviation scale and persistence to determine intervention strength. The resulting signal controls bounded scaling of the model's own residual updates, without relying on a predefined safety direction. We compare our method with seven defenses on seven jailbreak attacks and two over-refusal benchmarks across Llama, Qwen, and Gemma models, including Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B. Results show our method improves jailbreak robustness while maintaining low over-refusal on benign safety-sensitive requests with modest inference overhead.

translation.title: TERM：基于熵引导残差调制的无目标越狱防御方法
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在多种应用中展现出强大能力，因此安全性与实用性对可靠部署都至关重要。越狱攻击利用多样化的对抗性提示绕过对齐防护，诱导LLM生成有害回应。一些基于表示的防御方法使用预定义的引导方向或学习得到的安全区域来调控内部激活。然而，如何在没有预定义表示目标的情况下针对每个输入自适应地施加干预，同时限制过度拒绝，仍然是一个挑战。本文提出无目标熵引导残差调制（TERM），这是一种推理时防御方法，利用针对提示校准的注意力熵偏差来引导对模型自身残差更新的自适应调制。注意力模式随提示和解码步骤而变化，使得原始熵值难以作为一致的干预信号来解读。因此，我们针对每个提示自身的prefill基线校准注意力熵，建立输入特定的参考，以减少对良性请求的不必要干预。随后通过自适应尺度归一化和时间累积来考虑偏差的尺度与持续性差异，以确定干预强度。最终得到的信号控制模型自身残差更新的有界缩放，而无需依赖预定义的安全方向。我们在Llama、Qwen和Gemma模型（包括0.6B至32B的Qwen3模型）上，将本方法与七种防御方法在七种越狱攻击和两个过度拒绝基准上进行比较。结果表明，本方法在提升越狱鲁棒性的同时，对良性安全敏感请求保持较低的过度拒绝，且推理开销适中。
translation.brief: 针对LLM越狱攻击防御中难以按输入自适应干预的问题，提出在推理时用提示校准的注意力熵偏差引导模型自身残差更新有界缩放的无目标防御方法TERM。

papers.title: Transformers Provably Learn Graph Search: Training Dynamics and the Exponential Power of Depth
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress on complex reasoning tasks, yet the mechanisms by which they acquire reasoning capabilities and the efficiency of their reasoning remain poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the path-finding problem over directed graphs, a symbolic abstraction of multi-step reasoning. We first characterize the architectural requirements for this task, proving that one-layer transformers require $\Omega(N^2)$ size on dense graphs to implement the key DFS child-selection primitive. While a two-layer transformer implements full DFS with $O(N\log(N))$ size. Thus, a second layer is necessary and sufficient for near-linear DFS reasoning. We then extend this expressivity analysis to deeper models: for every $k\geq3$, a $k$-layer transformer implements a bounded-reachability DFS policy with look-ahead horizon $1+2^{k-3}$, establishing an exponential increase in reachability horizon with depth. Finally, going beyond expressivity, given appropriately curated training data, we show that two-layer transformers can provably learn to execute DFS via gradient flow and generalize to unseen graphs. Together, our results provide a mechanistic account of how transformers implement graph search, how depth expands bounded look-ahead, and how such reasoning algorithms can emerge through training.

translation.title: Transformer可证明地学习图搜索：训练动力学与深度的指数级威力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在复杂推理任务上取得了显著进展，但其获取推理能力的机制及推理效率仍知之甚少。本文研究有向图上的路径寻找问题，这是多步推理的一种符号化抽象。我们首先刻画了完成该任务所需的架构条件，证明单层Transformer在稠密图上需要$\Omega(N^2)$规模才能实现关键的DFS子节点选择原语，而两层Transformer只需$O(N\log(N))$规模即可实现完整DFS。因此，第二层对于近线性DFS推理既是必要的也是充分的。随后我们将这种表达能力分析扩展到更深的模型：对每个$k\geq3$，$k$层Transformer可实现前瞻范围（look-ahead horizon）为$1+2^{k-3}$的有界可达性DFS策略，表明可达范围随深度呈指数增长。最后，超越表达能力层面，在适当构造的训练数据下，我们证明两层Transformer可以通过梯度流可证明地学会执行DFS并泛化到未见过的图。这些结果共同为Transformer如何实现图搜索、深度如何扩展有界前瞻、以及此类推理算法如何通过训练涌现提供了机制性解释。
translation.brief: 针对Transformer如何习得图搜索推理能力的问题，通过对有向图寻路任务的表达能力与训练动力学分析，证明深度带来指数级前瞻扩展且两层Transformer可经梯度流学会DFS。

papers.title: IFRS Compliance Verification: An Open Multi-LLM Benchmark and Content-Conditioned Ensemble Classifier
papers.abstract: Verifying corporate financial disclosures against the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) is a core auditing task in which experts cross-reference disclosures with hundreds of fine-grained regulatory paragraphs: a laborious, costly, and error-prone process that motivates growing interest in large language models (LLMs) as compliance assistants. Yet single-model accuracy remains insufficient for high-stakes use, and naive ensembling is vulnerable to systematic per-model biases that can drag aggregate accuracy below that of the strongest individual annotator. This gap is addressed with a multi-stage framework, supported by a new benchmark of 19,998 IFRS regulation-disclosure pairs comprising 11,161 unanimous multi-LLM labels and 8,837 human annotations on items where the LLMs disagreed. The framework couples a three-stage domain-adapted sentence embedding pipeline (BERT masked language modeling on SEC EDGAR filings, unsupervised TSDAE and SimCSE adaptation, and supervised contrastive alignment) with a learned ensemble classifier that fuses frozen embeddings and LLM probability features from GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Pro via Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) optimized gradient-boosted trees. On the disagreement set, the ensemble achieves 81.7% weighted F1, exceeding the strongest single LLM by 10.4 points and majority voting by 14.6 points, and outperforms eleven unsupervised aggregation baselines; the retrieval pipeline attains Recall@15 of 45.3% on unseen regulations. The dataset, model checkpoints, annotation platform, and classifier implementation will be publicly released.

translation.title: IFRS合规性核验：开放多LLM基准与内容条件化集成分类器
translation.abstract: 依据国际财务报告准则（IFRS）核验企业财务披露是一项核心审计任务，专家需将披露内容与数百条细粒度监管条文交叉比对：这是一个费力、昂贵且易出错的过程，因此人们日益关注将大语言模型（LLM）用作合规助手。然而单模型准确率尚不足以满足高风险场景的使用需求，而简单的集成方法容易受到各模型系统性偏差的影响，可能使总体准确率低于最强的单个标注者。本文通过一个多阶段框架弥补这一缺口，并构建了一个包含19,998条IFRS法规-披露对的新基准，其中包含11,161条多LLM一致标注和8,837条针对LLM分歧样本的人工标注。该框架将三阶段领域适配的句子嵌入流水线（在SEC EDGAR文件上进行BERT掩码语言建模、无监督TSDAE和SimCSE适配、以及有监督对比对齐）与一个学习型集成分类器相结合，后者通过TPE（Tree-structured Parzen Estimator）优化的梯度提升树，融合GPT-4.1、Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro的冻结嵌入与LLM概率特征。在分歧集上，集成方法取得81.7%的加权F1，超过最强单个LLM 10.4分、超过多数投票14.6分，并优于十一种无监督聚合基线；检索流水线在未见过的法规上达到45.3%的Recall@15。数据集、模型检查点、标注平台和分类器实现将公开发布。
translation.brief: 针对IFRS合规核验中单模型准确率不足的问题，构建多LLM合规基准并提出三阶段领域嵌入流水线加TPE优化梯度提升树融合多模型特征的集成分类器。

papers.title: One Byte, One Token: Byteifying a 27B Hybrid-Attention LLM with Self-Generated Data
papers.abstract: Byte-level BPE fragments Chinese text (for Qwen3.8 on Chinese Wikipedia, 3.84 bytes per token on average; 64% of tokens are single characters) and hides spelling from the model. We ask whether an already-trained 27B subword model can be converted directly into a pure byte-level model (one byte, one token), without a patching structure or a local encoder, while keeping most of its ability. Starting from Qwen3.8-27B (48 Gated DeltaNet layers + 16 full-attention layers), we shrink the vocabulary from 248,320 to 384 entries (the 256 byte symbols already in the BPE vocabulary plus special ids), leave every other weight untouched, and continue training in a two-stage curriculum (encoding first, then reading) on 4.77 GB of supervised bytes: all dialogue/behavioral supervision is generated on-policy by the original model itself (character dictionary, word dictionary, general dialogue, coding sessions), and knowledge reading uses encyclopedia text (54% of supervised bytes). Training takes 178.6 h on 8xH200. On the same GPU and serving stack, the byte model's gap to the original falls within the paired bootstrap interval on MATH-500, HumanEval+, MMLU-Pro and non-thinking GSM8K, and it loses 4-6 points on C-Eval, thinking-mode GSM8K and non-thinking IFEval. Without thinking it leads on every character-level task (CUTE 75.2 -> 84.0, EXECUTE-zho 81.6 -> 93.9, our Chinese character suite 54.4 -> 64.0), but lookup knowledge about Chinese characters such as pronunciation and stroke count drops, and thinking does not recover it. The cost is throughput: per-step speed is identical, but each step yields 3-5x less output; Chinese characters per second is about 1/4 of the original, and prefill at 64K bytes is 6.5x slower. We also document four byte-model failure modes (greedy runaway, sampling breaking UTF-8, ineffective penalty terms on a small vocabulary, repetition) and their fixes.

translation.title: 一字节一Token：利用自生成数据将27B混合注意力LLM字节化
translation.abstract: 字节级BPE会碎片化中文文本（在中文维基百科上Qwen3.8平均每token为3.84字节，64%的token为单字符），并对模型隐藏拼写信息。我们探究一个已训练好的27B子词模型能否直接转换为纯字节级模型（一字节一token），无需打补丁结构或局部编码器，同时保留其大部分能力。从Qwen3.8-27B（48层Gated DeltaNet + 16层全注意力）出发，我们将词表从248,320缩减至384个条目（BPE词表中已有的256个字节符号加上特殊id），其余所有权重保持不变，并在4.77 GB的有监督字节数据上进行两阶段课程继续训练（先编码后阅读）：所有对话/行为监督均由原模型自身on-policy生成（字符词典、词语词典、通用对话、编码会话），知识阅读使用百科文本（占有监督字节的54%）。训练在8xH200上耗时178.6小时。在相同GPU和服务栈下，字节模型与原模型在MATH-500、HumanEval+、MMLU-Pro和非思考模式GSM8K上的差距落在配对bootstrap区间内，在C-Eval、思考模式GSM8K和非思考模式IFEval上下降4-6分。非思考模式下它在所有字符级任务上领先（CUTE 75.2 -> 84.0，EXECUTE-zho 81.6 -> 93.9，我们的汉字套件54.4 -> 64.0），但汉字发音、笔画数等查表型知识下降，思考模式也无法恢复。代价是吞吐量：每步速度相同，但每步产出减少3-5倍；每秒生成的汉字数约为原来的1/4，64K字节的prefill慢6.5倍。我们还记录了字节模型的四种失败模式（贪心失控、采样破坏UTF-8、小词表上惩罚项失效、重复）及其修复方法。
translation.brief: 针对BPE分词对中文碎片化并隐藏拼写的问题，通过缩减词表至字节级并用模型自生成数据两阶段继续训练，将Qwen3.8-27B直接转换为保留大部分能力的纯字节级LLM。

papers.title: Megrez: A Knowledge-Guided Agent for Formal Mathematics over MK Set Theory
papers.abstract: General-purpose coding agents equipped with proof-assistant tools have shown strong performance on standalone competition problems, yet cumulative textbook formalization inside a low-resource mathematical library still faces three obstacles: aligning textbook concepts with library declarations, keeping long-horizon search synchronized with live proof states, and integrating locally verified proofs reliably into a growing codebase. We present Megrez, a knowledge-guided formalization agent for Rocq libraries built on Morse--Kelley (MK) set theory. Megrez coordinates a general coding agent through three mechanisms: (1) a source-rebuildable knowledge graph merging formal declarations, compiler references, and curated metadata to support retrieval via Chinese aliases, concept clusters, proof dependencies, and multi-lane full-text ranking; (2) a feedback-driven 1--5 tactic short-burst proving loop paired with a goal-local branch ledger and exponential-interval structured reflection; and (3) a three-check acceptance pipeline (statement fidelity, axiom auditing, and full builds) coupled with a multi-corpus Provider stack and a candidate-bound recoverable batch state machine. Deployment and evaluation on a point-set topology corpus demonstrate effective cross-chapter formalization and scalable premise retrieval.

papers.title: Synapse-Control: Making Agent Experience Actionable with Lightweight Runtime Control
papers.abstract: Large language model agents reuse execution experience to improve reliability on complex tool-based tasks. Systems such as Sentry call large models to generate failure diagnoses before retrieving advice, adding inference cost to experience reuse. We present Synapse-Control, an agent runtime whose lightweight control plane selects advice and determines when to send it to the task-executing model. Rules shortlist relevant advice, and a lightweight 1.7B classifier fine-tuned on teacher-labeled state-suggestion pairs scores those candidates instead of generating a diagnosis. Micro-contracts encode reusable interface checks, such as required arguments or valid options, without prescribing complete task programs. A Prompt Value Table records earlier guidance and feedback to limit repeated suggestions through cooldown and token-budget checks. Across 1,308 attempts per method in AppWorld and WebShop, Synapse-Control achieves 270 successes (29.8% more than Base), replaces 4,987 generative diagnosis calls, and reduces auxiliary control time relative to Sentry by 50.2% and 51.0%, respectively.

papers.title: MOAI: Module-Optimizing Architecture for non-interactive secure transformer Inference
papers.abstract: Privacy concerns have been raised in Large Language Models (LLM) inference when models are deployed in Cloud Service Providers (CSP). Homomorphic encryption (HE) offers a promising solution by enabling secure inference directly over encrypted inputs. However, the high computational overhead of HE remains a major bottleneck. To address this challenge, we propose MOAI, an efficient HE-based, non-interactive framework for secure transformer inference. MOAI gains significant efficiency improvement from: (1) a novel evaluation flow that combines column and diagonal packing with consistent strategies across all layers, eliminating expensive format conversions. (2) rotation-free algorithms for Softmax and LayerNorm that significantly reduce the number of costly HE rotations, removing 2,448 HE rotations in BERT-base inference. (3) Column packing removes rotations in plaintext-ciphertext matrix multiplications and interleaved batching further reduces the rotations in ciphertext-ciphertext matrix multiplications. MOAI uses at least 1.7x fewer HE rotations compared to the state-of-the-art works across all matrix multiplications of BERT-base. As a result, we achieve a $52.8 \%$ reduction in evaluation time compared to the state-of-the-art HE-based non-interactive secure transformer inference, THOR (Moon et al., CCS 25). We then apply MOAI on the Powerformer's framework and achieve a $55.7 \%$ reduction in evaluation time compared to Powerformer (Park et al., ACL 25), which approximates Softmax and LayerNorm with simpler functions in transformer and proposes HE-based non-interactive transformer inference. We report an amortized time of 2.36 minutes per input on a single GPU environment. We show the extendibility by applying MOAI in LLaMA-3-8B. Our implementation is publicly available as open source.

papers.title: Tri-Stack-PIM: A Heterogeneous Multi-Die 3D-Integrated Processing-in-Memory Architecture for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference during autoregressive decoding is fundamentally memory-bandwidth-bound. Existing three-dimensional (3D) stacked processing-in-memory (PIM) architectures alleviate the off-chip bandwidth wall, yet remain constrained by several limitations: physical layer (PHY), controllers, and direct memory access (DMA) engines compete with arithmetic units for advanced-node base-die area; hybrid-bonding keep-out zones fragment the base-die floorplan and impede physical design; compute tiles built in a dynamic random access memory (DRAM) process are restricted to low logic density, capping achievable throughput; and nonlinear operations offloaded to the host reintroduce a communication bottleneck. We present Tri-Stack-PIM, a heterogeneous three-die architecture that resolves these tensions by dedicating a top DRAM die to storage, a middle buffer die on a mature process node to PHYs, DMA engines, and near-memory compute units, and a bottom base die on an advanced node exclusively to single-instruction-multiple-data (SIMD) multiply-accumulate (MAC) arrays. We further introduce a Unified Buffer-Aware Ready-based (UBAR) hardware out-of-order micro-operation scheduler that enforces cross-die dependency correctness at runtime while maximizing issue-slot utilization through a multi-term priority function, recovering up to 90% of the cycles that an in-order policy would forfeit. A joint architecture-dataflow co-exploration identifies Pareto-optimal configurations that reduce the energy-delay product (EDP) by 33-66x over naive parameter selection. Evaluated across multi-head, grouped-query, and multi-query attention (MHA, GQA, MQA) mechanisms with batch sizes 1-32, Tri-Stack-PIM achieves geometric-mean speedups of 4.95x, 2.57x, and 1.68x across all three attention mechanisms and batch sizes over a graphics processing unit (GPU) baseline, AttAcc, and H2-LLM, respectively.

papers.title: DrugCoding: A Scientific Programming Agent for Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: Drug discovery involves multiple interconnected research stages, including molecular design, property prediction, and virtual screening. These processes are characterized by complex workflows, interdependent computational tasks, and diverse specialized tools, placing substantial demands on the coordination of scientific models and computational resources. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents still face challenges in autonomous planning of complex tasks, adaptive selection of specialized models, and reliable execution of multi-stage scientific computations, limiting their effectiveness in automating complex drug discovery workflows. To address these challenges, we propose DrugCoding, a scientific programming agent system that integrates scientific task planning, adaptive model routing, multi-agent collaboration, and programmatic tool execution. DrugCoding enables autonomous task planning and dynamic model adaptation for complex research objectives. It can flexibly invoke specialized scientific models, autonomously generate and execute code according to task requirements, and leverage multi-agent collaboration to support efficient execution and reliable validation of complex scientific tasks. To evaluate DrugCoding's performance in scientific tool invocation and multi-stage task execution, we conduct multi-turn tool-calling experiments across diverse language models and scientific tool interfaces. Experimental results demonstrate that DrugCoding achieves an average session-level Pass@1 of 97.35% on the full benchmark, outperforming the strongest baseline, Codex, by 9.24%. On the challenging subset, DrugCoding achieves 97.92%, exceeding the strongest baseline.

papers.title: How Well Do Benchmarks Evaluate LLMs' Use for Personal Health Informatics?
papers.abstract: Benchmarking is a valuable technique for advancing the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), including in personal health informatics. There are growing efforts on benchmark creation for personal health data activities. However, it is unclear whether and how well these efforts align with needs and considerations of personal health informatics process. Addressing this need, we first analyzed 53,587 tasks across eight benchmarks related to personal health informatics and characterized the space of benchmark design. We then contrasted our observations of design choices with personal informatics theories and empirical knowledge. We find significant mismatches between existing benchmark design and domain guidelines and understanding. This lack of alignment limits the utility of the evidence current benchmarks offer about LLM capabilities. We use domain knowledge to highlight capabilities benchmarks should include and discuss opportunities our work enables for taking a human-centered and domain-driven approach to benchmark design.

translation.title: 基准测试能多好地评估LLM在个人健康信息学中的应用？
translation.abstract: 基准测试是提升大语言模型（LLM）能力的有效技术，包括在个人健康信息学领域。目前针对个人健康数据活动的基准构建工作日益增多，但这些工作是否以及多大程度上契合个人健康信息学流程的需求和考量仍不明确。为此，我们首先分析了八个与个人健康信息学相关基准中的53,587个任务，刻画了基准设计的空间；随后将观察到的设计选择与个人信息学理论及实证知识进行对比。我们发现现有基准设计与领域指南和认识之间存在显著错配，这种不一致限制了当前基准所提供的关于LLM能力证据的效用。我们利用领域知识指出基准应涵盖的能力，并讨论了本工作为采用以人为本、领域驱动的基准设计方法带来的机会。
translation.brief: 针对现有个人健康信息学基准与领域需求错配的问题，本文通过分析八个基准中的数万任务并与个人信息学理论对比，指出缺口并提出以人为本、领域驱动的基准设计方向。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Next-Step Recommendations with Knowledge Space Theory
papers.abstract: Selecting an LLM for next-step recommendation requires benchmarks that reflect the intended educational task and domain. We present a benchmarking method that uses Knowledge Space Theory (KST) as a formal evaluation reference. Given a task catalogue and an existing prerequisite relation, the method derives admissible knowledge states and the complete set of immediate next steps for each state. Recommendations generated by a model under a specified prompt are compared with these reference sets. A sample evaluation study uses 2,400 responses from six models across four mathematics domains, four prompt conditions, and two catalogue orders. Exact-set accuracy was 61.3% with descriptions only, 62.8% when models were asked to reconstruct prerequisites, 96.3% with supplied prerequisite relations, and 98.2% with the complete knowledge space. Performance varied across models and domains, and recommendation sets agreed across the two presentations in 85.25% of pairs. The benchmark supports comparisons of model-prompt combinations against a context-specific reference. Its scores describe structural recommendation accuracy under the evaluated conditions; they do not establish learning benefit or the necessity of using an LLM for selection.

translation.title: 基于知识空间理论的LLM下一步推荐基准测试
translation.abstract: 为下一步推荐选择LLM需要能反映预期教育任务和领域的基准。我们提出一种以知识空间理论（KST）作为形式化评估参照的基准测试方法：给定任务目录和已有先决条件关系，该方法推导出可允许的知识状态以及每个状态的完整即时下一步集合；将模型在指定提示下生成的推荐与这些参照集合进行比较。一项示例评估使用了六个模型在四个数学领域、四种提示条件和两种目录顺序下的2,400个响应：仅使用描述时精确集合准确率为61.3%，要求模型重构先决条件时为62.8%，提供先决条件关系时为96.3%，提供完整知识空间时为98.2%。性能因模型和领域而异，两种呈现方式下推荐集合在85.25%的配对中一致。该基准支持将模型-提示组合与特定上下文的参照进行比较；其得分描述的是在评估条件下的结构性推荐准确率，并不能确立学习收益或使用LLM进行选择的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏反映教育任务的LLM下一步推荐评估方法的问题，本文以知识空间理论推导参照集合，据此对模型推荐进行系统性基准测试。

papers.title: Efficient control of multi-agent robust MDPs through tensor trees
papers.abstract: This paper introduces a tensor-based framework for controller synthesis of stochastic multi-agent systems under temporal logic specifications that couple the agents, such as one agent reaching its goal only after another agent has reached its own. The agents are modeled as robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs), whose transition probabilities are only known to lie in an ambiguity set, for instance due to abstraction errors, learned models, or uncertain parameters. We show that the decoupled nature of the ambiguity sets allows one to decompose the computation of a lower bound on the satisfaction probabilities into per-agent factors, so that only the per-agent ambiguity sets need to be stored. This leads to improved memory complexity compared to monolithic approaches. We compare our approach with state-of-the-art approaches based on approximate simulation relations and with interval MDP abstractions. On a four-agent ordered reach-avoid benchmark, our approach certifies a lower bound twice as high as the simulation relation- based approach with 20 times less memory, and needs about 200 times less memory than the interval MDP abstraction, even at a resolution with about a million times more joint cells.

translation.title: 基于张量树的多智能体鲁棒MDP高效控制
translation.abstract: 本文提出一个基于张量的框架，用于在耦合各智能体的时序逻辑规范（如某智能体只有在另一智能体到达其目标后才能到达自己的目标）下，为随机多智能体系统进行控制器综合。智能体被建模为鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP），其转移概率仅已知位于一个歧义集内，例如由于抽象误差、学习得到的模型或不确定参数。我们证明了歧义集的解耦特性可将满足概率下界的计算分解为按智能体的因子，从而只需存储各智能体的歧义集，相比单体方法获得更好的内存复杂度。我们将该方法与基于近似仿真关系和区间MDP抽象的最先进方法进行比较：在四智能体有序可达-避让基准上，本方法以20倍的内存节省认证出两倍于仿真关系方法的下界，且相比区间MDP抽象节省约200倍内存，即使是在联合单元数多约一百万倍的分辨率下。
translation.brief: 针对耦合时序逻辑规范下多智能体RMDP控制器综合的内存开销问题，本文利用歧义集解耦性提出张量树分解方法，将计算按智能体分解以大幅降低内存。

papers.title: OpticalRAG: Pixel-Space Compression for Token-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is bottlenecked by the token budget of large language models: feeding long documents into the context window is expensive, while aggressive textual compression discards fine-grained information that is irreversibly lost in a one-dimensional token sequence. We argue that this bottleneck is not fundamental to information density but to the choice of compression \emph{modality}. Modern visual encoders can pack the contents of a rendered text page into roughly a hundred visual tokens with little semantic loss, opening a new compression-fidelity tradeoff that purely textual methods cannot reach. We present \textbf{OpticalRAG}, a framework that renders documents as page images, encodes them with a frozen vision encoder, and distills the retrieved visual tokens into as few as $16$ injected tokens before passing them to the LLM. Two ingredients make this work without expensive cross-modal training: (i) \emph{Encoder-Bridged Retrieval}, which projects text-query states into the visual feature space of the frozen encoder, through a projection shared with the compressor, to retrieve visual tokens from a text query, with no contrastive training; and (ii) \emph{Query-Driven Distillation}, a lightweight cross-attention compressor that condenses the retrieved visual tokens into a small set of query-conditioned prefix tokens. On LongBench-v2, BAMBOO, and LooGLE-v2, OpticalRAG achieves the best compression-aware accuracy (CAP) on all three benchmarks while injecting only $16$ tokens, and improves the closed-book Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone by $5.17$ points on this http URL is available at this https URL.

translation.title: OpticalRAG：面向token高效检索增强生成的像素空间压缩
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）受限于大语言模型的token预算：将长文档送入上下文窗口代价高昂，而激进的文本压缩会丢弃在一维token序列中不可逆丢失的细粒度信息。我们认为这一瓶颈并非源于信息密度，而是源于压缩模态的选择。现代视觉编码器可将渲染后的文本页面内容打包为约一百个视觉token而几乎不损失语义，开启了纯文本方法无法达到的新的压缩-保真权衡。我们提出OpticalRAG，该框架将文档渲染为页面图像，用冻结的视觉编码器编码，并将检索到的视觉token蒸馏为少至16个注入token后传给LLM。两个关键组件使其无需昂贵的跨模态训练即可工作：(i) Encoder-Bridged Retrieval，通过与压缩器共享的投影将文本查询状态投影到冻结编码器的视觉特征空间，从文本查询检索视觉token，无需对比训练；(ii) Query-Driven Distillation，一个轻量级交叉注意力压缩器，将检索到的视觉token压缩为一小组查询条件化的前缀token。在LongBench-v2、BAMBOO和LooGLE-v2上，OpticalRAG在仅注入16个token的情况下于全部三个基准上取得最佳压缩感知准确率（CAP），并将closed-book的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct基线提升5.17分。
translation.brief: 针对RAG受LLM token预算限制的问题，本文提出OpticalRAG，将文档渲染为图像并用冻结视觉编码器压缩为极少视觉token注入LLM，实现高效检索增强。

papers.title: BypassGym: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents' Endpoint Defense Evasion Capabilities
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence agents increasingly automate cybersecurity tasks, including offensive operations. Frequent attacks across the web make endpoint detection and response (EDR) a critical defense, but whether AI agents can evade it remains unclear. Benchmarks evaluate the offensive capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents in areas such as penetration testing and vulnerability discovery. One important capability that these benchmarks do not address is defense evasion, specifically whether an agent can develop a program that executes a payload without being blocked or terminated by a deployed EDR. We introduce BypassGym, to our knowledge the first benchmark to systematically evaluate this capability on real endpoints. Given command-and-control (C2) shellcode, an agent must generate and compile a loader that executes the payload without being blocked or terminated. A supplementary evasion knowledge skill provides domain knowledge and supports comparisons with and without this input. BypassGym is built on Proxmox VE(PVE), so the evaluation environment runs real Windows systems and EDR products inside virtual machines and returns structured detection feedback to the agent. We evaluate 5 lightweight model backends against 6 EDR products and 3 payloads, and find that even these simple models generate successful submissions, with DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash reaching 17/18 successful runs and Bitdefender allowing only 5 of 15 runs to pass. These results provide a systematic measurement of current AI agents' endpoint defense evasion capabilities and identify areas for defenders to investigate.

translation.title: BypassGym：评估AI智能体端点防御规避能力的基准
translation.abstract: 人工智能智能体日益自动化网络安全任务，包括攻击性操作。互联网上频繁的攻击使端点检测与响应（EDR）成为关键防御，但AI智能体能否规避它尚不明确。现有基准评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体在渗透测试和漏洞发现等领域的攻击能力，但未涉及一项重要能力：防御规避，即智能体能否开发出一个在已部署EDR下执行载荷而不被拦截或终止的程序。我们提出BypassGym，据我们所知是首个在真实端点上系统评估该能力的基准。给定命令与控制（C2）shellcode，智能体必须生成并编译一个加载器，在不被拦截或终止的情况下执行载荷。一个补充的规避知识技能提供领域知识，并支持有无该输入的对比。BypassGym构建于Proxmox VE（PVE）之上，评估环境在虚拟机中运行真实的Windows系统和EDR产品，并向智能体返回结构化的检测反馈。我们用5个轻量级模型后端对6个EDR产品和3个载荷进行评估，发现即使这些简单模型也能生成成功提交，其中DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash达到17/18次成功运行，而Bitdefender仅允许15次运行中的5次通过。这些结果系统量化了当前AI智能体的端点防御规避能力，并为防御者指出了需调查的领域。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏评估AI智能体EDR防御规避能力基准的问题，本文提出在真实Windows虚拟机与EDR产品上运行的BypassGym，要求智能体生成可绕过EDR执行载荷的加载器。

papers.title: On Private Knowledge Retrieval and Private Inference for secure multi-agent systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems provide a convenient framework for the massive deployment of agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs). It provides a sound framework where agents can interact with existing software to perform actions in an autonomous way. Agentic AI is the new term to denote these AI-based autonomous systems. In real multi-agent systems, agents need to deal with malicious agents some of which can exploit security vulnerabilities to do harm. A memory poisoning attack is an example of exploiting a vulnerability to modify agents knowledge and, thus, affect its behavior. In an agent, there are different types of memory systems (semantic, episodic, and short-term) which have their own characteristics and for which different memory poisoning attacks may be developed. In this paper we focus on semantic memory, we discuss its attack, and mitigation strategies. We introduce private knowledge retrieval and private inference. We propose a signature system in the knowledge base to prevent from undesired manipulation. This should avoid memory poisoning attacks by introducing security by design in the construction of the semantic memory. In our architecture, an agent contains a local Prolog-like inference system (i.e., using Horn clauses to represent knowledge) which accesses an external knowledge base to get the required knowledge. This externally signed knowledge base is accessed privately. We provide different implementations in Python using different privacy levels including k-anonymity and information-theoretical privacy (IT-PIR).

papers.title: Agentic AI Meets Formal Verification in the Era of Agentic Hardware Development
papers.abstract: As AI agents become increasingly capable of generating and optimizing hardware circuits, ensuring the correctness of AI-generated designs becomes more important. Meanwhile, advances in AI lower the barriers to developing and applying formal methods, creating new opportunities to automate and improve hardware verification. This invited paper presents an overview of the methodologies and applications of hardware formal methods in the AI era. First, we examine how agentic AI advances hardware formal methods across three levels: specification, proof construction, and reasoning engines. Second, we discuss how formal methods support reliable AI-driven hardware development through RTL generation, debugging, and correctness-preserving optimization. We review representative research alongside our recent contributions, highlighting key technical advances and insights from experimental results. Finally, we discuss future research opportunities toward proof-native hardware development, where formal reasoning could become an integral part of autonomous hardware design.

papers.title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
papers.abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.
