papers.title: From Search to Decision: How Post-Training Shapes Information-Seeking Capabilities in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Information seeking in large language model (LLM) systems increasingly involves decisions about when to acquire information, where to search, and how to evaluate and use evidence. Recent post-training methods have improved several such behaviors, but their objectives and evaluations span different tasks and system settings. This paper organizes research around six interrelated information-seeking capabilities and examines the learning signals, optimization methods, update loci, and credit-assignment mechanisms used to develop them. We synthesize empirical progress in targeted behaviors, end-to-end performance, search control, and generalization. Existing studies report gains in retrieval routing, query refinement, multi-tool exploration, evidence-grounded reasoning, and resource-aware search, although the scope of behavioral evidence varies across capabilities. We identify open challenges in estimating prospective retrieval utility, coordinating information-seeking decisions, and adapting to unfamiliar retrieval environments, and discuss evaluation practices for interpreting future progress.

translation.title: 从搜索到决策：后训练如何塑造大语言模型的信息获取能力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）系统中的信息获取日益涉及何时获取信息、在哪里搜索以及如何评估和使用证据的决策。近期的后训练方法改进了若干此类行为，但其目标和评估涵盖不同的任务与系统设置。本文围绕六项相互关联的信息获取能力组织相关研究，并考察用于培养这些能力的学习信号、优化方法、更新位置和信用分配机制。我们综合了在针对性行为、端到端性能、搜索控制和泛化方面的实证进展。现有研究在检索路由、查询细化、多工具探索、基于证据的推理和资源感知搜索方面报告了收益，尽管各能力的行为证据范围不一。我们指出了在估计前瞻性检索效用、协调信息获取决策以及适应陌生检索环境方面的开放挑战，并讨论了解释未来进展的评估实践。
translation.brief: 针对LLM信息获取中何时搜索、如何用证据等决策能力缺乏系统梳理的问题，本文以六项能力为框架组织后训练研究并分析其学习信号与评估实践。

papers.title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
papers.abstract: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($\Delta = -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($\Delta = -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.

translation.title: 集中式与分散式注意力头 Dropout 下自回归多步推理的崩溃
translation.abstract: 在延长清醒期间，哺乳动物新皮层网络会经历称为 off-states 的局部短暂神经元沉默。本文考察类似的时空集中式扰动如何影响自回归大语言模型（LLM）中的序列推理。在 GSM8K 基准上对两个 8B 模型（Qwen3-8B 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct）进行 250 组配对推导评估，我们对比了聚簇式注意力头掩码爆发与预算匹配的分散 i.i.d. dropout。集中式爆发导致显著的推理退化：在起始参数 $\mathcal{B}=0.10$（调度约 5.7% 的易损头-词元体量）时，Qwen3-8B 的准确率从分散噪声下的 91.2% 降至爆发 dropout 下的 78.8%（$\Delta = -12.4$ 个百分点 [pp]，exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$），而 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 从 84.0% 降至 76.8%（$\Delta = -7.2$ pp，$p = 0.0198$）。相反，通过分层五分位匹配将相同的累计预算均匀分散到生成各步骤中，退化则温和得多（Qwen 保持 91.2%，LLaMA 保持 84.0%）。在一项探索性因子拆解（$N=100$）中，单步 dropout 密度与单个调度抽取中的急剧下降相关（Qwen 上 $-10.0$ pp，$p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$），而多词元连续性表现出不确定的复合趋势（$-7.0$ pp，$p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$）。错误分析显示，Qwen 的失败反映为格式化回答内的推导错误（条件准确率下降 $-11.4$ pp），而 LLaMA 中 22.2% 的不一致损失缺少最终答案格式行（条件差距收窄至 $-5.0$ pp）。这些发现表明自回归推理链对集中式结构扰动尤为脆弱，为 transformer 架构的容错性提供了实证基准。
translation.brief: 研究集中式与分散式注意力头扰动对LLM多步推理的影响，通过在GSM8K上对两个8B模型施加掩码对比实验验证推理链对集中式破坏更脆弱。

papers.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
papers.abstract: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop direction, strengthens a concluding direction, and preserves the layer's output on productive tokens. Within a state-tree representation, where lossless BF16 storage acts as a special case, the admissible edits are sign flips and exponent shifts that preserve all shared group exponents and mantissas. We decompose this objective exactly into independent QUBO (Ising) problems, one per output row, which we solve on a GPU using simulated annealing or quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation. On the agent's two layers, Tree-Ising achieves 54.6% on MATH-500, outperforming the agent's edit (51.7%) under the same evaluation protocol, while the base model scores 7.9% as reported. The simulated bifurcation solver yields a statistically indistinguishable repair at 55.1%. Both solvers outperform the agent edit across all five math benchmarks, with statistically significant improvements on MATH-500 and GSM8K after correcting for multiple comparisons. Our approach modifies 13% to 17% fewer weights and reduces BF16 bit flips by a factor of 2.2 to 2.3. It requires only four forward-pass requests and zero LLM tokens, with the annealing recipe costing about $0.90 in GPU time. On Qwen3.5-2B, with layers and dose selected using only the base model, the same recipe increases greedy GSM8K accuracy from 21.6% to 69.4%. As a proof of concept, we execute an eight-variable repair subproblem using QAOA on an IBM Heron processor.

translation.title: Tree-Ising：用比特级 Ising 编辑修复语言模型
translation.abstract: 近期 MIT Takehi 等人的工作提出了权重空间编程，使前沿 LLM 智能体能够读取网络权重并写入修复。他们的 GPT-6 Astra 智能体在不使用梯度的情况下，通过 158 个智能体回合、8970 万个 token 和 50 次前向传播请求，修正了 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的推理循环。我们的方法 Tree-Ising 将这种修复转化为模型自身 BF16 权重上的稀疏离散优化问题。前向统计定义了一个目标函数，削弱循环方向、强化结论方向，并保留该层在有效 token 上的输出。在状态树表示中（无损 BF16 存储作为特例），可容许的编辑是保留所有共享组指数和尾数的符号翻转与指数移位。我们将该目标精确分解为独立的 QUBO（Ising）问题——每个输出行一个——并在 GPU 上用模拟退火或量子启发式模拟分岔求解。在智能体的两个层上，Tree-Ising 在 MATH-500 上取得 54.6%，在相同评估协议下优于智能体的编辑（51.7%），而据报道基础模型得分为 7.9%。模拟分岔求解器产生了统计上无显著差异的修复，为 55.1%。两个求解器在全部五个数学基准上均优于智能体编辑，经多重比较校正后在 MATH-500 和 GSM8K 上有统计显著改进。我们的方法少修改 13% 到 17% 的权重，并将 BF16 比特翻转减少 2.2 到 2.3 倍。它只需四次前向传播请求且零 LLM token，退火配方的 GPU 时间成本约 $0.90。在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，仅用基础模型选择层和剂量，相同配方将 greedy GSM8K 准确率从 21.6% 提升至 69.4%。作为概念验证，我们在 IBM Heron 处理器上用 QAOA 执行了一个八变量修复子问题。
translation.brief: 针对无梯度修复LLM推理缺陷的问题，Tree-Ising将修复建模为BF16权重上的稀疏QUBO/Ising优化，用模拟退火或模拟分岔求解以替代LLM智能体编辑。

papers.title: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: A Policed Quality-of-Service Mechanism for Agentic AI Traffic, Evaluated from Simulation to Real-Kernel Adversarial Testing
papers.abstract: Software agents built on large language models generate traffic unlike human web traffic, yet routers have no class for it and cannot verify a sender's claim to be an agent. This paper proposes the Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class (VATC), which combines a reserved Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value declaring agent traffic, a router-side classifier that demotes flows contradicting the declaration to a class served after best-effort traffic, and a rate-limited priority queue. VATC was compared with static Differentiated Services (DiffServ), a dedicated class that trusts the marking, and fq_codel, a per-flow fair-queuing scheduler, in two simulators and on a real Linux kernel. VATC matched DiffServ under steady load. In a constructed burst it cut mean agent queuing delay by 98% relative to DiffServ in simulation (assuming an immediate verdict), at a 12% increase in human delay; most of the gain came from the separate class. Under a spoofed flood in the kernel, the rate limit held human latency 11 times below DiffServ's. Without verification, DiffServ and a tightly configured fq_codel gave legitimate agents lower latency than VATC; a live four-feature classifier then demoted all 20 bulk-shaped spoofers and gave agents 0.30 ms, but missed six spoofers that copied the agent pattern. With emulated network delay, a timing feature of the classifier stopped separating agent from human flows. In real agent harnesses on a congested link, router queueing took 13% to 63% of task time, depending on harness and assumed model latency. The traffic was synthetic or sandbox-scale.

translation.title: 可验证智能体流量类别：面向智能体 AI 流量的受管控服务质量机制，从仿真到真实内核对抗测试的评估
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型的软件智能体产生的流量不同于人类网络流量，但路由器没有为其设置的类别，也无法验证发送方声称自己是智能体的说法。本文提出可验证智能体流量类别（VATC），它结合了：声明智能体流量的保留 Differentiated Services Code Point（DSCP）值、将违背声明的流量降级到在 best-effort 流量之后服务的类别的路由器端分类器，以及速率受限的优先队列。VATC 在两个仿真器和真实 Linux 内核上与静态 Differentiated Services（DiffServ，信任标记的专用类别）和 fq_codel（每流公平队列调度器）进行了比较。VATC 在稳定负载下与 DiffServ 相当。在构造的突发中，仿真中（假设立即裁决）VATC 将智能体平均排队时延相对 DiffServ 降低 98%，人类时延增加 12%；大部分收益来自独立类别。在内核中的伪造洪泛下，速率限制使人类时延比 DiffServ 低 11 倍。在没有验证的情况下，DiffServ 和严格配置的 fq_codel 给合法智能体的时延低于 VATC；随后一个实时的四特征分类器将全部 20 个批量形态的伪造者降级，并给智能体 0.30 ms 时延，但漏掉了六个复制智能体模式的伪造者。在模拟网络时延下，分类器的时序特征无法再区分智能体与人类流量。在拥塞链路上运行真实智能体框架时，路由器排队占任务时间的 13% 到 63%，取决于框架和假定的模型时延。这些流量是合成的或沙箱规模的。
translation.brief: 针对路由器无法识别和验证智能体AI流量的问题，提出VATC机制，结合DSCP标记、路由器端降级分类器和速率限制优先队列，并在仿真与真实Linux内核中进行评估。

papers.title: SHARP: Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory
papers.abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) prediction supports personalized location services by anticipating users' next destinations. Recent methods leverage large language models (LLMs) for semantic reasoning and graphs for collective mobility modeling, improving POI prediction. However, three challenges still remain. Bridging LLMs' semantic reasoning and specific POI prediction remains challenging. User mobility also evolves over time, making it necessary to retain and update historical knowledge within limited LLM contexts. Meanwhile, global transition graphs smooth out time-specific category transition patterns. To address these challenges, we propose Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory (SHARP), an agentic hierarchical framework in which category-level reasoning guides specific POI prediction. A trajectory memory agent maintains a dynamic trajectory memory bank that preserves earlier mobility patterns and tracks behavioral changes with limited context growth. We construct multi-granularity time-aware category transition graphs with global and time-conditioned views to preserve temporal regularities obscured by global aggregation. A category predict agent combines these graphs with trajectory memory to predict likely next categories. SHARP learns semantic IDs (SIDs) through a residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RQ-VAE) to construct semantic POI representations, which are jointly optimized with a category-guided POI predictor end-to-end. On three real-world datasets, SHARP improves Acc@5 and Acc@10 by an average of 5.29 and 4.52 percentage points, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

translation.title: SHARP：基于动态记忆的语义层次智能体推理进行下一 POI 预测
translation.abstract: 下一兴趣点（POI）预测通过预判用户的下一个目的地来支持个性化位置服务。近期方法利用大语言模型（LLM）进行语义推理，并利用图进行群体移动性建模，改进了 POI 预测。然而仍存在三个挑战：将 LLM 的语义推理与具体的 POI 预测衔接仍有难度；用户移动性随时间演化，需要在有限的 LLM 上下文内保留和更新历史知识；同时，全局转移图会平滑掉特定时间的类别转移模式。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SHARP（Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory），这是一个智能体层次化框架，其中类别级推理引导具体的 POI 预测。轨迹记忆智能体维护一个动态轨迹记忆库，在上下文有限增长的情况下保留早期移动模式并跟踪行为变化。我们构建了多粒度时间感知类别转移图，包含全局视图和时间条件视图，以保留被全局聚合掩盖的时间规律。类别预测智能体将这些图与轨迹记忆结合以预测可能的下一类别。SHARP 通过残差量化变分自编码器（RQ-VAE）学习语义 ID（SIDs）以构建语义 POI 表示，并与类别引导的 POI 预测器端到端联合优化。在三个真实数据集上，SHARP 相比最强基线将 Acc@5 和 Acc@10 平均提升 5.29 和 4.52 个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对LLM语义推理与具体POI预测衔接、移动模式动态演化及全局图丢失时间模式三大问题，提出SHARP层次化智能体框架，用动态轨迹记忆库、时间感知类别转移图和RQ-VAE语义ID端到端联合优化进行下一POI预测。

papers.title: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
papers.abstract: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.

translation.title: 基于Transformer的语言模型中inside-outside计算的分阶段可解释涌现
translation.abstract: 句法结构的变异性和解析歧义是自然语言的基本特征，现代LLM必须熟练掌握。此前的事后研究表明，训练完成的Transformer确实能近似inside-outside等经典解析算法，但关于其如何被学到的理论仍很缺乏。本文通过研究具有可变解析树拓扑的合成上下文无关文法中的学习动态，迈出了第一步。其分阶段学习曲线完全可解释：所有损失阶段a)均可解析计算，b)可明确关联到某个隐含潜在树变量的表示，该变量能消除歧义并利用更宽上下文的信息。通过探测表示，我们可视化了inside-outside计算在深度方向和训练过程中的涌现：早期阶段仅使用局部（bigram/trigram）信息且只涉及最初几层，随后Transformer逐渐发展出编码器-解码器结构，将最抽象的潜在信息编码在中间层，网络后半部分用于逐步精炼最终的token预测。这种计算组织方式与真实世界LLM中的发现相似，且重要的是它适用于可对数据统计进行完全解析控制的合成模型，从而为理论进展打开了大门。
translation.brief: 研究Transformer如何在训练中学会inside-outside解析计算，方法是在可变解析树拓扑的合成上下文无关文法上分析学习动态并探测表示。

papers.title: Model-Based Authoring of SOC Simulation Exercises for Cybersecurity Education
papers.abstract: Cybersecurity training and classroom exercises with a virtual Security Operations Center (SOC) combine alerts, evidence, timeline entries, learner tasks, and assessment items that must remain consistent across an evolving incident. This paper presents a model-based authoring method in which a technical and educational specification is used to construct an incident exercise model and a large language model (LLM) generates selected scenario text based on that model. The incident exercise model combines an incident model of events, objects, and evidence with an exercise orchestration model of SOC alerts, timeline entries, learner tasks, and assessment items. The method is implemented in a Virtual SOC prototype and evaluated using a phishing-to-ransomware reference exercise. Its incident exercise model contains eight incident events, eight incident objects, six evidence items, seven alerts in five batches, 13 timeline entries including 12 learner tasks, and five representative assessment items. GLM-5.3-generated alert descriptions are inserted and a separate validator checks references, ordering, evidence links, assessment completeness, and selected fixed fields. Validation is demonstrated with reference data, resulting in true-negative outcomes for valid data and true-positive outcomes for deliberately placed inconsistencies. The resulting exercise package is executable within the Virtual SOC learner environment. Overall, the evaluation indicates consistency across the involved model elements and establishes the feasibility of the model-based and generative approach.

translation.title: 面向网络安全教育的基于模型的SOC模拟演练编写方法
translation.abstract: 带有虚拟安全运营中心（SOC）的网络安全培训和课堂练习需要将告警、证据、时间线条目、学习者任务和评估项组合起来，并在不断演化的事件中保持一致。本文提出一种基于模型的编写方法：使用技术与教学规范构建事件演练模型，并由大语言模型（LLM）基于该模型生成选定的场景文本。事件演练模型将事件、对象和证据的事件模型与SOC告警、时间线条目、学习者任务和评估项的演练编排模型相结合。该方法在Virtual SOC原型中实现，并通过一个从钓鱼到勒索软件的参考演练进行评估：其事件演练模型包含八个事件事件、八个事件对象、六项证据、五批共七条告警、13条时间线条目（含12个学习者任务）以及五个代表性评估项。插入GLM-5.3生成的告警描述，并由独立验证器检查引用、顺序、证据链接、评估完整性和选定固定字段。通过参考数据展示了验证效果：对有效数据返回真负结果，对故意放置的不一致返回真正结果。生成的演练包可在Virtual SOC学习者环境中执行。总体而言，评估表明所涉模型元素间具有一致性，验证了基于模型与生成式方法的可行性。
translation.brief: 提出基于模型的SOC演练编写方法，用事件演练模型约束LLM生成场景文本并通过独立验证器保证一致性。

papers.title: PARLEY: Evaluating LLM Collaboration Through Cooperative Asymmetric Puzzles
papers.abstract: As large language models power autonomous agents, understanding how they collaborate and where they fail becomes critical. We introduce PARLEY, an extensible platform for studying LLM agent collaboration through four asymmetric puzzle tasks grounded in cognitive psychology (referential communication, joint coordination, perspective-taking, and spatial reasoning). GPT-4o agent pairs succeeded in 60.5% of conversations (N=400, 100 per task), with task-level variation (34-80%) reflecting distinct collaborative demands. From these conversations, we derived the data-driven PAC taxonomy: six failure types organized into Perception (visual interpretation and spatial reasoning), Adaptation (progress tracking and feedback integration), and Coordination (verification and grounding). Failure to incorporate external feedback was a critical indicator of unsuccessful collaboration, with agents repeatedly applying unsuccessful strategies. We also show that a taxonomy-guided intervention (N=200) improved average task success to 70.5%. These results demonstrate how PARLEY can be used to derive meaningful, data-driven insights that can in turn lead to improved agentic collaboration.

translation.title: PARLEY：通过合作性非对称谜题评估LLM协作
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型驱动自主智能体，理解它们如何协作以及在哪里失败变得至关重要。我们提出PARLEY，一个可扩展平台，通过四个基于认知心理学的非对称谜题任务（指称交流、联合协调、视角采择和空间推理）研究LLM智能体协作。GPT-4o智能体对在60.5%的对话中取得成功（N=400，每任务100次），任务层面的差异（34-80%）反映了不同的协作需求。基于这些对话，我们提出了数据驱动的PAC分类法：六种失败类型归为感知（视觉解释与空间推理）、适应（进度跟踪与反馈整合）和协调（验证与落地）三类。未能纳入外部反馈是协作失败的关键指标，表现为智能体反复使用不成功的策略。我们还表明，基于分类法的干预（N=200）将平均任务成功率提升至70.5%。这些结果展示了PARLEY如何用于得出有意义的数据驱动洞见，进而改进智能体协作。
translation.brief: 构建PARLEY平台研究LLM智能体协作，方法是用四个非对称合作谜题收集失败案例并归纳PAC失败分类法以指导干预。

papers.title: An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework
papers.abstract: We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). On 100 draft laws, the pipeline matches 0.28 of the findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model, 0.30 with Sonnet 5.5, and 0.43-0.46 across all flags (non-blind; the frozen blind baseline achieves 0.21, 95% CI 0.16-0.26). Across all runs, most misses occur on provisions that the system located but qualified as a different risk, and none of the 32 legal-collision findings was matched. On 21 acts held out from tuning, the pipeline outperforms a monolithic prompt containing the full methodology under the strict measure, though not under the lenient one, and Opus 5.5 adds nothing over Sonnet. The reported scores reflect agreement with model-extracted findings rated by an LLM judge whose two access routes agree on 73 of 74 labels, without human expert validation.

translation.title: 基于TRACE框架的法案草案反腐审查自动化AI助手
translation.abstract: 我们基于TRACE架构提出一个用于法案草案反腐审查自动化的AI助手，旨在筛查法案中的腐败风险：指出专家会批评的条款并指出每处的监管缺陷。该流水线结合了确定性解析核心、模型引导的单条款定性、基于规则的因素分配以及外部人工监督。为评估该助手，我们从乌克兰国家反腐败预防署（NAZK）公布的结论构建了一个开放基准，包含132部法律草案和474个模型提取的发现。当系统标记指向兼容条款且LLM裁判将风险评为相同（严格）或部分相同（宽松）时，视为与发现一致。在100部法律草案上，使用本地Gemma 4 31B模型时流水线在前十条标记中匹配0.28的发现，Sonnet 5.5为0.30，所有标记为0.43-0.46（非盲测；冻结的盲基线为0.21，95% CI 0.16-0.26）。在所有运行中，大多数漏报发生在系统已定位但定性为不同风险的条款上，且32个法律冲突发现无一被匹配。在从调参中留出的21部法案上，流水线在严格指标下优于包含完整方法的单体提示，宽松指标下则不然，且Opus 5.5相对Sonnet没有额外收益。所报分数反映与模型提取发现的一致性，而这些发现由两条访问路径在74个标签中有73个一致的LLM裁判评定，未经人类专家验证。
translation.brief: 构建基于TRACE架构的流水线自动筛查法案中的腐败风险，方法是将确定性解析、模型定性与规则分配结合并在NAZK公开结论基准上评估。

papers.title: SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Hybrid models combine softmax attention with linear attention, which compresses history into fixed-size recurrent states to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, linear attention has not pushed this compression to its limit: we find that the queries, keys, and values of linear layers concentrate in a stable, low-dimensional subspace, a phenomenon we call the linear attention sink, so each state is effectively low-rank, with a rank that varies across states. Yet existing serving systems keep these redundant states dense, reading and rewriting them in full at every decoding step, so their memory traffic grows with the batch size and dominates the decoding cost. Thus SinkState stores each recurrent state in an adaptive low-rank form throughout inference with buffered updates and a local SVD restricted to the top subspace. SinkState further consolidates the remaining components asynchronously on the CPU. On four hybrid models with Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, from 4B to 120B parameters, SinkState reduces the peak memory of recurrent states by up to 2.6x (1.9x on average) and speeds up decoding by up to 1.58x (1.25x on average) over Mamba-SSM and FLA, while maintaining accuracy.

translation.title: SinkState：面向高效混合LLM服务的循环状态在线SVD
translation.abstract: 混合模型将softmax注意力与线性注意力结合，后者将历史压缩为固定大小的循环状态，以平衡模型质量与推理效率。然而线性注意力并未将压缩推向极限：我们发现线性层的queries、keys和values集中于一个稳定的低维子空间，我们将这一现象称为linear attention sink，因此每个状态实际上都是低秩的，且秩在不同状态间变化。然而现有服务系统将这些冗余状态保存为稠密形式，在每次解码步骤中完整读写它们，使其内存流量随批大小增长并主导解码成本。为此，SinkState在整个推理过程中以自适应低秩形式存储每个循环状态，采用缓冲更新和仅针对顶部子空间的局部SVD。SinkState还在CPU上异步合并剩余组件。在四个包含Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet（GDN）层、参数量从4B到120B的混合模型上，SinkState相比Mamba-SSM和FLA将循环状态峰值内存最多降低2.6倍（平均1.9倍），解码加速最多1.58倍（平均1.25倍），同时保持准确率。
translation.brief: 发现循环状态呈低秩的linear attention sink现象，并提出SinkState在推理全程以自适应低秩形式存储状态以降低内存流量并加速解码。

papers.title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer. This survey investigates the structural source of asymmetric mechanism transfer across four scenarios: multimodal reasoning, multimodal generation, GUI and Web navigation, and embodied manipulation. We first formalize the self-evolving multimodal agent by four criteria and a differentia of self-reference, and adopt the three-stage self-evolving loop of experience generation, feedback acquisition, and update consolidation as our analytical framework to position the scenarios along ceilings on rollout count and feedback fidelity. Comparing self-evolving with fixed loops within each scenario separates the limitations that the scenario imposes from those inherent in the self-evolving design. We then recast each mechanism as a trade-off that raises a scarce factor by presupposing a task-structural resource, such as output equivalence or checkable outcomes, and judge it portable, conditional, blocked, or redundant across scenarios. We attribute the asymmetry to divergent combinations of scarce factors and resources across opposite transfer directions, and identify the matched-budget measurements that could overturn these still untested verdicts.

translation.title: 自进化多模态智能体的跨场景综述与分析
translation.abstract: 近期研究表明，多模态智能体越来越多地无需反复人工标注即可自我改进。然而，每种自我改进机制都在单一场景下设计和评估，其前提条件在跨场景迁移下未经验证。本综述研究了四种场景下机制非对称迁移的结构性来源：多模态推理、多模态生成、GUI 与 Web 导航以及具身操作。我们首先通过四项准则和一个自指差异来形式化自进化多模态智能体，并采用经验生成、反馈获取和更新巩固的三阶段自进化循环作为分析框架，以在 rollout 数量和反馈保真度的上限上对各场景进行定位。在每个场景内比较自进化循环与固定循环，可以区分场景施加的限制与自进化设计固有的限制。随后，我们将每种机制重构为一种权衡：通过预设任务结构性资源（如输出等价性或可检验结果）来提升某种稀缺因子，并据此判断其在跨场景间是可移植的、有条件的、受阻的还是冗余的。我们将这种非对称性归因于相反迁移方向上稀缺因子与资源的不同组合，并识别出可能推翻这些尚未验证结论的匹配预算测量方法。
translation.brief: 研究自进化多模态智能体机制在四类场景间非对称迁移的结构性来源，方法是以三阶段自进化循环为框架分析稀缺因子与任务结构性资源的组合并判定机制可移植性。

papers.title: Lilo: A Multi-Agent Conversational Sandbox for Children's Digital Communication
papers.abstract: Children's peer conflicts increasingly play out in group chats, where tone and timing are stripped away, and a hurtful message is easier to send than to say aloud. We present Lilo, a multi-agent conversational system that lets children practice such conversations, so they are better prepared when they encounter them in real digital communication. In Lilo, the child joins two AI-driven peers mid-argument, coached by a mentor character, also named Lilo, through a Stop-Think-Act traffic light. Through an exploratory study with 28 children (aged 9-11), we examine how children engage with Lilo's simulated peer conflict and the mentor's traffic-light interventions. The study included an intervention with Lilo, surveys before and after the intervention, and exit interviews. Participants reported significantly higher self-efficacy for coping with unpleasant messages after their interaction with Lilo. They felt safe experimenting, knowing nothing they wrote would be held against them.

translation.title: Lilo：面向儿童数字交流的多智能体对话沙盒
translation.abstract: 儿童之间的同伴冲突越来越多地发生在群聊中，语气和时机信息被剥离，一条伤人的信息发出去比说出口容易得多。我们提出 Lilo，一个多智能体对话系统，让儿童练习此类对话，以便在真实数字交流中遇到时更有准备。在 Lilo 中，儿童加入两个 AI 驱动的同伴的争论之中，并由一个名为 Lilo 的导师角色通过“停止-思考-行动”红绿灯进行辅导。通过一项有 28 名儿童（9-11 岁）参与的探索性研究，我们考察儿童如何参与 Lilo 模拟的同伴冲突以及导师红绿灯干预。研究包括 Lilo 干预、干预前后的问卷和退出访谈。参与者报告在与 Lilo 互动后，应对不愉快信息的自我效能感显著提高。他们感到可以安全地尝试，因为知道自己写的任何内容都不会被追究。
translation.brief: 为让儿童练习群聊中的同伴冲突应对，构建了多智能体对话沙盒 Lilo，并用导师角色的红绿灯干预引导儿童练习。

papers.title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract: Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. During inference, semantically similar graph paths are retrieved for each question and used as both information and in-context examples for the reasoning process. Candidate failure modes are extracted from the question and analysed independently through dedicated LLM calls, which generate plausible failure-to-observation chains. A final decision module compares these chains with the available answer choices. CoP is evaluated on the FailureSensorIQ benchmark across four industrial asset classes and three LLMs. Compared with direct prompting and conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), CoP improves diagnostic accuracy across all evaluated models, with gains ranging from 7.8 to 19.6 percentage points and from 11.7 to 18.2 percentage points, respectively. The results show that structured engineering knowledge can improve LLM-based diagnostic reasoning when graph retrieval is combined with in-context examples of fault propagation.

translation.title: Chain of Physics：基于工程启发的 LLM 推理支持故障诊断
translation.abstract: 复杂系统的故障诊断需要将观测到的物理量变化与产生它们的故障机制联系起来。经验丰富的工程师通过将传感器信息与系统行为和故障传播知识相结合来完成这项任务。大语言模型（LLM）可以支持这一过程，但其诊断推理依赖于资产特定工程知识的可得性，以及这些知识在推理过程中如何被表示和使用。本工作提出 Chain of Physics（CoP），一个基于 LLM 的故障诊断框架，围绕从资产特定参考文档自动生成的约束知识图谱（CKG）构建。CoP 从文本工程知识中解决故障-传感器关联问题。CKG 存储连接故障模式、物理量变化和监测传感器的诊断链。推理时，为每个问题检索语义相似的图路径，作为信息和上下文内示例用于推理过程。从问题中提取候选故障模式，并通过专用 LLM 调用独立分析，生成合理的故障-观测链。最终决策模块将这些链与可用的答案选项进行比较。CoP 在 FailureSensorIQ 基准上针对四类工业资产和三个 LLM 进行评估。与直接提示和常规检索增强生成（RAG）相比，CoP 在所有评估模型上均提高了诊断准确率，相对直接提示提升 7.8 至 19.6 个百分点，相对 RAG 提升 11.7 至 18.2 个百分点。结果表明，当图检索与故障传播的上下文内示例相结合时，结构化工程知识可以改进基于 LLM 的诊断推理。
translation.brief: 为改进 LLM 故障诊断，提出 Chain of Physics 框架，自动构建约束知识图谱存储故障-物理量-传感器诊断链，并结合图检索与上下文示例进行推理。

papers.title: LM-SimBench: A Unified Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark for Large Language Model Training Simulation
papers.abstract: Evaluating candidate parallelization strategies through distributed training runs makes strategy selection prohibitively expensive at scale. Performance simulation offers a lower cost alternative, yet controlled comparisons among existing simulators remain difficult because they differ in the training stages they model and the workloads on which they are evaluated. We introduce LM-SimBench, a unified framework, profiling dataset, and benchmark for evaluating LLM training simulators. The framework decomposes simulation into functional stages from model compilation to schedule level aggregation, connecting execution representations and cost estimators to measurable evaluation targets. Following this framework, we profile 23 model settings from 10 dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM families on an Ascend Neural Processing Unit (NPU) cluster. The resulting dataset contains 348 feasible configurations that jointly vary five parallelism dimensions and activation recomputation, with six views spanning configuration, rank, operator, event, and kernel granularity. Evaluations of representative training simulators demonstrate how LM-SimBench supports comparisons of prediction accuracy, assessment of configuration selection, and diagnosis of prediction errors. Matched GPU-NPU experiments validate the cross-platform applicability of the collection and evaluation protocol and demonstrate NPU-guided GPU configuration selection.

translation.title: LM-SimBench：面向大语言模型训练模拟的统一框架、数据集与基准
translation.abstract: 通过分布式训练运行来评估候选并行化策略，使得在大规模下的策略选择成本过高。性能模拟提供了一种更低成本的替代方案，但现有模拟器之间难以进行受控比较，因为它们建模的训练阶段和评估所用工作负载各不相同。我们提出 LM-SimBench，一个用于评估 LLM 训练模拟器的统一框架、剖析数据集和基准。该框架将模拟分解为从模型编译到调度级聚合的功能阶段，将执行表示和成本估计器与可度量的评估目标相连接。按照该框架，我们在 Ascend 神经处理单元（NPU）集群上剖析了来自 10 个稠密和混合专家（MoE）LLM 家族的 23 个模型设置。所得数据集包含 348 个可行配置，联合变化五个并行维度和激活重计算，涵盖配置、rank、算子、事件和 kernel 粒度的六种视图。对代表性训练模拟器的评估表明 LM-SimBench 支持预测精度比较、配置选择评估和预测误差诊断。匹配的 GPU-NPU 实验验证了该采集与评估协议的跨平台适用性，并展示了 NPU 引导的 GPU 配置选择。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 训练并行化策略选择成本高的问题，构建统一模拟评估框架 LM-SimBench，并在 Ascend NPU 集群上剖析多模型多并行配置形成数据集与基准。

papers.title: Adversarial risk analysis with fully probabilistic designs
papers.abstract: Adversarial risk analysis (ARA) informs decision-makers when facing intelligent opponents and uncertain outcomes, enabling an analyst to model beliefs about the opponents' preferences, capabilities, beliefs, and the strategic calculations that opponents employ. Major applications cover reliability and risk analysis of critical infrastructures in presence of adversarial threats. In such domains, ARA mitigates typical common knowledge assumptions of standard game-theoretic approaches. However, ARA entails complex modelling and computations. To alleviate these, we explore its combination with fully probabilistic design (FPD), a control theory methodology supporting an agent in choosing the decision distribution that achieves the outcomes with a distribution closest to its ideal. We use FPD to model and forecast the opponent's decisions within an ARA setting and present how to handle security games within this ARA-FPD framework, covering both single and multiple stage problems.

translation.title: 基于完全概率化设计的对抗风险分析
translation.abstract: 对抗风险分析（ARA）为面对智能对手和不确定结果的决策者提供支持，使分析者能够对对手的偏好、能力、信念以及对手所采用的策略计算进行信念建模。主要应用涵盖存在对抗威胁下关键基础设施的可靠性与风险分析。在这些领域中，ARA 缓解了标准博弈论方法中典型的共同知识假设。然而，ARA 涉及复杂的建模与计算。为缓解这些问题，我们探索将其与完全概率化设计（FPD）相结合，这是一种控制理论方法，支持智能体选择使其结果分布最接近其理想分布的决策分布。我们使用 FPD 在 ARA 设置中对对手决策进行建模和预测，并展示如何在该 ARA-FPD 框架内处理安全博弈，涵盖单阶段和多阶段问题。
translation.brief: 为降低对抗风险分析（ARA）的建模与计算复杂度，引入完全概率化设计（FPD）来建模并预测对手决策，并处理单阶段与多阶段安全博弈。

papers.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
papers.abstract: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.

papers.title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. This is because lessons are inferred from trajectories labeled only with task success or failure, yet are typically provided without the trajectories they came from, leaving the agent no way to check them. To address this, we introduce WikiTrace, an evidence-linked memory system designed to let agents check each lesson against its original trajectory. Specifically, motivated by the finding that a trajectory often still holds the evidence needed to catch an erroneous lesson, WikiTrace stores each lesson as a concise insight linked to a summary of why its trajectory succeeded or failed and to the raw trajectory itself. Then, on a new task, the agent starts from all insights and, whenever one lacks details needed to act, conflicts with another, or comes from a failed task, descends through its links with terminal tools to fill in missing details or correct the insight before acting. We validate WikiTrace on five agentic benchmarks, showing that it consistently outperforms existing memory approaches and a baseline given the same insights alone, while also reducing memory-induced degradation. Our code is available at this https URL

papers.title: Auditing the Judge: Internal Signals for LLM Reasoning Assurance
papers.abstract: Language-model systems use self-judgment to decide which answers to release, review, or recompute. Because intervention is costly, an assurance score must rank errors well at the available budget, not merely over the full ranking. We compare the judge's continuous verdict-token score with a supervised correctness probe trained on attention-head activations from the same prompt. Exact identities link fixed-budget error recall to residual risk and show that AUROC averages recall over all budgets. Across three open 7-12B models on GSM8K and MATH, the probe finds 1.3-22.5 additional percentage points of errors at 5% review in all six model-dataset settings (median 7.4 points). At 10% routing, probe-guided allocation improves accuracy over equal-cost random allocation in both GSM8K experiments, but beats judge-guided routing only for the weaker judge. Cross-dataset transfer lowers probe AUROC for every model in both directions relative to target-domain training. Because dataset, weight precision, and generation budget change together, this measures a joint protocol shift rather than a dataset-only effect. Internal signals can improve supervised, in-domain budget allocation, but are not domain-general confidence estimators.

papers.title: When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, verifier-rich environments, but current self-improvement mechanisms often write episode-derived lessons directly into memory, making local success an unreliable signal for reusable and safe knowledge. This paper addresses the core question of when an experience-derived behavioral update should be admitted into persistent agent state. We propose Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution (FGSE), a verifier-grounded framework that represents each candidate lesson as a structured hypothesis with an explicit precondition, behavior change, expected effect, and verifier. FGSE applies the hypothesis only in a temporary state, tests it on target-transfer, falsification, and archived-regression probes, and then commits, refines, or rejects it according to measured gain and risk. Across web, app, tool-use, and long-term memory benchmarks, FGSE achieves strong task performance, including 39.8 WebArena success rate, 78.8 AppWorld average completion, and 0.724/0.487 Pass$^1$ on $\tau$-Retail/$\tau$-Airline, while reducing falsification failures to 5.0%, regression damage to 1.3%, and harmful committed updates to 3.6%. These results suggest that testing memory updates as hypotheses supports more reliable long-term adaptation.

papers.title: AI Isn't Getting Dumber, We're Getting Pickier: Rising Standards in Human Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Users often complain that AI assistants such as ChatGPT are getting worse. Some versions do change, but human evaluation leaves a second possibility untested: the people judging may change. We separate the two on Chatbot Arena, a public platform where people compare answers from two anonymous large language models (LLMs) and pick the better one or say both are bad. We study 1,260,967 blind votes cast from May 2023 to August 2024 on pairs of models whose versions are fixed: dated vendor snapshots and models with fixed open weights. For the same pair of unchanged models, the share of votes saying "both are bad" rises by 1.71 percentage points a month on a mean of 17.1%, and by 1.91 points a month in 2024. In fourteen pairs observed often in both 2023 and 2024, it rose in every one, from 15.5% to 23.3%. The ranking does not trend: in 2024, the stronger model's share of decisive votes is flat. The rise holds within the same voter and on the same pair, and across arrival cohorts from their first recorded vote. It holds with prompt controls, in every major language, for dated vendor snapshots, open-weight models and models with stable answer length, and between interface changes. The drift is shared across models: month effects estimated from other models' pairs remove it from each model's own pairs. Platform-wide, the average model would be expected to score 78% against the 2023 average, yet the share of "both are bad" votes ended near where it began. The pattern fits a standard that follows the category's progress, so a product that stands still is judged as declining. Absolute verdicts on AI drifted while relative comparisons held steady, an evaluation drift that matters for LLM leaderboards and for the human feedback used to train models.

papers.title: EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities
papers.abstract: Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host--device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer changes, while an auditor checks implementation completeness and drives iterative debugging through device-side validation. Across 12 tasks spanning three mobile LLMs and four engine--backend pairs on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, EngineAgent achieves 75% end-to-end success with either of two underlying LLMs, versus 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline. Success requires compilation, on-device execution, and output-logit agreement with reference implementations. EngineAgent also reduces average per-task time and model-API cost relative to baselines using the same underlying LLMs.

translation.title: EngineAgent：基于推理栈层级感知与硬件能力的端侧LLM推理引擎智能体化
translation.abstract: 快速演进的LLM架构与异构移动硬件，使得在端侧推理引擎中支持新模型成为反复出现且代价高昂的系统挑战。每个模型可能需要在转换、图构建、算子和硬件后端之间进行协同修改。现有编码智能体往往遗漏这些跨层依赖，并难以诊断主机-设备执行路径上的故障。我们提出EngineAgent，一个用于自动化端侧LLM模型使能的智能体系统。其核心洞见是将可复用的引擎与硬件知识从模型特定实现中分离出来。在使能之前，EngineAgent构建一个层级感知的引擎索引，捕捉引擎抽象层与跨层依赖，并使用已支持的模型预验证后端特定的构建、执行与调试工作流。对于每个新模型，builder利用这些知识协调跨层修改，而auditor检查实现完整性，并通过设备端验证驱动迭代式调试。在覆盖三个移动端LLM、四对引擎-后端（涉及CPU、GPU和NPU）的12个任务上，EngineAgent在使用任意一种底层LLM的情况下均达到75%的端到端成功率，而最强的编码智能体基线仅为33.3%。成功标准包括编译、设备端执行以及输出logit与参考实现一致。在使用相同底层LLM的情况下，EngineAgent还降低了平均每任务时间和模型API成本。
translation.brief: 解决端侧推理引擎支持新LLM模型需跨层协同修改的难题，通过构建层级感知的引擎索引并分离可复用引擎知识与模型实现，用builder-auditor双智能体实现自动化使能与调试。

papers.title: ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents' Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces
papers.abstract: Research agents achieve increasingly strong benchmark scores, yet these scores do not necessarily translate into reliable delivery in ongoing research projects. Many research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone tasks and relatively self-contained workflows in clean or curated workspaces. However, researchers ask agents to complete one step within an ongoing project, where requests depend on earlier session decisions and workspaces contain unfinished files, outdated versions, and failed attempts. We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, grounded in real session context and in-progress workspaces. ARE-bench includes 75 tasks built on agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers' own projects, spanning seven research stages, 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total. Each task is anchored at a real user request, preserves its requirements, and summarizes the earlier requests still in effect as background. The complete workspace is replayed to that boundary without cleanup, preserving artifacts from earlier turns. Each checklist is compiled from an intent-aligned rubric and credits any valid solution. Across seven frontier models, the strongest passes every checklist item on only 66.2% of tasks, and Design and Execution rank among the hardest stages for every model. Three models pass about 69% of tasks when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked, but just 28.4% to 40.0% once historical and material or workspace requirements are also checked. Evaluating delivery without these contextual requirements can therefore overestimate research agents and mask differences between them.

translation.title: ARE-bench：在真实研究者会话与工作区中评测智能体的研究能力
translation.abstract: 研究型智能体在基准测试中取得越来越高的分数，但这些分数并不一定转化为正在进行的科研项目中的可靠交付。许多研究智能体基准强调独立任务和相对自包含的工作流，运行在干净或精心整理的工作区中。然而，研究者让智能体完成的往往是进行中项目里的某一步，请求依赖于先前会话的决策，工作区中包含未完成的文件、过时的版本和失败的尝试。我们提出ARE-bench，基于真实会话上下文和进行中的工作区，评估研究智能体能否在尊重既有决策和现有工作区状态的前提下推进进行中的项目。ARE-bench包含75个任务，基于招募研究人员自己项目的智能体会话和完整工作区构建，涵盖七个研究阶段、33项要求和150项子要求，共1173个二元检查项。每个任务锚定于一个真实用户请求，保留其要求，并将仍然有效的先前请求总结为背景。完整工作区在该边界处原样重放、不做清理，保留先前轮次的产物。每个检查单由意图对齐的评分标准编制而成，认可任何有效的解决方案。在七个前沿模型上，最强的模型也仅在66.2%的任务上通过所有检查项，且Design与Execution是所有模型中最难的阶段。当只检查交付契约和一般规范时，三个模型约通过69%的任务，但一旦同时检查历史性和材料性或工作区要求，通过率仅为28.4%到40.0%。因此，忽略这些上下文要求来评估交付，会高估研究智能体并掩盖它们之间的差异。
translation.brief: 解决现有研究智能体基准忽略进行中项目上下文的问题，构建基于真实研究者会话和工作区、含1173个检查项的ARE-bench来评测智能体在真实研究场景中的交付能力。

papers.title: Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit capabilities that resemble human Learning by Thinking (LbT), the acquisition of new insight through internal processes such as explanation and reasoning, without new external input. A systematic account of the cognitive mechanisms behind these capabilities, and of their limits, remains underdeveloped. This paper proposes a Cognitive LbT Framework that maps four mechanisms (Reflective Reasoning, Synthetic Memory Formation, Internal Simulation, and Conceptual Self-Organization) onto computational processes in LLMs. Drawing on representative methods, including chain-of-thought prompting, self-consistency, self-reflection, Tree-of-Thoughts search, Self-Instruct, and self-taught reasoning, the analysis argues that selected methods can functionally approximate aspects of these mechanisms and can improve performance on some tasks without additional labeled examples, although this does not always constitute durable learning in model parameters. For example, Self-Instruct generated approximately 52,000 instructions from 175 seed tasks and reported a 33% absolute improvement on Super-NaturalInstructions (Y. Wang et al., 2023). The same mechanisms also produce characteristic failures, including hallucination diffusion, model collapse, concept drift, and high computational cost. These failures are not isolated technical defects but follow from four structural asymmetries between LLMs and human cognition: the identity of generator and monitor, closed learning loops without external grounding, symbolic rather than sensorimotor simulation, and the cost of inference-time computation. The framework yields testable propositions about when LbT in LLMs should succeed or fail and offers a structured basis for designing more reliable autonomous learning systems.

translation.title: 大语言模型中'思考式学习'机制的认知映射
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益展现出类似人类'思考式学习'（Learning by Thinking, LbT）的能力，即通过解释和推理等内部过程、无需新的外部输入即可获得新洞见。对这些能力背后认知机制及其局限的系统性阐述仍不完善。本文提出一个认知LbT框架，将四种机制（反思性推理、合成记忆形成、内部模拟和概念自组织）映射到LLM中的计算过程。通过分析链式思维提示、自洽性、自我反思、Tree-of-Thoughts搜索、Self-Instruct和自学推理等代表性方法，本文论证所选方法可以在功能上近似这些机制的某些方面，并能在无需额外标注样本的情况下提升某些任务的性能，尽管这并不总是构成模型参数上的持久学习。例如，Self-Instruct从175个种子任务生成了约52000条指令，并在Super-NaturalInstructions上报告了33%的绝对提升（Y. Wang et al., 2023）。同样的机制也会产生特征性失败，包括幻觉扩散、模型坍塌、概念漂移和高计算成本。这些失败并非孤立的技术缺陷，而是源于LLM与人类认知之间的四种结构性不对称：生成器与监控者同一、缺乏外部锚定的封闭学习循环、符号化而非感知运动式的模拟，以及推理时计算的成本。该框架给出了关于LLM中LbT何时成功或失败的可检验命题，并为设计更可靠的自主学习系统提供了结构化基础。
translation.brief: 解决LLM类'思考式学习'能力缺乏系统性认知机制解释的问题，提出将四种认知机制映射到LLM计算过程的认知LbT框架，并分析其结构性失败根源。

papers.title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at this https URL.

translation.title: REAL Loss：面向投机解码优化真实期望接受长度
translation.abstract: 投机解码通过让draft模型一次性提出多个token供目标模型验证来加速LLM推理。加速比由期望接受长度（EAL）决定，然而交叉熵、KL散度和总变差等标准训练目标仅关注分布匹配或单步重叠。近期研究转而提出块级训练目标，试图直接优化EAL。但这些目标仍是替代品，而非EAL的精确表述。例如，一些方法在目标分布的延续上而非被接受token所选定的验证分支上对后续接受情况进行平均，引入了可能反转梯度方向的协方差偏差。我们分析这一偏差，并推导出REAL——一个真实EAL训练损失，它使用路径权重进行无偏估计，并使用Rao-Blackwellization降低方差。在以Qwen3.6-35B-A3B为目标模型、Domino为draft模型的受控损失级对比中，REAL在9个任务子集和5个评估种子上的概率化服务接受长度上优于WTV、VSD、DBLast和静态LK基线。这些提升只需修改训练损失，无需改动draft模型架构或推理流程，证明了真实EAL训练的实用性。REAL损失的参考实现可在本https URL获取。
translation.brief: 解决现有投机解码draft模型训练目标仅是期望接受长度替代品的问题，通过路径权重无偏估计与Rao-Blackwellization方差缩减，提出精确优化真实EAL的REAL训练损失。

papers.title: SIGMO: Sigmoid Gated Interaction-Aware Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Despite the widespread adoption of autonomous vehicle technologies, reliable navigation within cluttered environments remains arduous due to the necessity of interaction-aware strategies; example scenarios include: narrow passages with multiple agents, lane changing in dense traffic, and crossing unsignalized intersections. These scenarios often require highly proactive strategies, simultaneously demanding interpretability and quick adaptability, which challenge end-to-end and data-driven methods. An effective strategy requires: scalability to multiple agents, adaptability to changes in other agents' behavior, and harmony with surrounding traffic without freezing or becoming overly conservative. To meet these requirements, we present SIGMO, a sigmoid-gated interaction-aware motion planner, with two main contributions. First, we formulate polynomial sigmoid functions that analytically estimate yield scores of surrounding agents using physics-grounded interaction features that capture driving intuitions. Second, we integrate the polynomial sigmoid functions into a receding-horizon planner, which facilitates interaction-aware planning with arbitrary trajectory predictions. We validate SIGMO in interaction-intensive simulations and hardware experiments. The results show that SIGMO balances proactive and defensive behavior while remaining computationally lightweight, serving as a strong baseline in a mobility stack. The simulation and hardware experiment videos are available here: this https URL.

translation.title: SIGMO：基于Sigmoid门控的交互感知运动规划
translation.abstract: 尽管自动驾驶技术已被广泛采用，在杂乱环境中的可靠导航仍因需要交互感知策略而颇具挑战；示例场景包括：多智能体的窄通道、密集车流中变道以及穿越无信号交叉口。这些场景往往需要高度主动的策略，同时要求可解释性和快速适应性，这对端到端和数据驱动方法构成挑战。一个有效的策略需要：对多智能体的可扩展性、对其他智能体行为变化的适应性，以及与周围交通的协调而不冻结或过度保守。为满足这些要求，我们提出SIGMO，一个sigmoid门控的交互感知运动规划器，包含两项主要贡献。首先，我们形式化多项式sigmoid函数，利用基于物理、捕捉驾驶直觉的交互特征，解析地估计周围智能体的让行分数。其次，我们将多项式sigmoid函数集成到滚动时域规划器中，从而支持结合任意轨迹预测的交互感知规划。我们在交互密集的仿真和硬件实验中验证了SIGMO。结果表明，SIGMO在主动与防御行为之间取得平衡，同时计算开销轻，可作为移动性技术栈中的强基线。仿真与硬件实验视频见此https URL。
translation.brief: 解决复杂交互场景中自动驾驶运动规划缺乏可解释且快速适应的策略问题，提出用基于物理交互特征的多项式sigmoid函数估计周围智能体让行分数，并集成到滚动时域规划器中。

papers.title: Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Formal world models can support planning, verification, and safety reasoning, but constructing them from open-ended natural-language situations is difficult, particularly in multi-agent settings where several formalizations may be plausible. We study whether five LLMs can generate such world models as partially observable stochastic games and whether mechanical validity is sufficient to establish that the resulting model faithfully represents the intended decision problem. We introduce a benchmark of 44 scenarios spanning game, situational, and cultural settings and evaluate generated world models along three dimensions: mechanical validity, reference-relative structural agreement, and semantic criteria. Across three empirical tracks, we analyze 410 first-pass generations. In the reference-backed game track, 134/135 generated world models pass a strict mechanical audit, yet mean permutation-invariant structural F1 is only 0.366, with just 28/134 mechanically valid models exactly matching the authored reference. In the cultural track, explicitly naming the country changes the generated structural representation for most LLMs while producing only small changes in automated semantic scores. These results show that executability is a necessary but insufficient criterion for LLM-generated world models: models that are mechanically valid can still differ substantially in the structure used by downstream neuro-symbolic reasoning and planning.

translation.title: 评估LLM生成的世界模型在神经符号推理中的表现
translation.abstract: 形式化世界模型可以支持规划、验证与安全推理，但从开放式的自然语言情境中构建它们十分困难，尤其是在多种形式化都可能合理的多智能体场景中。我们研究五个LLM能否将此类世界模型生成为部分可观测随机博弈（POSG），以及机械有效性是否足以证明所生成的模型忠实表达了目标决策问题。我们引入一个包含44个场景（涵盖游戏、情境与文化设定）的基准，并从三个维度评估生成的世界模型：机械有效性、相对于参考的结构一致性以及语义标准。在三条实证轨迹中，我们分析了410个首次生成的世界模型。在含参考的游戏轨迹中，134/135个生成的世界模型通过了严格的机械审计，但置换不变的结构F1均值仅为0.366，且只有28/134个机械有效的模型与撰写的参考完全匹配。在文化轨迹中，显式提及国家名称会改变大多数LLM生成的结构表示，而自动语义评分仅有小幅变化。这些结果表明，可执行性是LLM生成世界模型的必要但非充分标准：机械有效的模型在下游神经符号推理与规划所使用的结构上仍可能存在显著差异。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否将自然语言情境形式化为POSG世界模型，并提出结合机械有效性、结构一致性与语义标准的评估基准。

papers.title: Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters
papers.abstract: Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. On clean audiobook speech (LibriSpeech test-clean), the median word is predicted correctly 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, while released streaming models get it 90 to 400 ms after it ends. Earlybird is the earliest on all six test sets we time, covering audiobooks, TED talks, public speech, earnings calls, and synthetic speech. On the same audiobooks, 69% of words are predicted correctly before they end, against 3-25% for the other models. For words still being spoken, confidence is calibrated, with an expected calibration error (ECE) of 3.7 to 5.5. On the eight English Open ASR Leaderboard sets, it is more accurate than Moonshine Tiny on every set and roughly ties Whistle, a model of the same size.

translation.title: Earlybird：2900万参数的预测式流式语音识别
translation.abstract: 流式语音识别器通常要到说话者说完一个词之后（一般延迟90-400毫秒）才输出该词。对于语音智能体而言，每一毫秒都至关重要：词语输出得越早，智能体就能越早开始搜索或规划回复。我们提出Earlybird，一个29M参数的流式识别器（4比特量化下仅16.8 MB）。Earlybird从随机截断（包括词中截断）的音频中学习，并被要求完整预测届时应输出的每个词，同时猜测接下来的两个词。其原始token概率为每个词提供了置信度，包括仍在发音中的词。在干净的有声书语音（LibriSpeech test-clean）上，中位数单词在说话者说完之前90毫秒即被正确预测，而已发布的流式模型则在词结束之后90至400毫秒才输出。在我们计时的全部六个测试集（涵盖有声书、TED演讲、公开演讲、财报电话会议和合成语音）上，Earlybird都是最早的。在相同的有声书上，69%的词在其结束前即被正确预测，而其他模型仅为3-25%。对于仍在发音中的词，其置信度是校准的，期望校准误差（ECE）为3.7至5.5。在八个英语Open ASR Leaderboard测试集上，它在每个数据集上都比Moonshine Tiny更准确，并与同规模的Whistle大致持平。
translation.brief: 提出Earlybird流式语音识别器，通过在随机截断音频上预测全部到期词来提前输出尚未说完的词，大幅降低识别延迟。

papers.title: Demonstration of MANA: Multi-perspective Alignment of NPC Agents
papers.abstract: We present MANA (Multi-perspective Alignment of NPC Agents), an interactive approach for authoring NPC behavior through embodied demonstration. We show MANA in the context of Minecraft, where a developer aligns NPCs while playing the game itself. Activating MANA lets the developer dynamically switch into the point of view (POV) of any character and demonstrate, in-situ, how it would act given the surrounding context, through both movement and dialogue. MANA then distills each demonstration into a generalized policy that maps in-game context to actions. Finally, once the developer switches to another NPC or exits MANA mode, this generalized policy drives the NPC on its own. We demonstrate MANA by aligning two initially generic Minecraft NPCs: Fletcher and Farmer to act aggressively and cowardly, respectively. After roughly 2 minutes of in-game play, each character exhibits consistent and believable behaviors across new, unseen scenarios.

translation.title: MANA演示：NPC智能体的多视角对齐
translation.abstract: 我们提出MANA（Multi-perspective Alignment of NPC Agents），一种通过具身演示来创作NPC行为的交互式方法。我们在Minecraft环境中展示MANA：开发者可以在玩游戏的过程中对齐NPC。激活MANA后，开发者可以动态切换到任意角色的第一人称视角（POV），并就其周围的上下文，通过移动和对话原位演示该角色应如何行动。MANA随后将每次演示提炼为一个泛化策略，将游戏内上下文映射到动作。最后，当开发者切换到另一个NPC或退出MANA模式后，该泛化策略会自主驱动该NPC。我们通过对齐两个最初通用的Minecraft NPC来演示MANA：将Fletcher和Farmer分别塑造为表现得激进和怯懦。经过约2分钟的游戏内操作，每个角色在全新的、未见过的场景中都表现出一致且可信的行为。
translation.brief: 提出MANA系统，让开发者以角色第一人称视角进行具身演示，并将演示提炼为泛化策略来对齐NPC行为。

papers.title: FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs. FERN (Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM) instead fuses three frozen retrievers into 100 candidates, describes each with up to 120 features, and reorders them with LightGBM rankers fitted once on BIRD's training questions. On Spider, where it was not fitted, its candidate pool alone reaches RASL's published recall at fifteen tables (98.0), and the ranker raises the share of questions with every gold table in the top five (complete@5) from 83.9% to 95.6%. At five tables, FERN's recall is within one point of RASL's on Spider (96.7 vs 97.0) and on BIRD with its evidence hints (96.6 vs 97.5), and 8.2 points below on BIRD without them (89.3). On 121 real BEAVER questions, without BEAVER fitting, its recall at fifteen (82.1) falls between two BEAVER-trained retrievers (80.8, 84.5), but its complete@15 is below both (49.6 vs 54.5 and 62.0). On Fiben, it falls far short at fifteen tables (54.2 vs 69.2, different question sets), although its recall at fifty is numerically close to RASL's question-only retrieval result (80.7 vs 79.4). On BIRD dev with evidence, non-retrieval features raise complete@5 by 7.7 points over retrieval signals alone. On BIRD dev, median latency is 208 ms per question on one A100, without hosted model calls.

translation.title: FERN：基于冻结检索器与学习排序的跨基准Text-to-SQL表格检索
translation.abstract: 在大型池化目录上运行的Text-to-SQL系统必须先检索出问题所需的表格。我们在池化的BIRD、Spider和Fiben目录上与RASL已发表的表格召回率进行比较，RASL使用Claude 3.5模型提取关键词并选择表格。FERN（Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM，无生成式LLM的特征工程排序）则将三个冻结的检索器融合得到100个候选表，为每个候选表提取最多120个特征，并用仅在BIRD训练问题上拟合一次的LightGBM排序器进行重排。在未拟合过的Spider上，仅其候选池在15张表时即达到RASL已发表的召回率（98.0），且排序器将所有gold表都排进前五的问题占比（complete@5）从83.9%提升到95.6%。在五张表时，FERN的召回率在Spider上与RASL相差不到一个点（96.7 vs 97.0），在带证据提示的BIRD上为96.6 vs 97.5，在不带证据提示的BIRD上则低8.2个点（89.3）。在121个真实的BEAVER问题上，未在BEAVER上拟合的情况下，其15张表召回率（82.1）介于两个BEAVER训练的检索器之间（80.8、84.5），但其complete@15低于两者（49.6 vs 54.5和62.0）。在Fiben上，15张表时差距较大（54.2 vs 69.2，问题集不同），尽管其50张表召回率在数值上接近RASL仅用问题的检索结果（80.7 vs 79.4）。在带证据的BIRD dev上，非检索特征比仅用检索信号将complete@5提高了7.7个点。在BIRD dev上，单个A100上每问题的中位延迟为208毫秒，无需调用托管模型。
translation.brief: 提出FERN，用冻结检索器召回候选表并训练LightGBM排序器重排，替代生成式LLM来完成Text-to-SQL的表格检索。

papers.title: Pterodactyl: Pushing the Limits of Efficient Automated Translation Evaluation
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present 1020 Group's submission to the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation. Our system, Pterodactyl, was engineered specifically for subtasks 2 and 3, that is, segment-level quality score prediction and the detection of error-free segments. Pterodactyl is a highly customizable, ultra-low cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. We also developed several variants of Pterodactyl that were specifically adapted for subtasks 3.

translation.title: Pterodactyl：突破高效自动翻译评估的极限
translation.abstract: 本文介绍1020 Group提交给WMT26自动质量评估共享任务的工作。我们的系统Pterodactyl专为子任务2和3设计，即句级质量分数预测和无错片段检测。Pterodactyl是一个高度可定制、超低成本的系统，针对翻译分流和数据整理中的二分类任务进行了优化。它基于LLM-as-a-judge方法，通过ROC分析来指导提示工程和模型选择。我们还开发了专门适配子任务3的多个Pterodactyl变体。
translation.brief: 提出Pterodactyl系统，用LLM-as-a-judge结合ROC引导的提示工程和模型选择来做句级翻译质量评分与无错片段检测。

papers.title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
papers.abstract: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. Built from 200 ICML 2026 papers, Re-Search tracks how a model's idea evolves as it asks questions and receives binary oracle feedback, isolating ideation from execution. Across six recent LLMs, nearly all progress happens within the first 30 of 100 questions, which largely decide how the game ends; after that, most models plateau. Through controlled interventions on the candidate questions and the hypothesis space, we find that the bottleneck is generation, not judgment: models recognize a good idea or a good question when one is offered, but often cannot produce it on their own. We further analyze the ideation traces and find that models fail by either over-exploiting one direction or over-exploring too many. These findings point to concrete design principles for autoresearch systems: since models can judge candidates they cannot produce, enriching the search with externally sourced ideas and questions may be more effective than improving any single model's generation ability.

translation.title: Re-Search：通过双人提问游戏剖析 LLM 研究构思能力
translation.abstract: 研究构思是一个迭代过程：研究者根据反馈逐步完善想法。然而现有评估方式掩盖了这一搜索过程，使人难以理解 LLM 如何探索研究想法空间以及是什么限制了其进展。我们提出 Re-Search，将“二十个问题”游戏的形式改编用于研究构思：仅给定一篇已发表论文的研究问题，模型必须通过提出是非题来重新发现该论文的核心想法。Re-Search 基于 200 篇 ICML 2026 论文构建，追踪模型的想法在提问和接收二元 oracle 反馈过程中的演变，从而将构思与执行分离。在六个近期 LLM 上，几乎所有进展发生在 100 个问题的前 30 个之内，这基本决定了游戏的结局；此后大多数模型陷入停滞。通过对候选问题和假设空间的受控干预，我们发现瓶颈在于生成而非判断：模型能够识别出被提供的好想法或好问题，但往往无法自己产出。我们进一步分析构思轨迹，发现模型的失败方式是过度深耕单一方向或过度发散探索过多方向。这些发现为自动科研系统指出了具体设计原则：既然模型可以判断其无法产出的候选方案，用外部来源的想法和问题丰富搜索，可能比提升单个模型的生成能力更有效。
translation.brief: 论文提出 Re-Search 基准，以二十个问题式的二元反馈游戏来隔离并剖析 LLM 研究构思过程，发现瓶颈在于生成而非判断。

papers.title: Second-Best Trade Is Half Efficient in Multidimensional Markets
papers.abstract: We prove that at least half of the first-best gains from trade can always be achieved in multidimensional two-sided markets with additive values and costs and arbitrary downward-closed feasibility constraints. The guarantee is achieved by a mechanism satisfying Bayesian incentive compatibility, interim individual rationality, and strong budget balance, and is tight already in single-item bilateral trade. Types are independent across agents, while the coordinates of each agent's type may be arbitrarily correlated. Feasibility constraints may couple trades across items and agents. This extends the known tight one-half guarantee for single-item bilateral trade. Our proof develops a new application of the Cai--Devanur--Weinberg duality framework. We show that the objective of every feasible dual is at least half of the first best. Strong duality then yields the guarantee without characterizing an optimal mechanism or dual. The key observation is that every feasible dual induces continuous-time Markov chains that, when stopped by exponential clocks, recover true types as expectations of virtual types. The dual constraints control the rate at which these chains change the prior distributions. We establish our bound by combining this control with a coupling of the agents' clocks.

translation.title: 多维市场中的次优交易达到一半效率
translation.abstract: 我们证明，在具有可加价值与成本以及任意向下封闭可行性约束的多维双边市场中，总能实现至少一半的第一最优交易收益。该保证由一个满足贝叶斯激励兼容、期中个体理性和强预算平衡的机制实现，且该保证在单物品双边贸易中已是紧的。各代理人的类型相互独立，而每个代理人类型内部各坐标可任意相关。可行性约束可以跨物品和跨代理人耦合交易。这将已知的单物品双边贸易的一半紧保证推广到更一般的情形。我们的证明发展了 Cai--Devanur--Weinberg 对偶框架的一个新应用：我们证明每个可行对偶的目标至少是第一最优的一半，然后由强对偶性直接得到该保证，而无需刻画最优机制或最优对偶。关键观察是每个可行对偶都诱导出连续时间马尔可夫链，当被指数时钟停止时，可将真实类型恢复为虚拟类型的期望。对偶约束控制这些链改变先验分布的速率，我们通过将这种控制与代理人时钟的耦合相结合来建立我们的界。
translation.brief: 论文证明在加性价值与向下封闭约束的多维双边市场中，满足激励兼容等性质的机制总能取得至少一半的第一最优交易收益，方法是基于 Cai–Devanur–Weinberg 对偶框架构造连续时间马尔可夫链分析。

papers.title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
papers.abstract: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent's reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On $79$ procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach $93.8\%$ completion, against $96.8\%$ for the agent, at $24\%$ lower cost per task. On $\tau^2$-Bench, they reach $75.8\%$ task success (agent: $80.6\%$) and run in $1.3$s instead of $170$s; three rounds of repair on training failures lift $k{=}2$ workflows from $66.7\%$ to $81.2\%$. On eight SOP-Bench procedures, ReTrace without repair trails few-shot generation ($80.6\%$ vs. $83.6\%$), but repair from labeled training failures lifts it to $87.8\%$ at $0.40$s per task, compared to $85.5\%$ in $46.6$s for the agent.

translation.title: ReTrace：将使用工具的 Agent 蒸馏为无规划器的工作流
translation.abstract: 业务流程自动化在新的输入上反复执行同一份标准操作规程（SOP）。大语言模型（LLM）agent 可以遵循以自然语言编写的 SOP，但每次执行中每一步都需要调用 LLM 来决策，在大规模场景下增加了延迟和成本。我们提出 ReTrace，它将一份 SOP 和少量有日志的 agent 运行记录转化为可复用的工作流，其中由代码而非 LLM 来选择下一步。agent 的推理（即它随每次工具调用写下的解释）往往说明了它为何采取该行动，而仅有工具调用则不能。ReTrace 提取每一步背后的条件，将这些条件跨运行合并为一份紧凑的规则文档，并据此生成可执行工作流。只有最后一个阶段依赖于平台，因此规则文档可以编译到不同的编排平台。在我们生产平台的 79 个流程上，ReTrace 工作流达到 93.8% 的完成率（agent 为 96.8%），每任务成本降低 24%。在 τ²-Bench 上，它们达到 75.8% 的任务成功率（agent 为 80.6%），运行时间从 170 秒降至 1.3 秒；对训练失败的三个回合修复将 k=2 工作流从 66.7% 提升至 81.2%。在 SOP-Bench 的 8 个流程上，未经修复的 ReTrace 略低于少样本生成（80.6% vs 83.6%），但基于标注训练失败的修复将其提升至 87.8%，每任务 0.40 秒，而 agent 为 46.6 秒达到 85.5%。
translation.brief: 论文提出 ReTrace，通过提取 agent 运行日志中的推理条件并编译为规则文档，将 LLM 工具调用 agent 蒸馏为无需 LLM 决策的低成本可复用工作流。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
papers.abstract: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery, uncovering 24 novel failures with zero overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming. Our results demonstrate that (1) the information available to the evaluation harness determines evaluation quality, (2) functional and security evaluation are complementary, and (3) LLM-based evaluation harnesses surface subtle errors that human reviewers miss. We recommend a two-framework strategy: trace-based evaluation for functional assessment and adversarial red-teaming for security validation.

translation.title: Agent 评估框架的对比分析：企业分析 Agent 的稳定性、检测与发现
translation.abstract: 在企业环境中部署基于 LLM 的分析 agent，需要能在复杂多工具工作流中可靠检测故障的评估框架。我们在受控研究环境中，使用冻结的执行轨迹，对三种评估框架进行了三阶段对比研究，每种框架代表一种不同的评估范式（基于轨迹的 LLM 评判、纯文本 LLM 评判结合红队测试、以及确定性启发式规则），应用于两个分析 agent。第一阶段通过重复测量量化评估框架的稳定性，发现 97% 的配置达到稳定性阈值，且稳定性模式与具体 agent 无关。第二阶段在 72 个真值测试用例上测量已知风险检测，其中基于轨迹的框架取得最佳的精确率-召回率平衡（F1=0.90），而纯文本评估在召回率上持平但产生 5 倍的误报。第三阶段评估未知风险发现，共发现 24 个新故障，且功能测试与安全红队测试之间零重叠。我们的结果表明：（1）评估框架可获得的信息决定评估质量；（2）功能评估与安全评估是互补的；（3）基于 LLM 的评估框架能暴露人类审查者遗漏的细微错误。我们推荐双框架策略：用基于轨迹的评估做功能评估，用对抗性红队测试做安全验证。
translation.brief: 论文在企业分析 agent 上对比三种评估范式，量化其稳定性、已知风险检测和未知风险发现能力，并据此推荐轨迹评估加红队测试的双框架策略。

papers.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
papers.abstract: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on a single applied domain, serve each instance only once, and assume a single family of learner, so memory-based and weight-based systems are rarely compared on the same scale. We propose Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream built from the three ARC-AGI editions, whose tasks need no domain knowledge. The same tasks return after dormant gaps with fresh instances, while new tasks keep arriving. On each instance, the learner may pay for demonstrations, submit answers, or act inside the harness, with retries permitted on incorrect submissions, which are paid for. Each instance is scored based on the share of this feedback budget consumed. Since a learner may keep anything between instances, memory-based and weight-based systems are scored on the same scale. After the stream, the learner is frozen and tested on fresh instances of the tasks it met, which measures memorization, and on unseen tasks, which measures generalization. We run an agent harness with frozen weights, with and without persistence, on Qwen3.5-9B and GLM-5.3 Flash, comparing them with two prompting floors, a program-induction method and Qwen3.5-9B's weights trained to imitate GLM-5.3 Flash. Persistence in the harness generally does not improve memorization unless provided with explicit expert guidance. Most harness-based methods still learn less than a floor that simply caches each task's demonstrations, across all models we tested. No harness-based method gains on unseen tasks, whereas weight-based learning shows substantial gains. This opens the door to future weight-based continual learning that could teach models to drive harnesses in new domains.

translation.title: Continual-ARC：测量一个工作生命周期内的技能习得
translation.abstract: Agent harness 已成为持续学习以及测试时参数化学习的一种有前景机制。然而现有基准存在若干局限：它们通常只关注单一应用领域，每个实例只出现一次，并假设单一类型的学习者，因此基于记忆的系统与基于权重的系统很少在同一尺度上进行比较。我们提出 Continual-ARC，一个由三个 ARC-AGI 版本构建的终身学习流，其任务不需要领域知识。同一任务会在休眠间隔后以新实例的形式回归，同时新任务不断到来。在每个实例上，学习者可以付费获取示范、提交答案，或在 harness 内行动，允许对错误提交重试（需付费）。每个实例根据消耗的反馈预算比例来评分。由于学习者可以在实例之间保留任何信息，基于记忆和基于权重的系统在同一尺度上被评分。流结束后，冻结学习者，并在其见过的任务的新实例上测试（衡量记忆），以及在未见任务上测试（衡量泛化）。我们在 Qwen3.5-9B 和 GLM-5.3 Flash 上运行权重冻结的 agent harness（含与不含持久化），并与两个提示基线、一个程序归纳方法以及经训练模仿 GLM-5.3 Flash 的 Qwen3.5-9B 权重进行比较。结果表明 harness 中的持久化通常不能改善记忆，除非提供明确的专家指导；我们测试的所有模型上，大多数基于 harness 的方法学到的东西仍少于简单缓存每个任务示范的提示基线；没有任何基于 harness 的方法在未见任务上获益，而基于权重的学习则显示出显著收益。这为未来基于权重的持续学习打开了大门，可能教会模型在新领域驱动 harness。
translation.brief: 论文提出 Continual-ARC 终身学习流基准，在同一尺度上统一评测基于记忆与基于权重的持续学习系统的技能习得、记忆与泛化能力。

papers.title: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
papers.abstract: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling them to match or surpass closed-source frontier models in our evaluations. These results establish Pyrite as a challenging test of pose-ranking ability and highlight LLM-guided feature discovery as a promising approach to interpret and combine the outputs of computational chemistry tools.

translation.title: Pyrite：构建与基准测试蛋白-配体构象排序智能体
translation.abstract: 预测配体如何结合其靶标是小分子药物发现的核心。现代共折叠模型能够生成多样化的候选构象，但可靠地对这些候选进行排序仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 Pyrite，一个包含 1,500 个构象对、覆盖多种蛋白-配体复合物的成对构象排序基准。配备 3D 可视化工具和基于物理打分的专家化学家的表现接近随机水平，凸显了解读现有化学信号的困难。为研究自动化排序，我们提出 PyriteRep，一种对分子几何结构、蛋白-配体相互作用和理化打分的结构化表示，并开发了两个基于 LLM 的智能体：PyriteReasoner，通过基于文本的推理直接比较构象；PyriteFeaturizer，生成可执行代码来构建用于逻辑回归的特征，并可选地纳入由 LLM 子调用派生的特征。这两个智能体分别达到最高 67% 和 74% 的准确率，超过了观察到的专家表现。LLM 引导的特征发现总体上优于直接推理，而 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 提升了开源权重模型，使其在我们的评估中能够匹敌或超越闭源前沿模型。这些结果确立了 Pyrite 作为构象排序能力的一项具有挑战性的测试，并凸显 LLM 引导的特征发现是解读和融合计算化学工具输出的一种有前景的方法。
translation.brief: 针对蛋白-配体构象候选难以可靠排序的问题，构建了 Pyrite 排序基准，并提出基于 LLM 的推理与代码生成特征两个智能体来实现自动化排序。

papers.title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.

translation.title: 对比式发现：基于竞争性解释的开放式科学发现
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地被用于开放式、数据驱动的科学发现，但大多数智能体采用逐点方式评估假设，即仅针对其补集 ¬h 来检验经验性命题 h。当证据否定 h 时，智能体只知道一个解释不太可能成立，却不知道证据支持哪个替代解释。为了找回该替代解释，我们提出 Contrastive Discovery，将单一假设替换为对比集（contrast set），即一个科学问题配上一组互斥且穷尽的相互竞争的解释。每个实验根据其证据如何在集合中重新分配信念来进行打分，当信念集中于某一解释时问题即被解决。由于对比集只改变智能体提出和打分的单元，现有智能体可以利用它重新评估已收集的证据或指导其搜索。在六个领域中，逐点方式下信念偏移最大的候选中 89% 是否定。在相同证据下，对比集将这些候选中的 73% 解析为具体的替代解释。当对比集引导搜索时，智能体在相同实验预算下比逐点 surprisal 多解决 67% 的问题。在一项盲测研究中，38 名人类专家在 78% 已解决的问题以及 82% 逐点智能体否定其假设即停止的问题上选择了相同的解释。这些结果共同表明，显式的竞争性解释能帮助发现智能体用相同的证据和验证预算解决更多科学问题。
translation.brief: 针对逐点假设检验无法指明证据支持哪个替代解释的问题，提出用互斥且穷尽的对比集替代单一假设来评估与引导搜索的方法。
